Dim satirNo, sagMargin
Sub PrintForm()
	prev = SFDC31E.GetFieldValue("ISPREV",1)
	prev = 1

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketBoyu = 100
	EtiketEni = 100
	sagMargin = EtiketEni - 2

	If prev = 0 Then
		res=pe1.Open(1,"Atölye Takip",EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni,"")
	Else
		res=pe1.Open(0,"Atölye Takip",EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni,"") 
	End If

	For i = 1 to SFDC00T.GetRowCount()
		if Doc.Is_EY1(SFDC00T.SELECTED(i)) Then
			Secilen = Secilen + 1
			if Secilen > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak()
			satirNo = i
			Call PrintLabel1(pe1)
		End if
	Next
	if Secilen = 0 Then k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Hiç makara seçmediniz", "dinamo", MB_OK)
	If prev <> 0 Then
		res = pe1.Show()
	End If
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
	If prev = 0 Then
		res = pe1.printdoc(0)
		res = pe1.close()
	End If
End Sub
Sub PrintLabel1(pe1)
	Evrak = Doc.RightJustify(trim(SFDC00T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)), 10)
	Tarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "TARIH", Evrak, ""))
	FisNo = Evrak
	MpsNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "MPSNO", Evrak, "")
	StokKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "STOK_CODE", Evrak, "")
	stokkodu1 = mid(StokKodu,1,2)
	MAKARAADET = 0
	Set S31T = Doc.Select1("sdfsdf", "SFDC31T", "EVRAKNO='"+Evrak+"'", "", -1)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,-1)
	Miktar = SFDC00T.KALAN(satirNo)
	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(Miktar)
	Miktar1 = Doc.NumFormat(miktar,12,Ondalik) 
	'Birim = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "SF_SF_UNIT", Evrak, "")
	Birim = "m"
	OperatorKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "IS_OPERATOR_1", Evrak, "")
	operator = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERS00", "AD", OperatorKodu,"")
	vardiya = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "VARDIYA", Evrak, "")
'  ISLEMKODU = TRIM(SFDC31E.D7_ISLEM_KODU(1))

	if ISLEMKODU= "U" then
		ISLEMKODU = "ÜRETÝM"
	ELSE
		ISLEMKODU = "KALAN"
	END IF

	IsNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "JOBNO", Evrak, "")
	MPaketMiktari = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10T","R_YMK_MPAKET",IsNo,"JOBNO")
	YMPaketMiktari = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10T","R_YMK_YMPAKET",IsNo,"JOBNO")
	YMPaketIcerigi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10T","R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI",IsNo,"JOBNO")
	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(YMPaketIcerigi)
	YMPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YMPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
 

	ToplamMiktar = MPaketMiktari & " x " & YMPaketMiktari & " x " & YMPaketIcerigi
	
	
	TezgahKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "X_T_ISMERKEZI", Evrak, "")
	TezgahAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",TezgahKodu,-1)
	OperasyonKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "OPERASYON", Evrak, "")
	OperasyonAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)


	MakaraNo = SFDC00T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)

	A_K= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E","ACIK_KAPALI",MpsNo,"")
	SiparisNo = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E","URETIMSIPINO",MpsNo,"")
	Rev_tes_tar = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E","REVURETIMDENTESTARIH",MpsNo,"")
	Musterikodu = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E","MUSTERIKODU",MpsNo,"")
	Musteriadi = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",Musterikodu,-1)

	Notlar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "NOTES", Evrak, "")
	renk = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC31E", "GK_1", Evrak, "")

	Notlar2 = Doc.GetUDFValue("S3",FisNo,"NOT",1)
	Notlar3 = Doc.GetUDFValue("S3",FisNo,"NOT",2)
	Notlar4 = Doc.GetUDFValue("S3",FisNo,"NOT",3)

	If trim(MakaraNo) <> trim(FisNo) Then
		msgbox("YANLIÞ ALANDAN ETÝKET BASIYORSUNUZ...MAKARA  TOPLAMI ÝÇÝN ETÝKET alanýný kullanýnýz.")
		res = pe1.close()
	End if

	MAKARAADET =  Doc.GetUDFValue("S3",FisNo,"TELMAKARA",0) 
	TOTAL = DOC.DIV(Miktar,MAKARAADET)  
	TOTAL1 = FormatNumber(TOTAL,0,,,-1)
	miktar = FormatNumber(miktar,0,,,-1)


	if miktar < 2 then 
		msgbox " Duruþ Etiketi Basýyorsunuz VEYA Miktarý Yanlýþ Girdiniz.Makara No'sunu kontrol ediniz"
		msgbox "Doðru yazmadýðýnýz sürece etiket basamazsýnýz"
		res = pe1.close()
	end if

	logo =Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")
	res=pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(3,3,90,96) 
	res = pe1.nopen()
	

	res = pe1.picture(5,45,12,45,"\\Ilkeden\d7k\d7000\ATOM2.bmp",100)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(7,5,12,15,"Üret.T")
	res = pe1.write(7,21,12,32,": " & Tarih)

	
	res = pe1.write(13,5,9,18,"MPS No")  
 	res = pe1.write(13,21,19,19,": " & trim(MpsNo))  

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",14)

	res = pe1.write(20,5,7,90,Trim(StokAdi))
	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.write(30,5,6,25,"Miktar")
	res = pe1.write(30,62,6,33,ISLEMKODU)
	res = pe1.write(30,32,6,50,": " & miktar & " " & Trim(Birim))


	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",10)

	res = pe1.write(36,5,16,31,"Tez./Oper. Kodu")
	res = pe1.write(36,32,15,63,": "&trim(TezgahKodu) & " / " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(operasyonadi)) 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.line(28,3,0,96) 
	res = pe1.line(81,3,0,96) 

	res = pe1.write(42,5,16,16,"Renk")
	res = pe1.write(42,32,9,50,": "&renk)

	res = pe1.write(48,5,16,31,"Operator")
	res = pe1.write(48,32,9,55,": "& trim(operator))

	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",11)	
	res = pe1.write(54,5,6,25,"Makara No")
	res = pe1.BarCode(54,32,20,50,"CODE128",Trim(MakaraNo),"") 
   
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)  
	res = pe1.write(83,5,9,10,"Not: ") 
	res = pe1.write(83,12,9,83,Notlar2) 

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i=1 To S31T.GetRowCount()
		KMakaraNo = KMakaraNo & trim(S31T.LOTNUMBER(i)) & "-"
	Next 
	if Len(KMakaraNo) > 0 Then KMakaraNo = Left(KMakaraNo, Len(KMakaraNo)-1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(70,5,5,20,"Giriþ Mak:") 
	res = pe1.write(72,5,12,sagMargin - 5,trim(KMakaraNo)) 
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : 01
Hangi Tablo için : STOK40
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : ATOM KABLO SÝPARÝÞ FORMU
Kod : 
Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 30
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 91
	satirsonu=120

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()


	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi", SayfaEni,SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.selectfont("arial",10)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+2,solmargin+63,satiryuksekligi,100,"ATOM KABLO SANAYÝ VE TÝC. A.Þ.")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+8,solmargin+77,satiryuksekligi,50,"SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial",9)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"C/H KODU")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"C/H ADI")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+40,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"M.SÝP NO")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin+25,satiryuksekligi,50,":")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin+25,satiryuksekligi,50,":")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+40,solmargin+25,satiryuksekligi,50,":")


	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin+140,satiryuksekligi,50,"SÝP. NO")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin+140,satiryuksekligi,50,"SÝP.TARÝHÝ")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin+158,satiryuksekligi,50,":")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin+158,satiryuksekligi,50,":")

	chkodu=STOK40E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	chadi=STOK40E.MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	msipno=STOK40E.CHSIPNO(1)
	sipno=STOK40E.EVRAKNO(1)
	tarih=Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK40E.TARIH(1))


	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin+28,satiryuksekligi,50,chkodu)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin+28,satiryuksekligi,80,chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+40,solmargin+28,satiryuksekligi,50,msipno)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+30,solmargin+160,satiryuksekligi,50,sipno)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+35,solmargin+160,satiryuksekligi,50,tarih)

'***********************		
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(0)

		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			if Grid(i,2) = "" or Grid(i,2)=""then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			end if
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic-9, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 2
				ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
		Next

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
res = pe1.setbold(0)
Dim satirpozr
		sol=solmargin
		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then

			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))

				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					degisken=doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
				
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+105,solmargin+110,satiryuksekligi,50,"TOPLAM TUTAR")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+110,solmargin+110,satiryuksekligi,50,"%  ÝSKONTO")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+120,solmargin+110,satiryuksekligi,50,"NET TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+125,solmargin+110,satiryuksekligi,50,"%18 KDV")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+135,solmargin+110,satiryuksekligi,50,"GENEL TOPLAM")

	toplamtutar=STOK40E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
	nettoplam=STOK40E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=STOK40E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	yuzde18=STOK40E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+105,solmargin+155,satiryuksekligi,50,toplamtutar)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+120,solmargin+155,satiryuksekligi,50,nettoplam)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+125,solmargin+155,satiryuksekligi,50,yuzde18)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+135,solmargin+155,satiryuksekligi,50,geneltoplam)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(10,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "TOLERANS"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(9,0) = "NOTES"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 35
	Grid(2,1) = 17
	Grid(3,1) = 17
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 17
	Grid(6,1) = 10
	Grid(7,1) = 17
	Grid(8,1) = 20
	Grid(9,1) = 20
	
	Grid(0,2) = "STOK KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "STOK ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(3,2) = "BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = "TOL."
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYATI"	
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTARI"
	Grid(8,2) = "T.TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(9,2) = "NOT"	
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "D"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"
		
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
'		msgbox satirsayisi
						
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
	StokKodu = STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					If degiskenadi = "_IFIYAT" Then
						Miktar = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						IndTutar = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.Div(IndTutar, Miktar)
					elseif degiskenadi="tolerans" then
						ttype=STOK40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						tolerans=STOK40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& tolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "miktar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ortutar" Then
						ondalik= STOK40T.Maxsigdig("OR_FIYAT")
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ttutar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						solTutar = sol
						GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						Degisken = STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If
					If degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					End if
					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 45,6,30,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_GK5"
	Grid(2,0) = "miktar"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "_CU"
	Grid(5,0)	=	"tolerans"
	Grid(6,0) = "ortutar"
	Grid(7,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "ttutar"
	Grid(9,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(10,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(11,0) ="NOTES"
			

	Grid(0,1) = 94
	Grid(1,1) = 18
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 16
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 16
	Grid(7,1) = 8
	Grid(8,1) = 20
	Grid(9,1) = 8
	Grid(10,1) = 20
	Grid(11,1) = 33


	PB = trim(STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Kablo Tipi"
	Grid(1,2) = "GK 5"
	Grid(2,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	Grid(4,2) = "Bakýr Faktörü"
	Grid(5,2) = "Tolerans"
	Grid(6,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(7,2) = ""
	Grid(8,2) = "Toplam Tutar"
	Grid(9,2) = ""
	Grid(10,2) = "Teslim Tarihi"
	Grid(11,2) = "Notlar"
		

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "CC"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"
	Grid(10,4) = "D"
	Grid(11,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	
	Grid(2,6) = 0
	Grid(4,6) = 3
	Grid(6,6) = 3
	Grid(8,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

'				" 3 -  'Hedging grup kodu 1' grup kodunda uygun seçenek seçilecek (FIX,AVG)."

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 15 
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13

	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 15 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satis Siparisi - " & trim(STOK40E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
	satirs=satirsayisi
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		if satirs =1 and sirano > 15 then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa1(pe1)
			res=pe1.pagebreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			sirano=0

		end if
				Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)

	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
'		msgbox satirsayisi
						
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
	StokKodu = STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					If degiskenadi = "_IFIYAT" Then
						Miktar = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						IndTutar = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.Div(IndTutar, Miktar)
					elseif degiskenadi="tolerans" then
						ttype=STOK40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						tolerans=STOK40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& tolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "miktar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ortutar" Then
						ondalik= STOK40T.Maxsigdig("OR_FIYAT")
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ttutar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						solTutar = sol
						GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					Else
						Degisken = STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If
					If degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					End if
					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi
	SatirBitis = SatirSonu1

'	msgbox satirbitis
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin + 40.5, SolMargin, satirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'yatay çizgi
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 10, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		If i <> 2 And i <> 5 And i <> 7 Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+40.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	SatirBitis = SatirSonu
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin + 40.5, SolMargin, satirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 9, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

		If i <> 2 And i <> 6 And i <> 8 Then

		End If

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 10, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)


' notlar mesajlar
'	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","SP  "+STOK40E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
'	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")

	Odeme1 = STOK40E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	Odeme2 = STOK40E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	Not1 = STOK40E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK40E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK40E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Not4 = STOK40E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)

	sevkAdresi2 = STOK40E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	sevkAdresi3 = STOK40E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)


	Blok2 = SolMargin + 35
	Genislik = 150

'ppp
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 45,6,30,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "miktar"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "_CU"
	Grid(5,0)	=	"tolerans"
	Grid(6,0) = "ortutar"
	Grid(7,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "ttutar"
	Grid(9,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(10,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(11,0) ="NOTES"
			

'	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 98
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 16
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 16
	Grid(7,1) = 8
	Grid(8,1) = 20
	Grid(9,1) = 8
	Grid(10,1) = 20
	Grid(11,1) = 47


	PB = trim(STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

'	Grid(0,2) = "Stok Kodu"
	Grid(1,2) = "Kablo Tipi"
	Grid(2,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	Grid(4,2) = "Bakýr Faktörü"
	Grid(5,2) = "Tolerans"
	Grid(6,2) = "Fiyat/ UnitPrice"
	Grid(7,2) = ""
	Grid(8,2) = "Toplam Tutar"
	Grid(9,2) = ""
	Grid(10,2) = "Teslim Tarihi"
	Grid(11,2) = "Notlar"
		

'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "CC"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"
	Grid(10,4) = "D"
	Grid(11,4) = "C"


	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 1 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	
	Grid(2,6) = 0
	Grid(4,6) = 3
	Grid(6,6) = 3
	Grid(8,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
'		msgbox satirsayisi
						
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
	StokKodu = STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					If degiskenadi = "_IFIYAT" Then
						Miktar = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						IndTutar = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.Div(IndTutar, Miktar)
					elseif degiskenadi="tolerans" then
						ttype=STOK40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						tolerans=STOK40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& tolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "miktar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ortutar" Then
						ondalik= STOK40T.Maxsigdig("OR_FIYAT")
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ttutar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						solTutar = sol
						GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						Degisken = STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If
					If degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					End if
					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi
	SatirBitis = SatirSonu1

'	msgbox satirbitis
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin + 40.5, SolMargin, satirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'yatay çizgi
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 10, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		if Grid(i + 1,2) <> "" Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+40.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next

End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 45,6,30,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(12,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_GK5"
	Grid(3,0) = "miktar"

	Grid(6,0)	=	"tolerans"
	Grid(7,0) = "ortutar"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(9,0) = "ttutar"
	Grid(10,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(11,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(12,0) ="NOTES"
			
	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 89
	Grid(2,1) = 12
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 14
	Grid(8,1) = 8
	Grid(9,1) = 17
	Grid(10,1) = 8
	Grid(11,1) = 18
	Grid(12,1) = 34


	PB = trim(STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "Kablo Tipi"
	Grid(2,2) = "GK 5"
	Grid(3,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "Bakýr Faktörü"
	Grid(6,2) = "Tolerans"
	Grid(7,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	Grid(9,2) = "Toplam Tutar"
	Grid(10,2) = ""
	Grid(11,2) = "Teslim Tarihi"
	Grid(12,2) = "Notlar"
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "CC"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"
	Grid(11,4) = "D"
	Grid(12,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	
	Grid(3,6) = 0
	Grid(5,6) = 3
	Grid(7,6) = 4
	Grid(9,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
			If trim(STOK30T.KOD(i)) = "" Then Exit Sub

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	sipno = STOK30T.OALLOC_SIPNO(i)
	res=pe1.Setalign("Left")
' 	CKSNo = CKSN10T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,solmargin,4,20,sipno)
'***********************************************
	
	mamulkod = STOK30T.KOD(i)

		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
'		msgbox satirsayisi
						
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
	StokKodu = STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					If degiskenadi = "_IFIYAT" Then
						Miktar = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						IndTutar = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.Div(IndTutar, Miktar)
					elseif degiskenadi="tolerans" then
						ttype=STOK40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						tolerans=STOK40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& tolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "miktar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ortutar" Then
						ondalik= STOK40T.Maxsigdig("OR_FIYAT")
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ttutar" Then
						Degisken = STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						solTutar = sol
						GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						Degisken = STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If
					If degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					End if
					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 45,6,30,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(12,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_GK5"
	Grid(3,0) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "_CU"
	Grid(6,0)	=	"tolerans"
	Grid(7,0) = "ortutar"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(9,0) = "ttutar"
	Grid(10,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(11,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(12,0) ="NOTES"
			
Grid(0,1) = 30
	Grid(1,1) = 90
	Grid(2,1) = 12
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 13
	Grid(8,1) = 8
	Grid(9,1) = 17
	Grid(10,1) = 8
	Grid(11,1) = 18
	Grid(12,1) = 24


	PB = trim(STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "Kablo Tipi"
	Grid(2,2) = "GK 5"
	Grid(3,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "Bakýr Faktörü"
	Grid(6,2) = "Tolerans"
	Grid(7,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	Grid(9,2) = "Toplam Tutar"
	Grid(10,2) = ""
	Grid(11,2) = "Teslim Tarihi"
	Grid(12,2) = "Notlar"
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "CC"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"
	Grid(11,4) = "D"
	Grid(12,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	
	Grid(3,6) = 0
	Grid(5,6) = 3
	Grid(7,6) = 3
	Grid(9,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

			sirano=0

		end if

	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
'		msgbox satirsayisi
						
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
	StokKodu = TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					If degiskenadi = "_IFIYAT" Then
						Miktar = TEKL40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						IndTutar = TEKL40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.Div(IndTutar, Miktar)
					elseif degiskenadi="tolerans" then
						ttype=TEKL40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						tolerans=TEKL40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& tolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "miktar" Then
						Degisken = TEKL40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ortutar" Then
						ondalik= TEKL40T.Maxsigdig("OR_FIYAT")
						Degisken = TEKL40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
					elseIf degiskenadi = "ttutar" Then
						Degisken = TEKL40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(SatirNo)
						solTutar = sol
						GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						Degisken = TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If
					If degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					End if
					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_AraSayfa(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 23 * satirYuksekligi
	SatirBitis = SatirSonu1

'	msgbox satirbitis
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin + 40.5, SolMargin, satirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'yatay çizgi
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 10, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		if Grid(i + 1,2) <> "" Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+40.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	SatirBitis = SatirSonu
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin + 40.5, SolMargin, satirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 9, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 40.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		if Grid(i + 1,2) <> "" Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+40.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 10, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)


' notlar mesajlar
'	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","SP  "+TEKL40E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))

'ppp
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 45,6,30,"Sayfa")
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(12,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_GK5"

	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(9,0) = "ttutar"
	Grid(10,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(11,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(12,0) ="NOTES"
			
	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 91
	Grid(2,1) = 12
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 12
	Grid(8,1) = 8
	Grid(9,1) = 17
	Grid(10,1) = 8
	Grid(11,1) = 18
	Grid(12,1) = 34


	PB = trim(TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "Kablo Tipi"
	Grid(2,2) = "GK 5"
	Grid(3,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "Bakýr Faktörü"
	Grid(6,2) = "Tolerans"
	Grid(7,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	Grid(9,2) = "Toplam Tutar"
	Grid(10,2) = ""
	Grid(11,2) = "Teslim Tarihi"
	Grid(12,2) = "Notlar"
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "CC"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"
	Grid(11,4) = "D"
	Grid(12,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	
	Grid(3,6) = 0
	Grid(5,6) = 3
	Grid(7,6) = 4
	Grid(9,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

'	sayfaBoyu = 210
'	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 10
	BasliksatirBaslangic = 57

	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	solTutar = 150
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60

	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi

	n = 0

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

'	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satis Siparisi - " & trim(TEKL40E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satis Siparisi - " & trim(TEKL40E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni, "PORTRAIT")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	satirs = satirsayisi

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		if satirs =1 and sirano > 30 then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res=pe1.pagebreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
'			sirano=0
			sirano = 1
		end if
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

' QQQ
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 65
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
			satiryuksekligi = 5
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		StokKodu = TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If

					If degiskenadi = "_MIKTAR" Then
						Degisken = Doc.Div(TEKL40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo),1000)
					elseif degiskenadi="_TOLERANS" then
						ttype=TEKL40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						vTolerans=Doc.NumFormat_Nlz(TEKL40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo),12,2)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& vTolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					ElseIf degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					Else
						Degisken = TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

	Grid(2,1) = 10
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 16
	Grid(5,1) = 12
'	Grid(6,1) = 12
'	Grid(7,1) = 8
	Grid(6,1) = 20
	Grid(7,1) = 0
	Grid(8,1) = 34


	PB = trim(TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Cable Type"
	Grid(1,2) = "Code"
	Grid(2,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	Grid(4,2) = "Cu V."
	Grid(5,2) = "Tolerance"
	'Grid(7,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(6,2) = "Unit Price"
	Grid(7,2) = ""
	Grid(8,2) = "Notes"
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"
	Grid(11,4) = "D"
	Grid(12,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	

	Grid(3,6) = 0
	Grid(5,6) = 3
	Grid(7,6) = 4
	Grid(9,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

'	sayfaBoyu = 210
'	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 10
	BasliksatirBaslangic = 57

	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	solTutar = 150
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60

	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi

	n = 0

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

'	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satis Siparisi - " & trim(TEKL40E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satis Siparisi - " & trim(TEKL40E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni, "PORTRAIT")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	satirs = satirsayisi

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		if satirs =1 and sirano > 30 then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res=pe1.pagebreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
'			sirano=0
			sirano = 1
		end if
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

' QQQ
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 65
	satirSonu1 = satirBaslangic + 30 * satirYuksekligi

		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If sonSatir >= satirSonu1 Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic - 7 
			satiryuksekligi = 5
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-7
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic - 7 + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		

		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		StokKodu = TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

					If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					End If

					If degiskenadi = "_MIKTAR" Then
						Degisken = Doc.Div(TEKL40T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo),1000)
					elseif degiskenadi="_TOLERANS" then
						ttype=TEKL40T.TOLERANSTYPE(SatirNo)			
						vTolerans=Doc.NumFormat_Nlz(TEKL40T.TOLERANS(SatirNo),12,2)
						degisken ="  "& ttype &"  "& vTolerans
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_CU" Then
						Degisken = GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, 1)						
					elseIf degiskenadi = "_GK5" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", StokKodu, "")
					ElseIf degiskenadi = "PRICEUNIT" Then
						SolPB = sol
					Else
						Degisken = TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
					End If

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr - 2 , Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
			satirs=satirs-1
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	If pe1.GetPageCount > 1 Then
		For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount
			res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'			res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 185, 6,26,"Sayfa")
'			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'			res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
'		'	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 9 * SatirAra,xCizgi(9) + 53,6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
'		'	res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 215, 6,50,": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)

			res = pe1.Write(BBasla + (6*satirara+5), SolMargin+5, 6,50,"Page : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

Function GetBakirAgirligi(StokKodu, Miktar)
	KartAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_14", StokKodu, "")
	if Doc.Round(KartAgirlik, 3) > 0 Then
		GetBakirAgirligi = KartAgirlik * Miktar
		Exit Function
	End if
	BakirAgirligi = 0
	ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", StokKodu,1, Miktar,"","","","","","","","")
	Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		Hmd = Left(Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i),3)
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "H" and (Hmd = "H00" or Hmd = "H01") Then
			BakirAgirligi = BakirAgirligi + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End if
	Next
	GetBakirAgirligi = Doc.Round(BakirAgirligi, 3)
End Function

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(12,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_GK5"
	Grid(2,0) = "_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "_CU"
	Grid(5,0)	=	"_TOLERANS"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(7,0) = "____birimiPRICEUNIT"
	Grid(8,0) ="NOTES"
			
	Grid(0,1) = 60
	Grid(1,1) = 15
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 16
	Grid(5,1) = 12
'	Grid(6,1) = 12
'	Grid(7,1) = 8
	Grid(6,1) = 20
	Grid(7,1) = 0
	Grid(8,1) = 34


	PB = trim(TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	If PB = "ECU" Then PB = "EURO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Cable Type"
	Grid(1,2) = "GK 5"
	Grid(2,2) = "Quantity (km)"
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	Grid(4,2) = "Traus"
	Grid(5,2) = "Tolerans"
	'Grid(7,2) = "Fiyat/" & vbcrlf & "Unit Price"
	Grid(6,2) = "Unit Price"
	Grid(7,2) = ""
	Grid(8,2) = "Notes"
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"
	Grid(11,4) = "D"
	Grid(12,4) = "C"

	Sol = SolMargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			Grid(i,6) = 2
		end if
		SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next	

	Grid(3,6) = 0
	Grid(5,6) = 3
	Grid(7,6) = 4
	Grid(9,6) = 2

	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 25
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 9
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 56
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 5
	n = 0


	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Teklifi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
'	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call Print_form_EnSonSayfa(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
				If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					End If
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_ISKONTOLU_FIYAT" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						OrFiyat = TEKL40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
						Indirim = TEKL40T.ISKONTO_EFEKTIF(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(OrFiyat * (1 - Indirim / 100),18,2)
					End If
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	SatirBitis = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	cizgiBasla = satirbaslangic - 8
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - cizgiBasla

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(cizgiBasla - 5, SolMargin, cizgiBoyu + 5, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla + 6, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
	Next

End Sub
Sub Print_form_EnSonSayfa(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve

'	bBasla = EnAlt + 17

	Next
	
'	Ondalik = Grid(5,6)
	Ondalik = 2

	ToplamTutar = TEKL40E.OR_NEWTOPLAM
	ToplamTutar = Doc.NumFormat0(ToplamTutar,18,Ondalik)
	IskontoTutari = TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI
	IskontoTutari = Doc.NumFormat0(IskontoTutari,18,Ondalik)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(1,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "ISKONTO_EFEKTIF"

	Grid(0,1) = 80
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 26
	Grid(4,1) = 26
	Grid(5,1) = 15

	Grid(0,2) = "AÇIKLAMA"
	Grid(1,2) = "METRE"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLIM TRH."
	Grid(3,2) = "B.FÝYAT"
	Grid(4,2) = "TUTAR (TL)"
	Grid(5,2) = "Ýsk(%)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Set dovizTable = Dovizler
	if dovizTable.GetRecCount() = 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	elseif dovizTable.GetRecCount() > 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	End if
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next

End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Yaz(pe1,Ust,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	satirPozr = Ust
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	if Ust > satirSonu then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		call Normal(pe1)
'		Call Print_form_sayfabasi1(pe1)
		satirPozr = Ustmargin + 15
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirPozr - 1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)
	end if
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	Ust = satirPozr
End Sub
Function DovizVarMi()
	DovizVarMi = False
	For i = 1 to TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
		ParaBirimi = TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
		if trim(ParaBirimi) <> "" and trim(ParaBirimi) <> "TL" then
			DovizVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function Dovizler()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=TEKL40T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TK40 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set TEKL40 = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	TK40.CopyTable(TEKL40)
	TK40.GroupBy("PRICEUNIT")
	set Dovizler = TK40
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	satirBaslangic = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 151.5
	sayfaEni = 211.5
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(33)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Bordro Formu", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	UstMargin = satiryuksekligi * 2
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 5
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 5
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = BRDR1TP.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	If i > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak()
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 8)
	res = pe1.setalign("Left")

'BAÞLIK ALANLAR
	SicilNo = BRDR1TP.KOD(i)
	AdSoyad = BRDR1TP.AD_SOYAD(i)

	ESube = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSB01","IY_SICILNO_ESUBE",Isyeri,"")

	Il = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSB01","IY_SICILNO_IL",Isyeri,"")

	Medeni = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","MEDENI_DURUMU",SicilNo,"")
	MedeniDurum = Doc.GetGecoValue("|MEDENI","AD",Medeni,-1)

	BrutKazanc = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_BRUTKAZANC(i)
	NetOdenecek = BRDR1TP.NETODENECEK(i)
	SSKMatrahi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_SSKMATRAHI(i)
	GVMatrahi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_GVMATRAHI(i)
	KumGvMatrahi = BRDR1TP.KUM_GVMATRAHI(i)
	DVMatrahi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_BRUTKAZANC(i)
	GelirVergisi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_GV(i)
	SSK_Isci = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_SSKPRIMI(i)- BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMII(i)
	Issizlik = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMII(i)
	Borc = BRDR1TP.KESILENAVANS(i)
	Avans = BRDR1TP.KESILENBORC(i)





	BordroDonem = BRDR1TP.CTARIH1(i)
	Ay = Mid(BordroDonem,6,2)
	Yil = Left(BordroDonem,4)

		DonemIsmi = "OCAK"
	Elseif trim(Ay) = "02" then
		DonemIsmi = "ÞUBAT"
	Elseif trim(Ay) = "03" then

	Elseif trim(Ay) = "04" then
		DonemIsmi = "NÝSAN"
	Elseif trim(Ay) = "05" then

	Elseif trim(Ay) = "06" then
		DonemIsmi = "HAZÝRAN"
	Elseif trim(Ay) = "07" then
		DonemIsmi = "TEMMUZ"
	Elseif trim(Ay) = "08" then

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 15
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 100
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 35 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "e-bildirge",  SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB43T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic-9, solmargin+159, satiryuksekligi,15,"ÜÝGPEK")
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic-5, solmargin+157, satiryuksekligi,15,"Tutarý YTL")
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic-5, solmargin+173, satiryuksekligi,6,"EGS")
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic-5, solmargin+180, satiryuksekligi,6,"ÝÇN")

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB43T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	
		n = n+1
			
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB43T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
			
				If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" then
					degisken = n
					res = pe1.writebox(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi, Degisken)
				End if
				If DegiskenAdi = "_CINS" then
					Cinsiyet = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERSM0","CINSIYET",PERSB43T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirno),"")
					Degisken = Cinsiyet
					res = pe1.writebox(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				End if

		
					'If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
					'	Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
					'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					'End if	
 					'If DegiskenAdi = "ISEGIRISTARIHI" then
					'	Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
					'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					'End if	
					
				res = pe1.writebox(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	SayfaNo	 = pe1.GetCurrentPage()
	res = pe1.write(satirSonu + satiryuksekligi, 185, satiryuksekligi, 20, SayfaNo & "-" &SayfaSayisi)


End Sub

End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.line(ustmargin,solmargin,0,Altmargin-Ustmargin)

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 148.5
	sayfaEni = 210
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	UstMargin2 = 157
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 6
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 5
	satiryuksekligi = 4.5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4.5


	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Bordro Formu",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = BRDR1TP.GetRecCount()

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 160
	sayfaEni = 216
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 8.6
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 1
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 5
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Bordro Formu",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(33)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = BRDR1TP.GetRecCount()

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	If i > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak()
	res = pe1.setalign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	Logo = Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	'res = pe1.write(10, solmargin + 160,satiryuksekligi, 40,"Tarih : " & doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.Today()))

'ALANLAR
	SicilNo = BRDR1TP.KOD(i)
	AdSoyad = BRDR1TP.AD_SOYAD(i)
	Isyeri = BRDR1TP.ISYERIKODU(i)
	IsyeriAdi = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSB01","IY_UNVAN",Isyeri,"")
	Departman = BRDR1TP.DEPARTMAN(i)
	DepartmanAdi = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM04","ACIKLAMA",Departman,"")
	Gorev = BRDR1TP.GOREVKODU(i)
	GorevAdi = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM05","MESLEKADI",Gorev,"")
	GirisTarih = BRDR1TP.TARIH1(i)
	GirisTarih = doc.StrtoNordate(GirisTarih)
	CikisTarih = BRDR1TP.TARIH2(i)
	CikisTarih = doc.StrtoNordate(CikisTarih)
	Ucret = BRDR1TP.N_UCRET(i)
	NetBrut = BRDR1TP.N_KAZANC_NTBRT(i)
	KimlikNo = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","TCKIMLIKNO",SicilNo,"")
	SSKNo = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","SIGORTASICILNO",SicilNo,"")
	VergiNo = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","VERGINO",SicilNo,"")
	Medeni = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","MEDENI_DURUMU",SicilNo,"")
	MedeniDurum = Doc.GetGecoValue("|MEDENI","AD",Medeni,-1)
	SSKNo = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","SIGORTASICILNO",SicilNo,"")

Sub PrintForm()
	BTopTut = 0
	ATopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 45
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Cari Hesap Fiþi",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = CARI20T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
       Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 40	
	SatirSonu = 270
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 40 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
   res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Write(10,55,5,120,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(15,75,5,80,"C A R Ý   H E S A P   F Ý Þ Ý")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

	res = pe1.Write(30,176,10,15,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(30,186,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(30,90,10,15,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(30,100,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(CARI20E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(30,105,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(30,11,10,20,"EVRAK NO")
	res = pe1.Write(30,26,10,2,":")
	BNo = CARI20E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,17)
	res = pe1.Write(30,23,10,17,BoNo)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(25,10,12,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

 	CKod = CARI20T.KOD(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,25,CKod)
	CU1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,"")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,34,4,40,CU1)
	Vir = CARI20T.MFORCE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,75,4,2,Vir) 
	MKHNo = CARI20T.MUHASEBECODE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,80,4,25,MKHNo)
	Nit = CARI20T.NITELIK(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,107,4,2,Nit) 
	Acik = CARI20T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,111,4,35,Acik) 
	BTutar = CARI20T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i)
	BTopTut = BTutar + BTopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,149,4,25,Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(BTutar,10,2))
	ATutar = CARI20T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	ATopTut = ATutar + ATopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,173,4,25,Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(ATutar,10,2))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(37,33,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,74,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,79,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,106,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,110,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,148,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(37,175,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
