Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 1 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(AA,110,7,90)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.Write(Ara,112,8,30,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,139,8,2,":")
	BTopT = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(BTopTut,10,2)
	ATopT = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(ATopTut,10,2)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara,149,8,25,BTopT)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara,173,8,25,ATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
'	OrtVa = CKSN10E.ORTALAMARVALOR
'	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	
'	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)

End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,189,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public xCizgi, sayfaSatirSayisi, ToplamBrut, ToplamNet, ToplamBoy
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		AltUst = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, AltUst, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(AltUst, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(AltUst, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTY" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums"

  ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	toplamust = pe1.GetTop()
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(4,0) = "_QTY"
	Grid(5,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(6,0) = "_OUTER"	
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(3,1) = 86
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 11
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF DRUMS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "INNER END"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "OUTER END"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
		res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 100, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets"
	'ToplamStr2 = "Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr2 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"


	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	toplamust = pe1.GetTop()
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr2)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(3,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(4,0) = "_QTYOFPAL"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(3,1) = 97
	Grid(4,1) = 0
	Grid(5,1) = 11
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
		res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 100, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub

	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_1)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(4,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(8,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(9,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 20
	Grid(1,1) = 22
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 56
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 11
	Grid(8,1) = 11
	Grid(9,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(4,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(8,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(9,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 80, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : CEKI1
Hangi Tablo için : STOK66
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için :

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public xCizgi, sayfaSatirSayisi, ToplamBrut, ToplamNet, ToplamBoy
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		AltUst = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, AltUst, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(AltUst, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(AltUst, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTY" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums"

  ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF DRUMS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "INNER END"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "OUTER END"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then

		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & STOK66T.GetRowCount() & " drums"

  ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,8)

'	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
'	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(0,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(1,0) = "SF_VRI_VR_R3"
	Grid(2,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(3,0) = "_QTY"
	Grid(4,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(5,0) = "_OUTER"	
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
'	Grid(0,1) = 18
'	Grid(1,1) = 18
	Grid(0,1) = 26
	Grid(1,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(2,1) = 102
	Grid(3,1) = 11
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
'	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
'	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM DRUM NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "DUCAB DRUM NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(3,2) = "QTY OF DRUMS"
	Grid(4,2)	 = "INNER END"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "OUTER END"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
'	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "NC"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public xCizgi, sayfaSatirSayisi, ToplamBrut, ToplamNet, ToplamBoy
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets"
	'ToplamStr2 = "Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr2 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"


res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr2)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

	Grid(3,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"

	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)

			Degisken = Grid(i,0)

			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets"
	'ToplamStr2 = "Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr2 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"


	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	toplamust = pe1.GetTop()
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr2)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(3,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(4,0) = "_QTYOFPAL"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 30
	Grid(2,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(3,1) = 93
	Grid(4,1) = 0
	Grid(5,1) = 11
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
		res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 100, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

  res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
'	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	'ToplamStr2 = "Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr2 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"


res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr2)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

'	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(0,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(2,0) = "_GRUP9"
'	Grid(4,0) = "_QTYOFPAL"
	Grid(3,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(4,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
'	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(0,1) = 24
	Grid(1,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(2,1) = 105
'	Grid(4,1) = 0
	Grid(3,1) = 13
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 17
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
'	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(0,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
'	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(3,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(4,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
'	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Makro Kodu : CEKI3

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public xCizgi, sayfaSatirSayisi, ToplamBrut, ToplamNet, ToplamBoy
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1<'.'", "", -1)
	MakaraSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	PaletSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "
	'ToplamStr1 = "Gross : "& Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_1)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(4,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(8,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(9,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"

	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 22
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 54
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 11
	Grid(8,1) = 11
	Grid(9,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(4,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(8,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(9,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"


	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 80, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub
