	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1<'.'", "", -1)
	MakaraSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	PaletSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "
	'ToplamStr1 = "Gross : "& Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
	toplamust = pe1.GetTop
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_1)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(4,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(8,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(9,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 22
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 54
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 11
	Grid(8,1) = 11
	Grid(9,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(4,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(8,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(9,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 80, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
' res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(3,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(4,0) = "_QTYOFPAL"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
'	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(3,1) = 115
	Grid(4,1) = 0
	Grid(5,1) = 11
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
'	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(4,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public xCizgi, sayfaSatirSayisi, ToplamBrut, ToplamNet, ToplamBoy
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1<'.'", "", -1)
	MakaraSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	PaletSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "
	'ToplamStr1 = "Gross : "& Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
	toplamust = pe1.GetTop
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_1)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Call GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, toplamust)

End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(2,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(3,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(4,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(8,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(9,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 20
	Grid(1,1) = 22
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 56
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 11
	Grid(8,1) = 11
	Grid(9,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "MKR NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "SERÝ NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(4,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(8,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(9,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub GenelToplamYazdir(pe1, satirPos)
	Set S66TS = Doc.Select2("d33fcff4", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if Left(S66TS.KOD(i), 2) = "ZR" Then
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "SWA"
		Else
			S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i) = "NONSWA"
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER+PACKNO_1")
	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S66TS.PACKNO_1(i)) <> "" Then
			S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) = S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i) + 25
		End if
	Next
	S66TS.GroupBy("LOTNUMBER")
	S66TS.Sort("<LOTNUMBER")

	For i = 1 to S66TS.GetRowCount()
		Str1 = trim(S66TS.LOTNUMBER(i)) & " = " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.SF_MIKTAR(i), 12, 0) &"m, " & Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.NETAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) & ", " & _
					Doc.NumFormat(S66TS.BRUTAGIRLIK(i), 12, 0) 
res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",6)

res = pe1.Write(satirPos + (i - 1) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 80, 5, 100, Str1)
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if

	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & S66T.GetRowCount() & " pallets"
	'ToplamStr2 = "Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
  ToplamStr2 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"


res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr2)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

'	Grid(0,0) = "OALLOC_SIPNO"
'	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(0,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(1,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(2,0) = "_QTYOFPAL"
	Grid(3,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(4,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
'	Grid(8,0) = "NETAGIRLIK"
'	Grid(9,0) = "BRUTAGIRLIK"
	
'	Grid(0,1) = 18
'	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(0,1) = 20
'	Grid(3,1) = 66
	Grid(1,1) = 139
	Grid(2,1) = 0
	Grid(3,1) = 11
	Grid(4,1) = 12
	Grid(5,1) = 12
'	Grid(8,1) = 12
'	Grid(9,1) = 12
	
'	Grid(0,2) = "ATOM ORDER NO"
'	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(0,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(2,2) = "QTY OF PALLETS"
	Grid(3,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(4,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"
'	Grid(8,2)	 = "NET WEIGHT (kg)"
'	Grid(9,2)	 = "GROSS WEIGHT (kg)"	

'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
'	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "NC"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "N"
'	Grid(9,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi = STOK66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(240,240,240))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
'	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> STOK66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&STOK66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = STOK66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + STOK66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + STOK66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = STOK66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = STOK66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(STOK66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = STOK66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = STOK66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				stokkodu = STOK66T.KOD(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,150))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)

	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	PaletSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "
	'ToplamStr1 = "Gross : "& Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_1)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(1,0) = "PACKNO_1"

	Grid(3,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(4,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(5,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(6,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"

'	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(0,1) = 22
	Grid(1,1) = 18
	Grid(2,1) = 96
	Grid(3,1) = 12
	Grid(4,1) = 12
	Grid(5,1) = 11
	Grid(6,1) = 11
	Grid(7,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(3,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(4,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(5,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(6,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(7,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
'	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"


	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Public ustmargin, solmargin, sagMargin, satirYuksekligi, sirano
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, AraToplam, Grid, satirSonu, satirBaslangic

Sub PrintForm()
		
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3

	Redim xCizgi(0)

	Ustmargin = 2 * satirYuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi

	solmargin = 6
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	satirpozr = 0

	sayfaSatirsayisi = 30
	sirano = 0
	sayfaSatirPozr = UstMargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi
	CKSN23T.SafePack

	satirSayisi = CKSN23T.GetRecCount
	Call Alanlar()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63
	SatirSonu = 260
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(Firma))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 6, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "K A R Þ I L I K S I Z / Ý A D E   Ç E K   G Ý R Ý Þ   B O R D R O S U")

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	CHKodu = CKSN23E.GIRISCODE
	Unvan1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", CHKodu, "")
	Unvan2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", CHKodu, "")
	Adres2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres3 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", CHKodu, "")
	VergiDairesi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", CHKodu, "")
	VergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", CHKodu, "")

	BBasla = 30
	KutuEn = 100
	res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 1, 5, KutuEn, CHKodu)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, "Vergi Dairesi : " & VergiDairesi & " Vergi No : " & VergiNo)

	res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, solMargin, pe1.GetBottom - BBasla + 2, KutuEn + 2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "TARÝH")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN23E.TARIH))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & trim(CKSN23E.EVRAKNO))

	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1)
		Baslik = Grid(i, 2)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 3 * satirYuksekligi, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi)) = sol - 1
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi) + 1)
	Next
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(CKSN23T.E_CKSNNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i, 0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "_BANKASUBE" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN23T.E_BANKA(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN23T.E_SUBE(satirNo))
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SEHIR" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",CKSN23T.E_SEHIR(satirNo),-1)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_CEKHESAPNO" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN23T.E_OREVRAKNO(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN23T.E_HESAPNO(satirNo))
		else
			Degisken = CKSN23T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi, SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i, 6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(Degisken, 18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i, 4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		if degiskenAdi = "E_OR_TUTAR" then
			solTutar = sol
			GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_OR_KUR" then
			solPB = sol
			GenPB = SutunGenisligi
		end if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	satirUst = satirBaslangic -  4 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))
	res = pe1.box(satirUst, SolMargin, satirSonu - satirUst, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 3
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirUst, LineX, satirSonu - satirUst, 0)
	Next

	sBAsla = satirSonu + satirYuksekligi
	res = pe1.line(sBAsla, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	ToplamTutar = CKSN23E.OR_TOPLAMTUTAR

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 30, ": "& CKSN23T.GetRecCount)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 8, 2, ":")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(6,6)))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	PB = CKSN23T.E_OR_KUR(1)
 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, PB)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN23E.ORTALAMARVALOR))

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(ToplamTutar)
	if trim(PB) = trim(Doc.DefaultPB) then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "YALNIZ " & Yalniz & Doc.DefaultPB & " hesabýnýza alacak kaydedilmiþtir.")
	end if

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "YETKÝLÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 5, 52, "DÜZENLEYEN")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	alt = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 4 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "LÜTFEN FAKSLAYINIZ")
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solmargin + 139, 5, 52, "ÖDEMEYÝ EKSÝKSÝZ")
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALDIM")
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "KAÞE - ÝMZA")

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	res = pe1.line(alt, solMargin + 1, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 0, 40)
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41, 173, 10, 25, i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "E_CKSNNO"
	Grid(1, 0) = "E_KESIDECI"
	Grid(2, 0) = "_BANKASUBE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "_SEHIR"
	Grid(4, 0) = "_CEKHESAPNO"
	Grid(5, 0) = "E_RVADE"
	Grid(6, 0) = "E_OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(7, 0) = "E_OR_KUR"

	Grid(0, 1) = 12
	Grid(1, 1) = 37
	Grid(2, 1) = 43
	Grid(3, 1) = 21
	Grid(4, 1) = 32.5
	Grid(5, 1) = 17
	Grid(6, 1) = 26
	Grid(7, 1) = 6

	Grid(0, 2) = "ÇEK NO"
	Grid(1, 2) = "KEÞÝDECÝ"
	Grid(2, 2) = "BANKA / ÞUBE"
	Grid(3, 2) = "ÞEHÝR"
	Grid(4, 2) = "BANKA ÇEK / HESAP NO"
	Grid(5, 2) = "VADE TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(6, 2) = "TUTARI"
	Grid(7, 2) = ""

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"
	Grid(5, 4) = "D"
	Grid(6, 4) = "N"
	Grid(7, 4) = "C"
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i, 0)
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			ondalik = CKSN23T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i, 6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(6, 6) = 2
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	for i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr, solMargin + 136, 5, 20, "SAYFA")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, S66T
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 40
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 54
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 35
	siraNo = 0
	ToplamBrut = 0
	ToplamBoy = 0
	ToplamNet = 0

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ceki Listesi" & trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO), sayfaboyu,SayfaEni,"")
	STOK66T.SafePack()
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("SSWWW", "STOK66T", "", "", -1)
	S66T.Sort("KOD+ALLOC_SIPNO")
	satirSayisi = S66T.GetRecCount()
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(200,200,200))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, satirBaslangic - UstMargin - 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	sol = solmargin
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 11, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		if Grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			SolUzunluk = sol
			GenUzunluk = SutunGenisligi
		End if
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol
		ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)-1)

	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

	res = pe1.setalign("center")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)
	carikod = STOK66E.MUSTERIKODU
	cariad = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",carikod,"")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - 5 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin, 7, sagMargin - solMargin, "PACKING LIST")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 1, 20, 50, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, solmargin+1, 5, 120, cariad)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, solmargin+1, 5, 120, trim(STOK66E.EVRAKNO))


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin - 6 * satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "01.01.2008 755 F 02 Rev 2")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 25, sagMargin - 100, 5, 100, "WAREHOUSE  : " & trim(STOK66E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, sagMargin - 20, 5, 20, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK66E.TARIH))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sipno = S66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
	StokKodu = S66T.KOD(satirNo)
	PaletNo = S66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo)
'	if satirNo > 1 and satirNo <> S66T.GetRowCount() Then
	if satirNo > 1 Then
		EskiSipStok = S66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo-1)&S66T.KOD(satirNo-1)
		EskiPaletNo = S66T.PACKNO_1(satirNo-1)
		if (trim(PaletNo) = "" and (sipno & StokKodu) <> EskiSipStok) or _
			(trim(PaletNo) <> "" and PaletNo <> EskiPaletNo) Then
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End if
	End if
	Degisken = ""
	if siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()	
		siraNo = 0
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamNet = ToplamNet + S66T.NETAGIRLIK(satirNo)
	ToplamBoy = ToplamBoy + S66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")						
	sol = solMargin + 1

	SeriNo = S66T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	LotNo = S66T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	if InStr(1, LotNo, "/") > 0 Then
		tire = Instr(1, SeriNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			Alt = Left(SeriNo, tire - 1)
			Ust = Mid(SeriNo, tire + 1)
		Else
			Alt = ""
			ust = ""
		End if
	Else
		tire = Instr(1, LotNo, "-")
		if tire > 0 Then
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(Mid(LotNo, tire + 1)))
		Else
			MakaraBoyu = Doc.CDbl(trim(LotNo))
		End if
		MakaraSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(S66T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo), MakaraBoyu))
	End if
	stokkodu = S66T.KOD(satirNo)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		if Left(degiskenadi, 1) <> "_" then
			Degisken = S66T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			if degiskenAdi = "_MSIPNO" Then
				sipno = S66T.OALLOC_SIPNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO", sipno,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_GRUP9" Then
				Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,"")
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFPAL" Then
				Degisken = 1
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_QTYOFRE" Then
				Degisken = MakaraSayisi
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_REELLENGTH" Then
				Degisken = MakaraBoyu
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_INNER" Then
				Degisken = Alt
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_OUTER" Then
				Degisken = Ust
			Elseif degiskenAdi = "_STD" Then
				Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "STANDARD", 0)
			End if
		End if
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			degisken = doc.numformat(degisken, 20, Ondalik)				
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		Elseif Grid(i,4) = "NC" then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If
		if DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,0))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
			res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 1, Sol - 1, satirYuksekligi + 1, sutunGenisligi)
			res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
			res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
		Else
			res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	sonSatir = siraNo
End Sub
Sub Print_form_Arasayfasonu(pe1)
	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Box(ustMargin, solmargin, EnAlt - UstMargin, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	
	For i = 0 to uBound(xCizgi) - 1
		res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, xCizgi(i), EnAlt - UstMargin, 0)
	Next
	For i = 1 to sonSatir
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic + (i-1) * satiryuksekligi - 1, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	next

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1<'.'", "", -1)
	MakaraSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	Set S66T = Doc.Select2("sdfsd", "STOK66T", "PACKNO_1>'.'", "", -1)
	S66T.GroupBy("PACKNO_1")
	PaletSayisi = S66T.GetRowCount()
	ToplamBrut = ToplamBrut + S66T.GetRowCount() * 25

	'ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets, " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr = "Total : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBoy, 12, 0) & " m, " & MakaraSayisi & " drums, " & PaletSayisi & " pallets "
	'ToplamStr1 = "Gross : "& Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"
	ToplamStr1 = "Net : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,12,0) & " kg, Gross : " & Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,12,0) & " kg"

	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr)
	res = pe1.Write(EnAlt + satirYuksekligi+5, solMargin, 7, 100, ToplamStr1)
	
res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 7, 150, STOK66E.NOTES_4)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "_STD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MSIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(4,0) = "_GRUP9"
	Grid(5,0) = "_QTYOFRE"
	Grid(6,0) = "_REELLENGTH"	
	Grid(7,0) = "_INNER"
	Grid(8,0) = "_OUTER"
	Grid(9,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"

	
	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 24
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 58
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 12
	Grid(7,1) = 11
	Grid(8,1) = 11
	Grid(9,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "STANDARD"
	Grid(1,2) = "CUSTOMER ORDER NO"
	Grid(2,2) = "DRUM NO"
	Grid(3,2) = "PALLET NO"
	Grid(4,2) = "TYPE & CROSS SECTION (mm2) DESCRIPTION"
	Grid(5,2)	 = "QTY OF REELS"
	Grid(6,2)	 = "REEL LENGTH"
	Grid(7,2) = "INNER END"
	Grid(8,2) = "OUTER END"
	Grid(9,2)	 = "LENGTH (m)"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "NC"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"


	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = S66T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik				
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Page  : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEURTutar = 0
	ToplamEURIskonto	= 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 25
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, top, sipno, XX_SATIR

Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	sayfaBoyu = 280
	sayfaEni = 215
	SolMargin = 18
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 20
	XX_SATIR = 4.3
	Ustmargin = 28
	AltMargin = 10
	satirbaslangic=117
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	top = 0
	sipno = ""
	satirsonu=satirbaslangic+95
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	pe1. ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	satiryuksekligi = 25.4 / 6
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "SevkIrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK61T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

'	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11, 5, 6, 35, chvergidairesi)
'	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11 ,55, 6, 35, chvergino)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR , 153, 6, 35, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR * 2, 153, 6, 35, sevktarih)
	sipno = STOK61T.SIPNO(1)
	siptrh = doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.getDbFieldvalue("STOK40E", "TARIH", sipno,""))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 110, 6, 30, sipno)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 155, 6, 65, siptrh)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sipno = STOK61T.SIPNO(1)
		mik = STOK61T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
		top = top + mik
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic 
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satirYuksekligi
			End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK61T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
	Not1=STOK60E.NotES_1
	Not2=STOK60E.NotES_2
	Not3=STOK60E.NotES_3
	Not4=STOK60E.NotES_4
	nak=STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	plaka=STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

' ZZZ *************

'	sonsatir = pe1.GetTop()+satiryuksekligi*2
	sonsatir = 204

	res = pe1.write(sonsatir, 30, 6, 100, Not1)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR , 30, 6, 100, Not2)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 2, 30, 6, 100, Not3)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 3, 30, 6, 100, Not4)
	sons=238
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR,150, 6, 95, nak)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 5, 150, 6, 60, plaka)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 28
	Grid(4,1) = 30

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,5) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK61T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

	SKd = " "
	ASURE=0
	DSURE=0
	USURE=0
	HAd=" "
	
	bb=4*4.3
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
  res = pe1.Open(0,"Günlük Makine Çalýþma Formu",297,210,"")
	
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	Satirsayisi = LISTET2.GetRecCount()	 

	For I=1 To Satirsayisi	
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
		Fark = Doc.DTDTDif1(LISTET2.RECTARIH1(i), LISTET2.RECTIME1(i), LISTET2.RECTARIH2(i), LISTET2.RECTIME2(i))
		If trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "A" Then
			ASURE =  ASURE + Fark
		ElseIf trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "D" Then
			DSURE = DSURE+ Fark
		ElseIf trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "U" Then
			USURE = USURE+ Fark
		End If
		satirno=satirno+1
		Fark = 0
	Next
		Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)

End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	If satirno = 22 Then
		Call sayfasonu(pe1)
		res=pe1.pagebreak
		satirno=1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	'	satirbaslangic=56 
	End If
	
	satirpozr= ust+satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 7
	
	fisno = LISTET2.EVRAKNO(i)
	mpsno=LISTET2.MPSNO(i)
	urunkodu=LISTET2.STOK_CODE(i)
	urunadi=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",urunkodu,"")	
	operasyon=LISTET2.OPERASYON(i)
	miktar=LISTET2.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	baszaman=LISTET2.RECTIME1(i)
	bitzaman=LISTET2.RECTIME2(i)
	nedenkodu=LISTET2.DURMA_SEBEBI(i)
	If trim(nedenkodu)<>"" Then
		dneden = Doc.GetGecoValue("DURMAS", "AD", nedenkodu, -1)
	End If

	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+1,4,10,Trim(fisno))
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+12,4,14,Trim(mpsno))
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+26,4,30,Trim(urunadi))	
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+76,4,20,Trim(operasyon))
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
'	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+93,4,18,doc.numformat(miktar,18,0))
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+93,4,20,miktar)

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+116,4,20,Trim(baszaman))	
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+131,4,30,Trim(bitzaman))
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,yan+144,4,30,dneden)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB39T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB39T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISEGIRISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					

					'If DegiskenAdi = "SIGORTASICILNO" then 
									
						'Uzunluk = Len(trim(Degisken))
						'For j = 1 to Uzunluk
							'DegiskenChar = mid(trim(Degisken),j,1)
							'res = pe1.write(satirpozr,sol + j*5.1 , satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, DegiskenChar)
						'Next
					'End if	

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(1,0) = "BABA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "DOGUM_TARIHI"
	Grid(3,0) = "CINSIYET"
	Grid(4,0) = "EK1GOREVKODU"
	Grid(5,0) = "ISEGIRISTARIHI"
	Grid(6,0) = "EK1SGKK"
	Grid(7,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"

	Grid(0,1) = 50
	Grid(1,1) = 28
	Grid(2,1) = 24
	Grid(3,1) = 19
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 19
	Grid(7,1) = 74

	Grid(0,2) = "ADI SOYADI         (4)"
	Grid(1,2) = "BABA   (5)"
	Grid(2,2) = "DOÐUM TARÝHÝ (6)"
	Grid(3,2) = "CÝNSÝYETÝ E/K (7)"
	Grid(4,2) = "GÖREV KODU (8)"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÝÞE GÝRÝÞ TARÝHÝ(9)"
	Grid(6,2) = "SOS.GÜV KODU(10)"
	Grid(7,2) = "SÝCÝL NO (11)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "D"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi, satiryuksekligi2

Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 25
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 70
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB40T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISTENCIKISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 45
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 52
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 20 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB08T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	'Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(PERSB08T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 52,10,10,10,"")
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
			If sirano > 19 Then
				'Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			End if
	'			If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
	'			'Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	'			siraNo = 1
	'			res = pe1.PageBreak()
	'			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	'			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	'		End if
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Tahoma", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 3
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(PERSB08T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,satirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS"  Then
			   Degisken = satirNo
			Else 
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If
		If DegiskenAdi = "PEGK" then
			res = pe1.setalign("right")
			degisken = doc.NumFormat(degisken,10,2)
		End if
		If DegiskenAdi = "PEGS" then
			sol = solmargin + 2
			res = pe1.setalign("Center")
			degisken = doc.NumFormat(degisken,10,0)
		End if
		If DegiskenAdi = "_NEDEN" then
			Abc = PERSB08T.EGBN(satirno)
			Degisken = doc.GetGecoValue("|BORSSKEG","AD",Abc,-1)
			degisken = trim(degisken)
		End if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(3,0) = "PEGK"
	Grid(4,0) = "EBGS"
	Grid(5,0) = "EGBN"
	Grid(6,0) = "_NEDEN"
	Grid(7,0) = "DEGERLENDIRMESONUCU"

	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 29
	Grid(2,1) = 39
	Grid(3,1) = 27
	Grid(4,1) = 19
	Grid(5,1) = 8
	Grid(6,1) = 25
	Grid(7,1) = 15

	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 0
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 181
	satirSonu = altmargin-50
	satiryuksekligi1=7.4

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Vizite Kaðýdý", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	satirSayisi = PERSB06.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirSayisi = PERSB06T.GetRecCount()
	for i = 1 to satirSayisi
		Call satirYazdir(pe1, i)
	Next		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, satirNo)
res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
	
	if pe1.GetBottom() > satirSonu then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	else
		if satirNo = 1 then
			satirPozr = satirBaslangic
		else
		
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		end if
	end if
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 8)
	
	yil=PERSB06T.PRM_YIL(satirNo)
	ay=PERSB06T.PRM_AY(satirNo)
	gunsayisi=PERSB06T.PRM_ODEMEGUNSAYISI(satirNo)
	rakam=PERSB06T.PRM_UCRETI(satirNo)
	yazi=PERSB06T.PRM_UCRETI_YAZIYLA(satirNo)
	ekodeme1=PERSB06T.PRM_EKODEMELER1(satirNo)
	ekodeme2=PERSB06T.PRM_EKODEMELER2(satirNo)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,40,yil)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+14,satiryuksekligi,40,ay)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+24,satiryuksekligi,40,gunsayisi)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+41,satiryuksekligi,40,rakam)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+63,satiryuksekligi,80,yazi)	
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+121,satiryuksekligi,40,ekodeme1)
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+153,satiryuksekligi,40,ekodeme2)
		


End Sub
