Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 0
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4.7
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 152
	satirSonu = altmargin-65
	satiryuksekligi1=7.4

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "ÝþYeri Bildirgesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB07.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirSayisi = PERSB07T.GetRecCount()
	for i = 1 to satirSayisi
		Call satirYazdir(pe1, i)
	Next		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, satirNo)
res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
	
	if pe1.GetBottom() > satirSonu then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	else
		if satirNo = 1 then
			satirPozr = satirBaslangic
		else
		
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		end if
	end if
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 8)
	
	yil=PERSB07T.PRM_YIL(satirNo)
	ay=PERSB07T.PRM_AY(satirNo)
	gunsayisi=PERSB07T.PRM_ODEMEGUNSAYISI(satirNo)
	
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,40,satirNo)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+9,satiryuksekligi,40,yil)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+69,satiryuksekligi,40,ay)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+129,satiryuksekligi,40,gunsayisi)
	

End Sub

Dim Doc1, d7LB
Sub PrintForm()
	Call PrintLabel()
End Sub
Sub PrintLabel()
'	if Doc.GetDocType <> "STOKFR2" and Doc.GetDocType <> "TRACK25" Then
'		if Doc.Save_Voucher <> 0 then
'			Exit Sub
'		End if
'	End if

MSGBOX "XX"
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
	Set d7LB = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")

	if Doc.GetDocType = "STOK20" Then
		Call STOK20_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK68" Then
		Call STOK68_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		Call STOK60_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK25" or Doc.GetDocType = "STOKFR2" or Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK25" Then
		Call STOK25_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29" or Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29I" Then
		Call STOK29_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK36" Then
		Call STOK36_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK19" Then
		Call STOK19_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK26" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK26T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK63" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK63T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK61" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK61T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK24" Then
		Call STOK24_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "MMPS10" Then
		Call MMPS10_Print()
	End if

	Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "D7KIDSLB", ""
End Sub
Sub STOK20_Print()
	STOK20T.SafePack()
'	Set S20T = Doc.Select2("XXXSTOK20T", "STOK20T", "", "", -1)
'	Hata = ""
'	S20T.GroupBy2("MPSNO")
'	For i = 1 to S20T.GetRowCount()
'		Statu = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E", "STATUS", S20T.MPSNO(i), "")
'
'		if (TRIM(S20T.MPSNO(i))<>"") AND (trim(Statu) <> "R") Then
'			Hata = Hata & "MPS No : " & trim(S20T.MPSNO(i)) & vbcrlf
'		End if
'	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" Then
'		k = Doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & "R statüsünde olmayan MPS 'lere etiket veremezsiniz.", "Hata !", MB_OK+MB_ICONWARNING)
'		Exit Sub
'	End if
'	Doc.DeleteTableObject "XXXSTOK20T"

'	S20T.GroupBy2("SERINO")
	satir = STOK20T.GetCurrentRow()
	if trim(STOK20T.SERINO(satir)) = "" Then STOK20T.SERINO(satir) = Doc.Sayac0danAl("SERINO")
	Set S20T = Doc.Select2("XXXSTOK20T", "STOK20T", "", "", -1)

	for i = satir to satir
'	for i = 1 to S20T.GetRowCount()
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Etiket Bilgileri Güncelleniyor : " & i & " / " & S20T.GetRowCount()
		Redim IDArray(1,0)
		StokKodu = S20T.KOD(i)
		BaskiSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("d7KIDSLB", "BASKISAYISI", Doc.LeftJustify(S20T.SERINO(i), 30),"") 
		if trim(BaskiSayisi) > 0 Then
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "BASKISAYISI", BaskiSayisi + 1)
			S20T.SF_VRI_VR_C(i) = "E"
		End if
		CHKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10TM", "MUSTERIKODU", S20T.MPSNO(i) & S20T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i),"EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
		if trim(CHKodu) = "" Then CHKodu = GetMusteriCHKodu(StokKodu)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "CH_MUSTERI", CHKodu)
		'UCHKodu = "99999"
		'Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "CH_TEDARIKCI", UCHKodu)
'		SevkAdresKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10TM", "SHIPTOCODE", S20T.MPSNO(i) & S20T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i),"EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "REFTEXT01", SevkAdresKodu)
		EtiketFormu = GetEtiketFormKodu(S20T.KOD(i), CHKodu, "")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "FORMKODU", EtiketFormu)
		S20T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i) = Doc.RightJustify(trim(EtiketFormu),10)
'		solSag = uCase(Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK00", "TEXT_TECH_2", S20T.KOD(i), ""))
'		if Instr(1, solSag, "SAG") > 0 or Instr(1, solSag, "SAÐ") > 0 Then
'			S20T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i) = Doc.RightJustify("TURUNCU",10)
'			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "GK_1", "TURUNCU")
'		Else
'			S20T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i) = Doc.RightJustify("BEYAZ",10)
'			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "GK_1", "BEYAZ")
'		End if
		AmbalajKodu = GetKasaKodu(StokKodu, CHKodu, SevkAdresKodu)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "AMBALAJKODU", AmbalajKodu)

		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "MPSNO", S20T.MPSNO(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "MPSTM_TRNUM", S20T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SF_MIKTAR", S20T.SF_MIKTAR(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SF_UNIT", S20T.SF_SF_UNIT(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "VRI_VR_R1", S20T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "VRI_VR_R2", S20T.SF_VRI_VR_R2(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "VRI_VR_R3", S20T.SF_VRI_VR_R3(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "STATU", "")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "EVRAKTYPE", "MG")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "EVRAKNO", STOK20E.EVRAKNO)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "REFTARIH1", STOK20E.TARIH)
		Call EtiketBilgileriniYaz(S20T.KOD(i), S20T.SERINO(i), S20T.LOTNUMBER(i), IDArray)
	Next
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYYSTOK20T=STOK20T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S20T1 = Doc.GetTableObject("YYYSTOK20T")
	S20T1.CopyTable(S20T)

	S20T.GroupBy("SF_VRI_NUM2+SF_VRI_NUM1")
	For i = 1 to S20T.GetRowCount()
		QStr = "SF_VRI_NUM1='"+S20T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i)+"'&SF_VRI_NUM2='"+S20T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i)+"'" ' "'&SF_VRI_VR_C<>'E'"
		Set PSTOK20T = Doc.Select2("PSTOK20T", "YYYSTOK20T", QStr, "", -1)
		EtiketFormu = S20T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i)
		if trim(EtiketFormu) <> "" and PSTOK20T.GetRowCount > 0 Then
			par1="PSTOK20T"
			Doc.RunMacro1 "PFRM7S." & trim(EtiketFormu),"PrintLabel1", par1
			Call EtiketleriGuncelle_STOK20(PSTOK20T)
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "XXXSTOK20T"
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "YYYSTOK20T"
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "PSTOK20T"
End Sub
Sub STOK68_Print()
	STOK68T.SafePack()
	Set S68T = Doc.Select2("XXXSTOK68T", "STOK68T", "", "", -1)
	S68T.GroupBy2("SERINO")
	for i = 1 to S68T.GetRowCount()
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Etiket Bilgileri Güncelleniyor : " & i & " / " & S68T.GetRowCount()
		Redim IDArray(1,0)
		StokKodu = S68T.KOD(i)
		BaskiSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("d7KIDSLB", "BASKISAYISI", Doc.LeftJustify(S68T.SERINO(i), 30),"") 
		if trim(BaskiSayisi) > 0 Then
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "BASKISAYISI", BaskiSayisi + 1)
			S68T.SF_VRI_VR_C(i) = "E"
		End if
		if trim(S68T.MUSTERI_CH_KODU(i)) <> "" Then
			CHKodu = S68T.MUSTERI_CH_KODU(i)
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "EVRAKTYPE", "MG")
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "APPKODU", "STOK20")
		Else
			UCHKodu = STOK68E.CHCODE
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "EVRAKTYPE", "FG")
			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "APPKODU", "STOK68")
		End if
		if trim(CHKodu) <> "" Then S68T.SF_VRI_VR_R3(i) = CHKodu
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "CH_MUSTERI", CHKodu)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "CH_TEDARIKCI", UCHKodu)
'		SevkAdresKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10TM", "SHIPTOCODE", S68T.MPSNO(i) & S68T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i),"EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "REFTEXT01", SevkAdresKodu)

		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "FORMKODU", EtiketFormu)
		S68T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i) = Doc.RightJustify(trim(EtiketFormu),10)
'		solSag = uCase(Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK00", "TEXT_TECH_2", S68T.KOD(i), ""))

'			S68T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i) = Doc.RightJustify("TURUNCU",10)
'			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "GK_1", "TURUNCU")
'		Else
'			S68T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i) = Doc.RightJustify("BEYAZ",10)
'			Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "GK_1", "BEYAZ")
'		End if
		AmbalajKodu = GetKasaKodu(StokKodu, CHKodu, SevkAdresKodu)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "AMBALAJKODU", AmbalajKodu)

		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "MPSNO", S68T.MPSNO(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "MPSTM_TRNUM", S68T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SF_MIKTAR", S68T.SF_MIKTAR(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SF_UNIT", S68T.SF_SF_UNIT(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "STATU", "")
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "EVRAKNO", STOK68E.EVRAKNO)
'		S68T.EVRAKNO(i) = STOK68E.XIRSALIYENO
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "REFTARIH1", STOK68E.TARIH)
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SIPARISNO_46", S68T.SIPNO(i))
		Call IDArrayAdd(IDArray, "SIPARTNO_46", S68T.SIPARTNO(i))

		Call EtiketBilgileriniYaz(S68T.KOD(i), S68T.SERINO(i), S68T.LOTNUMBER(i), IDArray)
	Next
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYYSTOK68T=STOK68T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S68T1 = Doc.GetTableObject("YYYSTOK68T")
	S68T1.CopyTable(S68T)

	S68T.GroupBy("SF_VRI_NUM2+SF_VRI_NUM1")
	For i = 1 to S68T.GetRowCount()
'		QStr = "SF_VRI_NUM1='"+S68T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i)+"'&SF_VRI_NUM2='"+S68T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i)+"'&SF_VRI_VR_C<>'E'"
		QStr = "SF_VRI_NUM1='"+S68T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i)+"'&SF_VRI_NUM2='"+S68T.SF_VRI_NUM2(i)+"'"

		Set PSTOK68T = Doc.Select2("PSTOK68T", "YYYSTOK68T", QStr, "", -1)
		EtiketFormu = S68T.SF_VRI_NUM1(i)

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : ETIKET-05
Hangi Tablo için : STOK40
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : MARKET BARKOD ETÝKETÝ
Kod : 
Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, EtiketSol, EtiketEni
Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 150
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 0
	EtiketBoyu = 34
	EtiketEni = 32
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 2
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 1
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 3
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 4
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	STOK40T.SafePack
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	EskiKod = ""
	For i = 1 to STOK40T.GetRecCount()
		if trim(STOK40T.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			if trim(STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)) = "AD" or trim(STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)) = "Adet" Then
				AyniEtikettenKacTane = STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				AyniEtikettenKacTane = 2
			End if
			if STOK40T.KOD(i) <> EskiKod and i > 1 Then
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				EtiketNo = 0
			End if
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
					EtiketSol = SolMargin
				else
					EtiketSol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
				end if	
				if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
		EskiKod = STOK40T.KOD(i)
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
	stokkodu=STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
	stokadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirNo)
	id=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","EANKODU",stokkodu,"")
    
	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res=pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)
	
	res=pe1.Write(ust, EtiketSol , 7, 55, stokkodu)		
	res=pe1.Write(ust +26, EtiketSol , 7, 24, stokadi)		
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res=pe1.barcode(ust+5, EtiketSol , 21,24, "EAN128",trim(id),"")	
End Sub

	Next

Sub PrintLabel()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 150
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 0
	EtiketBoyu = 34
	EtiketEni = 32
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 2
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 1
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 3
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 4
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	STOK20T.SafePack
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	EskiKod = ""
	For i = 1 to STOK20T.GetRecCount()
		if trim(STOK20T.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			if trim(STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)) = "AD" or trim(STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)) = "Adet" Then
				AyniEtikettenKacTane = STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				AyniEtikettenKacTane = 2
			End if
			if STOK20T.KOD(i) <> EskiKod and i > 1 Then
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				EtiketNo = 0
			End if
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
					EtiketSol = SolMargin
				else
					EtiketSol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
				end if	
				if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
		EskiKod = STOK20T.KOD(i)
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	if Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK25" Then
		Set S25T = Doc.Select1("de34frt5454", "STOK25T", "EVRAKNO='" & STACK.SON_EVRAKNO & "'", "", -1)
		if S25T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Else
		Set S25T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK25T")
	End if

	SeriNo = S25T.NEWSERINO(1)

	if trim(SeriNo) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Barkod = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SeriNo), 30)


	EtiketFormKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("D7KIDSLB", "FORMKODU", Barkod, "")
 
	if trim(EtiketFormKodu) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Doc.RunMacro0 "PFRM7S." & EtiketFormKodu,"PrintLabel"
End Sub

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Sol, EtiketEni, D7LB
Sub PrintForm()
	Call PrintLabel()
End Sub
Sub PrintLabel()
	FormKodu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	SatirTipi = 1
	Set D7LB = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.ETIKET", "GetEtiketTable", FormKodu, SatirTipi)
	if D7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 96
	EtiketEni = 96
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	For i = 1 to D7LB.GetRecCount()
		EtiketAdedi = 1
		AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
		for k = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
			EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
			yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
			if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
				Sol = SolMargin
			else
				Sol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
			end if	
			if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Ust = Ustmargin					
			else
				Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
			end if
			Ust = Ustmargin
			Sol = SolMargin
			Call Etiket(pe1,i)
		Next
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1, satirNo)
	SeriNo = D7LB.SERINO(satirNo) 
MSGBOX SeriNo 
	EvrakNo = D7LB.EVRAKNO(satirNo)
	Tarih = D7LB.REFTARIH1(satirNo)
	StokKodu = D7LB.SKOD(satirNo) 
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,"")
	Miktar = D7LB.SF_BAKIYE(satirNo)
	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(Miktar)
	Miktar1 = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(Miktar,12,6) 
	Birim = D7LB.SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	LotNo = D7LB.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	TedarikciKodu = D7LB.CH_TEDARIKCI(satirNo)
	Tedarikci = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", TedarikciKodu, "")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.Box(3,3,90,93)
	res = pe1.Line(28,3,0,93) 
	res = pe1.Line(81,3,0,93) 
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.Picture(5,45,12,45,"\\Ilkeden\d7k\d7000\ATOM2.bmp",100)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(7,5,12,15,"Giriþ.T")
	res = pe1.write(7,21,12,32,": " & Doc.StrtoNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",14)
	res = pe1.Write(20,5,7,90,Trim(StokAdi))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",14)
	res = pe1.write(30,5,6,25,"Miktar")
	res = pe1.write(30,32,6,50,": " & miktar1 & " " & Trim(Birim))

	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.write(36,5,16,31,"Stok Kodu")
	res = pe1.write(36,32,15,63,": " & trim(StokKodu))

	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",10)
	if Doc.GetDocType = "STOK20" Then
		res = pe1.write(13,5,9,18,"Ürt.Fiþ No") 
		res = pe1.write(13,21,9,19,": "& trim(EvrakNo))
		res = pe1.write(42,5,16,31,"Lot No")
		res = pe1.write(42,32,9,63,": "& trim(LotNo))    
	Else
		res = pe1.write(13,5,9,18,"Ýrs. No") 
		res = pe1.write(13,21,9,19,": "& trim(EvrakNo))
		res = pe1.write(42,5,16,31,"Tedarikçi")
		res = pe1.write(42,32,9,63,": "& trim(Tedarikci))    
	End if
	res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",13)	
	res = pe1.write(54,5,6,25,"Seri No")
	res = pe1.NoPen()

	res = pe1.BarCode(54,32,20,50,"Code128",Trim(SeriNo),"") 
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	if trim(d7LB.CH_TEDARIKCI(satirNo)) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 5,5,26,"Ted. Lot. No")
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight(),5,63,": "& trim(D7LB.VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)))
	End if
	
	res = pe1.write(83,5,9,10,"Not: ") 
	res = pe1.write(83,12,9,83, notlar) 
	res = pe1.write(85,12,9,83, Notlar2) 
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.WriteBox(UstMargin + 40,SolMargin + 40,18,120,"COMMERCIAL INVOICE")

	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 9)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	chkodu=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,"")
	chadi2=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkodu,"")
	chadres1=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,"")
	chadres2=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,"")
	chadres3=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,"")
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,"")
	chvergino=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,"")
	
	sunvan=STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	sadres1=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_1
	sadres2=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2
	sadres3=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_3
	
	BolgeKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "BOLGEKODU", chkodu,"")
	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	ftno=STOK70E.EVRAKNO
	svktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.S60_RSEVKTARIH(1))
	irsPosNo = STOK70T.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(1)
	SiparisNo = Doc.getDBFieldValue("STOK60T","SIPNO",irsPosNo,"SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")

	res = pe1.NoPen()

		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 6 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 7 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="2" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin + 1
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sunvan)

		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)

		solAdres = solMargin + 1
		bBasla = UstMargin + 5 * satirYuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)
	end if
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

res = pe1.nopen()

	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	satir = satirBaslangic - 2 * satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 8)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		Else
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End if

		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi

	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(ST70.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If satirNo = ST70.GetRecCount() and sonSatir >= SatirSonu then
		Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
	Else
		If sonSatir >= AraSatirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'			Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	End if
'	Yenilot = ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
'	if EskiLot <> YeniLot or EskiLot = "" Then 
'		if FaturaGrupSayisi > 1 and EskiLot <> "" then
'			Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
'			AraToplam = 0
'			satirPozr = satirPozr  + 2*satirYuksekligi
'		end if
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
'		satirPozr = satirPozr  + 5* satirYuksekligi
'	end if
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 8)
	EskiLot = Yenilot
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	SiparisNo = ST70.SIPNO(satirno)
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT" then
			Tutar = ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirno)
			Miktar = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.Div(Tutar,Miktar) * 1000
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SIPNO" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_BAZ_LME" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"KAP_LME",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_LME_AYI" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"LME_DONEM",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
			Degisken = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) / 1000
		else
			Degisken = ST70.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	AraToplam = AraToplam + ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub 	Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
	Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		Toplam = Toplam + STOK70T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		ToplamUzunluk = ToplamUzunluk + STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next

'***********

	Toplam = Doc.Round(Toplam,2)
	Toplam1=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,18,2)	
	ToplamUzunluk1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUzunluk / 1000,18,3)	

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
'	CIF_FOB = Doc.getUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)
'	OdemeSekli = Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK40E","ODEMEKOSULLARI_1",SiparisNo,"")
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(Toplam,2) - Doc.Floor(Toplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Toplam) & " " &Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")
'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	IskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	if IskontoOrani = 0 then
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi + 2
	else
		dim IskontoNotu(3), xIskontoOrani(3)
		For j = 1 to 4
			if STOK70E.GetFieldValue("OR_ISKONTO" & j & "TOPLAMI",1) > 0 then
				xIskontoOrani(j-1) = STOK70E.GetFieldValue("DO_ISKONTO" & j & "_ORANI",1)
				IskontoSayisi = IskontoSayisi + 1
				IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_NOTE",j)
				if trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) = "" then
					IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.Round(xIskontoOrani(j-1),1) & "% DISCOUNT"
				end if
			end if
		Next
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + (IskontoSayisi + 2) * satirYuksekligi + 4
	end if
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	if IskontoOrani <> 0 then
		res = pe1.write(Baslangic - (IskontoSayisi + 1) * satirYuksekligi - 2, solMargin+50, 6,80, "TOPLAM/TOTAL " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Toplam1)
		For j = 1 to 4
			xIskontoOrani1 = xIskontoOrani(j-1)
			if xIskontoOrani1 > 0 then
				IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * xIskontoOrani1 / 100,2)
				IskontoTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoTutari,18,2)
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 6,130, trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoTutari1)
			end if
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
		ToplamIskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * IskontoOrani / 100,2)
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam - ToplamIskontoTutari
		IskontoluToplam1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	else
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam
		IskontoluToplam1= Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	End if

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)

	Grid(0,0) = "_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_BAZ_LME"
	Grid(2,0) = "_LME_AYI"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 21
	Grid(1,1) = 20
	Grid(2,1) = 18
	Grid(3,1) = 60
	Grid(4,1) = 30
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 22

	Grid(0,2) = "Order No"
	Grid(1,2) = "LME"
	Grid(2,2) = "LME Term"
	Grid(3,2) = "Type & Cross-Section"
	Grid(4,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(5,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & "/km)"
	Grid(6,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & ")"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	
	sol1 = SolMargin + 1
	for i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
		if Grid(i,0) = "OR_TUTAR" then
			GenTutar = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solTutar = Sol1			
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "PRICEUNIT" and solTutar > 0 then
			GenPB = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solPB = Sol1
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "OR_FIYAT" then
			GenFiyat = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1) - 2
			solFiyat = Sol1
		end if
		sol1 = sol1 + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			ondalik = ST70.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			if degisken = "OR_TUTAR" or degisken = "OR_FIYAT" then
				Ondalik = 2
			Elseif degisken = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				Ondalik = 3
			End if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	Grid(1,6) = 2
End Sub

Sub AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirPozr, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar-55, 6, 55, "ARA TOPLAM/SUB TOTAL " & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")	
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat(AraToplam,18,2))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Function KTA_Kontrol()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("KOD")

	for i = 1 to ST70T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = ST70T.KOD(i)
		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
	'	if AG_OG = 0 or trim(AG_OG) = "" then
	'		Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
	'	end if
	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
'		Hata = "Aþaðýdaki stok kartlarýnýn kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarý girilmemiþ (DLG170)" & vbcrlf & hata & _
'					vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."
'	end if
	KTA_Kontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SipTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	Set SipTable = ST70T
End Function
Function GrupSayisiBul(ST70)
	GrupSayisi = 0
	EskiGrup = ""
	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount
		if ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) <> EskiGrup then
			GrupSayisi = GrupSayisi + 1
			EskiGrup = ST70.LOTNUMBER(i)
		end if
	Next
	GrupSayisiBul = GrupSayisi
End Function
Function IskontoKontrol()
	for i = 1 to 4
		DagitilanIskonto = 0
		For j = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
			DagitilanIskonto = DagitilanIskonto + STOK70T.GetFieldValue("TL_TISKONTO_" & i, j)
		Next

		IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_TUTAR",i) * STOK70T.KUR(1),2)
		If IskontoTutari <> 0 and IskontoTutari <> DagitilanIskonto then
			Hata = Hata & "K.T.A. 'daki " & i & ". iskonto satýrlara daðýtýlmamýþ." & vbcrlf 
		End if
	Next
	IskontoKontrol = Hata
End Function
Sub HagemeyerNot(pe1, satirPozr)
	HNot = "The balance of this invoice has been assigned to Midt Factoring A/S, Vester Soegade 10, 1st Floor, " & _
			"DK-1601 Copenhagen, phone: +45 7021 1100, fax: +45 7021 1101, to whom payment can be made only. " & _
			"When due please transfer the amount to Danske Bank A/S, DK-1390 Copenhagen, SWIFT/BIC: DABADKKK, " & _
			"account No. 4788102135, IBAN: DK2830004788102135, stating invoice number and customer number." & vbcrlf & _
			"Objections, if any, to be made to Midt Factoring A/S without delay."
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, solMargin + 5, 15, sagMargin - solMargin - 5, HNot)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

		exit sub
	end if

	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	EskiLot = ""
	bbasla=0

'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

		Exit Sub
	End If

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(ST70.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If satirNo = ST70.GetRecCount() and sonSatir >= SatirSonu then
		Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
	Else
		If sonSatir >= AraSatirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'			Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	End if
'	Yenilot = ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
'	if EskiLot <> YeniLot or EskiLot = "" Then 
'		if FaturaGrupSayisi > 1 and EskiLot <> "" then
'			Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
'			AraToplam = 0
'			satirPozr = satirPozr  + 2*satirYuksekligi
'		end if
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
'		satirPozr = satirPozr  + 5* satirYuksekligi
'	end if
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 8)
	EskiLot = Yenilot
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	SiparisNo = ST70.SIPNO(satirno)
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT" then
			Tutar = ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirno)
			Miktar = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.Div(Tutar,Miktar) * 1000
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SIPNO" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_BAZ_LME" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"KAP_LME",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_LME_AYI" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"LME_DONEM",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
			Degisken = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) / 1000
		else
			Degisken = ST70.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	AraToplam = AraToplam + ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub 	Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
	Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		Toplam = Toplam + STOK70T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		ToplamUzunluk = ToplamUzunluk + STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next

'***********

	Toplam = Doc.Round(Toplam,2)
	Toplam1=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,18,2)	
	ToplamUzunluk1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUzunluk / 1000,18,3)	

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
'	CIF_FOB = Doc.getUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)
'	OdemeSekli = Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK40E","ODEMEKOSULLARI_1",SiparisNo,"")
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(Toplam,2) - Doc.Floor(Toplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Toplam) & " " &Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")
'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	IskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	if IskontoOrani = 0 then
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi + 2
	else
		dim IskontoNotu(3), xIskontoOrani(3)
		For j = 1 to 4
			if STOK70E.GetFieldValue("OR_ISKONTO" & j & "TOPLAMI",1) > 0 then
				xIskontoOrani(j-1) = STOK70E.GetFieldValue("DO_ISKONTO" & j & "_ORANI",1)
				IskontoSayisi = IskontoSayisi + 1
				IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_NOTE",j)
				if trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) = "" then
					IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.Round(xIskontoOrani(j-1),1) & "% DISCOUNT"
				end if
			end if
		Next
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + (IskontoSayisi + 2) * satirYuksekligi + 4
	end if
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	if IskontoOrani <> 0 then
		res = pe1.write(Baslangic - (IskontoSayisi + 1) * satirYuksekligi - 2, solMargin+50, 6,80, "TOPLAM/TOTAL " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Toplam1)
		For j = 1 to 4
			xIskontoOrani1 = xIskontoOrani(j-1)
			if xIskontoOrani1 > 0 then
				IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * xIskontoOrani1 / 100,2)
				IskontoTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoTutari,18,2)
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 6,130, trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoTutari1)
			end if
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
		ToplamIskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * IskontoOrani / 100,2)
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam - ToplamIskontoTutari
		IskontoluToplam1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	else
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam
		IskontoluToplam1= Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	End if
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(IskontoluToplam,2) - Doc.Floor(IskontoluToplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(IskontoluToplam1) &" " & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)
	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	SevkYeri = Doc.GetUDFValue("SP",SiparisNo,"SEVK",0)
	res = pe1.write(Baslangic, solMargin, 6,130, "TOPLAM/TOTAL " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar , 6, genTutar, IskontoluToplam1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)

	Sigorta = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"SIGORTA",0)
	if Navlun > 0 then
		if Sigorta = 0 then Sigorta = IskontoluToplam * 0.004

	FOBTutar = IskontoluToplam - Navlun - Sigorta
	if trim(STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)) <> "USD" then

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM UZUNLUK / TOTAL LENGTH")

	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,ToplamNet1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,"kg")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")

	Set Clist = Doc.Select2("dd3ftrgft", "STOK70T", "", "", -1)

		Clist.ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE(i)= Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK60T", "ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE", cList.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(i), "SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")
		Clist.ALLOC_EVRAKNO(i)= Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK60T", "ALLOC_EVRAKNO", cList.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(i), "SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")

	For i = 1 to Clist.GetRowCount()
		if Clist.ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE(i) = "CL" Then

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)

	Grid(0,0) = "_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_BAZ_LME"
	Grid(2,0) = "_LME_AYI"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 29
	Grid(1,1) = 17
	Grid(2,1) = 14
	Grid(3,1) = 72
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 22

	Grid(0,2) = "Order No"
	Grid(1,2) = "LME"
	Grid(2,2) = "LME Term"
	Grid(3,2) = "Type & Cross-Section"
	Grid(4,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(5,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & "/km)"
	Grid(6,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & ")"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	
	sol1 = SolMargin + 1
	for i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
		if Grid(i,0) = "OR_TUTAR" then
			GenTutar = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solTutar = Sol1			
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "PRICEUNIT" and solTutar > 0 then
			GenPB = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solPB = Sol1
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "OR_FIYAT" then
			GenFiyat = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1) - 2
			solFiyat = Sol1
		end if
		sol1 = sol1 + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			ondalik = ST70.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			if degisken = "OR_TUTAR" or degisken = "OR_FIYAT" then
				Ondalik = 2
			Elseif degisken = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				Ondalik = 3
			End if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	Grid(1,6) = 2
End Sub

Sub AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirPozr, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar-55, 6, 55, "ARA TOPLAM/SUB TOTAL " & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")	
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat(AraToplam,18,2))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Function KTA_Kontrol()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("KOD")

	for i = 1 to ST70T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = ST70T.KOD(i)
		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
	'	if AG_OG = 0 or trim(AG_OG) = "" then
	'		Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
	'	end if
	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
'		Hata = "Aþaðýdaki stok kartlarýnýn kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarý girilmemiþ (DLG170)" & vbcrlf & hata & _
'					vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."
'	end if
	KTA_Kontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SipTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	Set SipTable = ST70T
End Function
Function GrupSayisiBul(ST70)
	GrupSayisi = 0
	EskiGrup = ""
	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount
		if ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) <> EskiGrup then
			GrupSayisi = GrupSayisi + 1
			EskiGrup = ST70.LOTNUMBER(i)
		end if
	Next
	GrupSayisiBul = GrupSayisi
End Function
Function IskontoKontrol()
	for i = 1 to 4
		DagitilanIskonto = 0
		For j = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
			DagitilanIskonto = DagitilanIskonto + STOK70T.GetFieldValue("TL_TISKONTO_" & i, j)
		Next

		IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_TUTAR",i) * STOK70T.KUR(1),2)
		If IskontoTutari <> 0 and IskontoTutari <> DagitilanIskonto then
			Hata = Hata & "K.T.A. 'daki " & i & ". iskonto satýrlara daðýtýlmamýþ." & vbcrlf 
		End if
	Next
	IskontoKontrol = Hata
End Function

			"DK-1601 Copenhagen, phone: +45 7021 1100, fax: +45 7021 1101, to whom payment can be made only. " & _
			"When due please transfer the amount to Danske Bank A/S, DK-1390 Copenhagen, SWIFT/BIC: DABADKKK, " & _
			"account No. 4788102135, IBAN: DK2830004788102135, stating invoice number and customer number." & vbcrlf & _
			"Objections, if any, to be made to Midt Factoring A/S without delay."
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, solMargin + 5, 15, sagMargin - solMargin - 5, HNot)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

	y = doc.d7MsgBox("Lütfen, Listelemeden önce Eskalasyon iþlemi yapýldýðýný kontrol ediniz.","Dinamo",MB_OK)
	Hata = IskontoKontrol

	end if

		k = Doc.d7MsgBox(Hata,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	EskiLot = ""
	bbasla=0
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	AraToplam = 0	
	Toplam= 0
'	SolMargin= 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 74
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 20 * satirYuksekligi
	AraSatirSonu = satirBaslangic + 32 * satirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
'	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura",  SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
'	Set ST70 = Doc.getTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	ST70.CopyTable(S70)

'		StokKodu = ST70.KOD(i)
'		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
'		ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) = cStr(AG_OG)
'	Next
	Set ST70 = Doc.Select2("ssww", "STOK70T", "", "", -1)
	ST70.GroupBy("KOD+SIPNO+OR_FIYAT")
'	ST70.Sort("LOTNUMBER")

'	FaturaGrupSayisi = GrupSayisiBul(ST70)

	Call Alanlar()

	satirSayisi = ST70.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.Show()

		res = pe1.nopen()
        
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.WriteBox(UstMargin + 40,SolMargin + 40,18,120,"COMMERCIAL INVOICE")

	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 9)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	chkodu=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,"")
	chadi2=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkodu,"")
	chadres1=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,"")
	chadres2=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,"")
	chadres3=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,"")
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,"")
	chvergino=Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,"")
	
	sunvan=STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	sadres1=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_1
	sadres2=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2
	sadres3=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_3

	svktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.S60_RSEVKTARIH(1))
	irsPosNo = STOK70T.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(1)
	SiparisNo = Doc.getDBFieldValue("STOK60T","SIPNO",irsPosNo,"SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")

	res = pe1.NoPen()

		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 30, "DELIVERY ADRESS")
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 5 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 6 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 7 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="2" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin + 1
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sunvan)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="3" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 1
		bBasla = UstMargin + 5 * satirYuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

res = pe1.nopen()

	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	satir = satirBaslangic - 2 * satirYuksekligi

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		Else
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satir, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4, Baslik)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi

	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(ST70.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If satirNo = ST70.GetRecCount() and sonSatir >= SatirSonu then
		Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
	Else
		If sonSatir >= AraSatirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'			Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	End if
'	Yenilot = ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
'	if EskiLot <> YeniLot or EskiLot = "" Then 
'		if FaturaGrupSayisi > 1 and EskiLot <> "" then
'			Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
'			AraToplam = 0
'			satirPozr = satirPozr  + 2*satirYuksekligi
'		end if
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
'		satirPozr = satirPozr  + 5* satirYuksekligi
'	end if
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 8)
	EskiLot = Yenilot
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	SiparisNo = ST70.SIPNO(satirno)
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT" then
			Tutar = ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirno)
			Miktar = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.Div(Tutar,Miktar) * 1000
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SIPNO" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_BAZ_LME" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"KAP_LME",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_LME_AYI" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"LME_DONEM",0)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
			Degisken = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) / 1000
		else
			Degisken = ST70.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	AraToplam = AraToplam + ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub 	Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
	Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		Toplam = Toplam + STOK70T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		ToplamUzunluk = ToplamUzunluk + STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next

'***********

	Toplam = Doc.Round(Toplam,2)
	Toplam1=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,18,2)	
	ToplamUzunluk1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUzunluk / 1000,18,3)	

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
'	CIF_FOB = Doc.getUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)
'	OdemeSekli = Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK40E","ODEMEKOSULLARI_1",SiparisNo,"")
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(Toplam,2) - Doc.Floor(Toplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Toplam) & " " &Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")
'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	IskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	if IskontoOrani = 0 then
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi + 2
	else
		dim IskontoNotu(3), xIskontoOrani(3)
		For j = 1 to 4
			if STOK70E.GetFieldValue("OR_ISKONTO" & j & "TOPLAMI",1) > 0 then
				xIskontoOrani(j-1) = STOK70E.GetFieldValue("DO_ISKONTO" & j & "_ORANI",1)
				IskontoSayisi = IskontoSayisi + 1
				IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_NOTE",j)
				if trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) = "" then
					IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.Round(xIskontoOrani(j-1),1) & "% DISCOUNT"
				end if
			end if
		Next
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + (IskontoSayisi + 2) * satirYuksekligi + 4
	end if
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	if IskontoOrani <> 0 then
		res = pe1.write(Baslangic - (IskontoSayisi + 1) * satirYuksekligi - 2, solMargin+50, 6,80, "TOPLAM/TOTAL " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Toplam1)
		For j = 1 to 4
			xIskontoOrani1 = xIskontoOrani(j-1)
			if xIskontoOrani1 > 0 then
				IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * xIskontoOrani1 / 100,2)
				IskontoTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoTutari,18,2)
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 6,130, trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoTutari1)
			end if
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
		ToplamIskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * IskontoOrani / 100,2)
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam - ToplamIskontoTutari
		IskontoluToplam1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)

	Grid(0,0) = "_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_BAZ_LME"
	Grid(2,0) = "_LME_AYI"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 18
	Grid(1,1) = 17
	Grid(2,1) = 14
	Grid(3,1) = 83
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 22

	Grid(0,2) = "Order No"
	Grid(1,2) = "LME"
	Grid(2,2) = "LME Term"
	Grid(3,2) = "Type & Cross-Section"
	Grid(4,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(5,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & "/km)"
	Grid(6,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & ")"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	
	sol1 = SolMargin + 1
	for i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
		if Grid(i,0) = "OR_TUTAR" then
			GenTutar = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solTutar = Sol1			
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "PRICEUNIT" and solTutar > 0 then
			GenPB = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solPB = Sol1
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "OR_FIYAT" then
			GenFiyat = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1) - 2
			solFiyat = Sol1
		end if
		sol1 = sol1 + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			ondalik = ST70.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			if degisken = "OR_TUTAR" or degisken = "OR_FIYAT" then
				Ondalik = 2
			Elseif degisken = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				Ondalik = 3
			End if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	Grid(1,6) = 2
End Sub

Sub AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirPozr, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar-55, 6, 55, "ARA TOPLAM/SUB TOTAL " & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")	
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat(AraToplam,18,2))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Function KTA_Kontrol()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("KOD")

	for i = 1 to ST70T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = ST70T.KOD(i)
		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
	'	if AG_OG = 0 or trim(AG_OG) = "" then
	'		Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
	'	end if
	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
'		Hata = "Aþaðýdaki stok kartlarýnýn kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarý girilmemiþ (DLG170)" & vbcrlf & hata & _
'					vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."
'	end if
	KTA_Kontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SipTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	Set SipTable = ST70T
End Function
Function GrupSayisiBul(ST70)
	GrupSayisi = 0
	EskiGrup = ""
	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount
		if ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) <> EskiGrup then
			GrupSayisi = GrupSayisi + 1
			EskiGrup = ST70.LOTNUMBER(i)
		end if
	Next
	GrupSayisiBul = GrupSayisi
End Function
Function IskontoKontrol()
	for i = 1 to 4
		DagitilanIskonto = 0
		For j = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
			DagitilanIskonto = DagitilanIskonto + STOK70T.GetFieldValue("TL_TISKONTO_" & i, j)
		Next

		IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_TUTAR",i) * STOK70T.KUR(1),2)
		If IskontoTutari <> 0 and IskontoTutari <> DagitilanIskonto then
			Hata = Hata & "K.T.A. 'daki " & i & ". iskonto satýrlara daðýtýlmamýþ." & vbcrlf 
		End if
	Next
	IskontoKontrol = Hata
End Function
Sub HagemeyerNot(pe1, satirPozr)
	HNot = "The balance of this invoice has been assigned to Midt Factoring A/S, Vester Soegade 10, 1st Floor, " & _
			"DK-1601 Copenhagen, phone: +45 7021 1100, fax: +45 7021 1101, to whom payment can be made only. " & _
			"When due please transfer the amount to Danske Bank A/S, DK-1390 Copenhagen, SWIFT/BIC: DABADKKK, " & _
			"account No. 4788102135, IBAN: DK2830004788102135, stating invoice number and customer number." & vbcrlf & _
			"Objections, if any, to be made to Midt Factoring A/S without delay."
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, solMargin + 5, 15, sagMargin - solMargin - 5, HNot)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Hata = IskontoKontrol

	end if

	Hata = KTA_Kontrol()
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox(Hata,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	EskiLot = ""
	bbasla=0
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	AraToplam = 0	
	Toplam= 0
'	SolMargin= 0
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	UstMargin = 4 * satirYuksekligi
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 4
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 20 * satirYuksekligi
	AraSatirSonu = satirBaslangic + 32 * satirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(6)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura",  SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
'	Set ST70 = Doc.getTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

	chadres2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,"")

	chvergidairesi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,"")
	chvergino = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,"")
	
	sunvan = STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1

	sadres2 = STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2

	ftno = STOK70E.EVRAKNO
	svktarih = Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.S60_RSEVKTARIH(1))
	irsPosNo = STOK70T.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(1)
	SiparisNo = Doc.getDBFieldValue("STOK60T","SIPNO",irsPosNo,"SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")
	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1
	

'	adresbilgisi=Inputbox("1: Cari Kart Adresi ve Sevk Adresi                         2: Sevk adresi                                                       3: Cari kart adresi " ,"Adres")
	adresbilgisi = 3
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	if adresbilgisi="1" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin  - 2 * satiryuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)
	
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 30, "DELIVERY ADRESS")
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 5 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 6 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 7 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="2" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin + 1
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sunvan)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="3" then
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)
		solAdres = solMargin + 1
		bBasla = UstMargin + 5 * satirYuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)
	end if

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res=pe1.write(bBasla - 2 * satiryuksekligi, solMargin + 159, 5, 25, tarih)
	res=pe1.write(bBasla - satiryuksekligi, solMargin + 159, 5, 25, trim(ftno))

	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(bBasla + 15 * satiryuksekligi - 3, solMargin + 5, 7, 100, Not1)

	satir = satirBaslangic - 2 * satirYuksekligi
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 9)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		Else
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satir, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next

	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(ST70.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If satirNo = ST70.GetRecCount() and sonSatir >= SatirSonu then
		Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
	Else
		If sonSatir >= AraSatirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'			Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	End if
'	Yenilot = ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
'	if EskiLot <> YeniLot or EskiLot = "" Then 
'		if FaturaGrupSayisi > 1 and EskiLot <> "" then
'			Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
'			AraToplam = 0
'			satirPozr = satirPozr  + 2*satirYuksekligi
'		end if
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
'		satirPozr = satirPozr  + 5* satirYuksekligi
'	end if
	EskiLot = Yenilot
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT" then
			Tutar = ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirno)
			Miktar = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.Div(Tutar,Miktar) * 1000
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SIPNO" then
			SiparisNo = ST70.SIPNO(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
			Degisken = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) / 1000
		else
			Degisken = ST70.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	AraToplam = AraToplam + ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub 	Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
	Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		Toplam = Toplam + STOK70T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		ToplamUzunluk = ToplamUzunluk + STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next

'***********

	Toplam = Doc.Round(Toplam,2)
	Toplam1=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,18,2)	
	ToplamUzunluk1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUzunluk / 1000,18,3)	

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)
'	OdemeSekli = Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK40E","ODEMEKOSULLARI_1",SiparisNo,"")
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(Toplam,2) - Doc.Floor(Toplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Toplam) & " " &Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")
'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	IskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	if IskontoOrani = 0 then
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi
	else
		dim IskontoNotu(3), xIskontoOrani(3)
		For j = 1 to 4
			if STOK70E.GetFieldValue("OR_ISKONTO" & j & "TOPLAMI",1) > 0 then
				xIskontoOrani(j-1) = STOK70E.GetFieldValue("DO_ISKONTO" & j & "_ORANI",1)
				IskontoSayisi = IskontoSayisi + 1
				IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_NOTE",j)
				if trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) = "" then
					IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.Round(xIskontoOrani(j-1),1) & "% DISCOUNT"
				end if
			end if
		Next
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + (IskontoSayisi + 4) * satirYuksekligi
	end if
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	if IskontoOrani <> 0 then
		res = pe1.write(Baslangic - (IskontoSayisi + 2) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin+50, 6,80, "TOPLAM/TOTAL CIF " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Toplam1)
		For j = 1 to 4
			xIskontoOrani1 = xIskontoOrani(j-1)
			if xIskontoOrani1 > 0 then
				IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * xIskontoOrani1 / 100,2)
				IskontoTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoTutari,18,2)
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 6,130, trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoTutari1)
			end if
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
		ToplamIskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * IskontoOrani / 100,2)
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam - ToplamIskontoTutari
		IskontoluToplam1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	else
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam
		IskontoluToplam1= Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	End if
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(IskontoluToplam,2) - Doc.Floor(IskontoluToplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(IskontoluToplam1) &" " & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",12)
	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	SevkYeri = Doc.GetUDFValue("SP",SiparisNo,"SEVK",0)
	res = pe1.write(Baslangic, solMargin, 6,130, "TOPLAM/TOTAL CIF " & trim(SevkYeri) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoluToplam1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)
	ToplamNet = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"TOPLAM_NET",0)
	ToplamBrut = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"TOPLAM_BRT",0)
	Ambalaj = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"AMBALAJ",0)
	Navlun = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN",0)
	Sigorta = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"SIGORTA",0)
	if Navlun > 0 then
		if Sigorta = 0 then Sigorta = IskontoluToplam * 0.004
	end if
	
	FOBTutar = IskontoluToplam - Navlun - Sigorta
	if trim(STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)) <> "USD" then
		ToplamUSD = Doc.Div(FOBTutar,Doc.GetKur("USD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),STOK70E.TARIH,1,-1))
	end if

	ToplamNet1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,18,0)
	ToplamBrut1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,18,0)
	Navlun1 = Doc.NumFormat(Navlun,18,2)
	Sigorta1 = Doc.NumFormat(Sigorta,18,2)
	FOBTutar1 = Doc.NumFormat(FOBTutar,18,2)
	ToplamUSD1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUSD,18,2)

	Isbu = "ÝÞBU MALLAR TÜRK MENÞELÝ OLUP " & CHR(34) & "ATOM KABLO SAN. VE TÝC. A.Þ." & CHR(34)
	Isbu2 = "TARAFINDAN TÜRKÝYE 'DE ÝMAL EDÝLMÝÞTÝR."
	
	WeHereby = "WE HEREBY CERTIFY THAT THIS INVOICE IS CORRECT AND THE GOODS ARE OF TURKISH ORIGIN"
	sol1 = solMargin + 20
	Genislik1 = 80
	Genislik2 = 5
	Genislik3 = 30
	Genislik4 = 50

	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, sagMargin - sol1,"(Y." & Yalniz & ")")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM UZUNLUK / TOTAL LENGTH")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,ToplamUzunluk1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,"km")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM NET AÐIRLIK / TOTAL NET WEIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,ToplamNet1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,"kg")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM BRÜT AÐIRLIK / TOTAL GROSS WEIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,ToplamBrut1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,"kg")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"AMBALAJ / PACKING")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,Ambalaj)

	PB = trim(STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))

	if Navlun > 0 then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"NAVLUN / FREIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,Navlun1)
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,PB)

		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"SÝGORTA / INSURANCE")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,Sigorta1)
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,PB)
	end if

	if Navlun > 0 then
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM FOB " & PB & " / TOTAL FOB " & PB)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,FOBTutar1)
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,PB)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	End if
	'if ToplamUSD > 0 then
	'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM FOB USD / TOTAL FOB USD")
	'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik2,":")
	'	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, Genislik3,ToplamUSD1)
	'	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1 , 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 2,"USD")
	'end if
	'res=pe1.write(Ustmargin + 230, solmargin+51, 5, 30, Doc.strToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH))
	Call GTIP_Yazdir(pe1, pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,Isbu)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,Isbu2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,WeHereby)
'	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,WeHereby2)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Set Siparisler = SipTable()
	for i = 1 to Siparisler.GetRecCount
		SiparisNo = Siparisler.SIPNO(i)
		MusteriSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Eskalasyon = Doc.GetUDFValue("SP",SiparisNo,"ESKALASYON",0)
		KapanisLME = Doc.GetUDFValue("SP",SiparisNo,"KAP_LME",0)
		PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
		if trim(Eskalasyon) <> "" then
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,trim(MusteriSipNo) _
									& " : " & trim(Eskalasyon) & " = " & KapanisLME & " " & trim(PB) & "/TONNE")
		end if
	Next
	' res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,OdemeSekli)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 5, 5, sagMargin - solMargin - 5,Not2)
'res=pe1.write(252, solmargin+51, 5, 30, Doc.strToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH))

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(4,7)

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)

	Grid(0,0) = "_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 27
	Grid(1,1) = 80
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 26
	Grid(4,1) = 35

	Grid(0,2) = "Order No"
	Grid(1,2) = "Type & Cross-Section"
	Grid(2,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(3,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & "/km)"
	Grid(4,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & ")"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	
	sol1 = SolMargin + 1
	for i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
		if Grid(i,0) = "OR_TUTAR" then
			GenTutar = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solTutar = Sol1			
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "PRICEUNIT" and solTutar > 0 then
			GenPB = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solPB = Sol1
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "OR_FIYAT" then
			GenFiyat = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1) - 2
			solFiyat = Sol1
		end if
		sol1 = sol1 + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			ondalik = ST70.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			if degisken = "OR_TUTAR" or degisken = "OR_FIYAT" then
				Ondalik = 2
			Elseif degisken = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				Ondalik = 3
			End if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

'Sub BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
Sub GTIP_Yazdir(pe1, SatirPozr)
	satir = UstMargin
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	satir = SatirPozr + satirYuksekligi
'	if trim(YeniLot) >= "2" OR trim(YeniLot) = "3" OR trim(YeniLot) = "0" OR trim(YeniLot) = "" then
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(satir,solMargin,5,70,"G.T.Ý.P. : 85.44.49.91.11.11")
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi,pe1.GetLeft,5,120,"Elektrik Enerji Nakli Ýçin Kablolar")
'	elseif trim(YeniLot) = "1"  then
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
'		res = pe1.Write(satir,solMargin,5,40,"G.T.Ý.P.")
'		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi,pe1.GetLeft,5,40,"85.44.60.10.10.19")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
'		res = pe1.Write(satir,pe1.GetRight + 1,5,120,"Gerilimi 1000 V. geçen bakýr iletkenli")
'		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi,pe1.GetLeft,5,120,"toprak altý kablolarý")
'	end if
End Sub

Sub AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirPozr, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar-55, 6, 55, "ARA TOPLAM/SUB TOTAL " & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")	
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat(AraToplam,18,2))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Function KTA_Kontrol()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("KOD")

	for i = 1 to ST70T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = ST70T.KOD(i)
		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
	'	if AG_OG = 0 or trim(AG_OG) = "" then
	'		Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
	'	end if
	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
'		Hata = "Aþaðýdaki stok kartlarýnýn kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarý girilmemiþ (DLG170)" & vbcrlf & hata & _
'					vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."
'	end if
	KTA_Kontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SipTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	Set SipTable = ST70T
End Function
Function GrupSayisiBul(ST70)
	GrupSayisi = 0
	EskiGrup = ""
	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount
		if ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) <> EskiGrup then
			GrupSayisi = GrupSayisi + 1
			EskiGrup = ST70.LOTNUMBER(i)
		end if
	Next
	GrupSayisiBul = GrupSayisi
End Function
Function IskontoKontrol()
	for i = 1 to 4
		DagitilanIskonto = 0
		For j = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
			DagitilanIskonto = DagitilanIskonto + STOK70T.GetFieldValue("TL_TISKONTO_" & i, j)
		Next

		IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_TUTAR",i) * STOK70T.KUR(1),2)
		If IskontoTutari <> 0 and IskontoTutari <> DagitilanIskonto then
			Hata = Hata & "K.T.A. 'daki " & i & ". iskonto satýrlara daðýtýlmamýþ." & vbcrlf 
		End if
	Next
	IskontoKontrol = Hata
End Function
