Sub PrintForm()
	y = doc.d7MsgBox("Lütfen, Listelemeden önce Eskalasyon iþlemi yapýldýðýný kontrol ediniz.","Dinamo",MB_OK)
	Hata = IskontoKontrol
	if Hata <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
	end if

	Hata = KTA_Kontrol()
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox(Hata,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	EskiLot = ""
	bbasla=0
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	AraToplam = 0	
	Toplam= 0
'	SolMargin= 0
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	UstMargin = 4 * satirYuksekligi
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 4
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 20 * satirYuksekligi
	AraSatirSonu = satirBaslangic + 32 * satirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(6)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura",  SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
'	Set ST70 = Doc.getTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	ST70.CopyTable(S70)
'	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount()
'		StokKodu = ST70.KOD(i)
'		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
'		ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) = cStr(AG_OG)
'	Next
	Set ST70 = Doc.Select2("ssww", "STOK70T", "", "", -1)
	ST70.GroupBy("KOD+SIPNO+OR_FIYAT")
'	ST70.Sort("LOTNUMBER")

'	FaturaGrupSayisi = GrupSayisiBul(ST70)

	Call Alanlar()

	satirSayisi = ST70.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 9)

	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	chkodu = STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,"")
	chadi2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkodu,"")
	chadres1 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,"")
	chadres2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,"")
	chadres3 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,"")
	chvergidairesi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,"")
	chvergino = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,"")
	
	sunvan = STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	sadres1 = STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_1
	sadres2 = STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2
	sadres3 = STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_3
	
	BolgeKodu = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "BOLGEKODU", chkodu,"")
	tarih = Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	ftno = STOK70E.EVRAKNO
	svktarih = Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.S60_RSEVKTARIH(1))
	irsPosNo = STOK70T.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO(1)
	SiparisNo = Doc.getDBFieldValue("STOK60T","SIPNO",irsPosNo,"SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO")
	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1
	

'	adresbilgisi=Inputbox("1: Cari Kart Adresi ve Sevk Adresi                         2: Sevk adresi                                                       3: Cari kart adresi " ,"Adres")
	adresbilgisi = 3
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	if adresbilgisi="1" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin  - 2 * satiryuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)
	
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 30, "DELIVERY ADRESS")
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 5 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 6 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 7 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="2" then
		solAdres = solMargin + 100
		bBasla = UstMargin + 1
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sunvan)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, sadres3)
	elseif adresbilgisi="3" then
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)
		solAdres = solMargin + 1
		bBasla = UstMargin + 5 * satirYuksekligi
		res=pe1.write(bBasla, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadi2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres1)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres2)
		res=pe1.write(bBasla + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solAdres, 5, 72, chadres3)
	end if

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res=pe1.write(bBasla - 2 * satiryuksekligi, solMargin + 159, 5, 25, tarih)
	res=pe1.write(bBasla - satiryuksekligi, solMargin + 159, 5, 25, trim(ftno))

	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(bBasla + 15 * satiryuksekligi - 3, solMargin + 5, 7, 100, Not1)

	satir = satirBaslangic - 2 * satirYuksekligi
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 9)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		if Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		Else
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End if
		res = pe1.write(satir, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi, Baslik)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next

	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(ST70.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If satirNo = ST70.GetRecCount() and sonSatir >= SatirSonu then
		Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
	Else
		If sonSatir >= AraSatirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic	
'			Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + 2*satiryuksekligi
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
	End if
'	Yenilot = ST70.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
'	if EskiLot <> YeniLot or EskiLot = "" Then 
'		if FaturaGrupSayisi > 1 and EskiLot <> "" then
'			Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
'			AraToplam = 0
'			satirPozr = satirPozr  + 2*satirYuksekligi
'		end if
'		Call BaslikYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr,YeniLot)
'		satirPozr = satirPozr  + 5* satirYuksekligi
'	end if
	EskiLot = Yenilot
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT" then
			Tutar = ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirno)
			Miktar = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.Div(Tutar,Miktar) * 1000
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SIPNO" then
			SiparisNo = ST70.SIPNO(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
			Degisken = ST70.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) / 1000
		else
			Degisken = ST70.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	AraToplam = AraToplam + ST70.OR_TUTAR(satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub 	Print_form_AraSayfaSonu(pe1, sol)
	Call AraToplamYazdir(pe1,pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, sol)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		Toplam = Toplam + STOK70T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		ToplamUzunluk = ToplamUzunluk + STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next

'***********

	Toplam = Doc.Round(Toplam,2)
	Toplam1=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,18,2)	
	ToplamUzunluk1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUzunluk / 1000,18,3)	

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)
'	OdemeSekli = Doc.GetDBFieldvalue("STOK40E","ODEMEKOSULLARI_1",SiparisNo,"")
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(Toplam,2) - Doc.Floor(Toplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Toplam) & " " &Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")
'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	IskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	if IskontoOrani = 0 then
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi
	else
		dim IskontoNotu(3), xIskontoOrani(3)
		For j = 1 to 4
			if STOK70E.GetFieldValue("OR_ISKONTO" & j & "TOPLAMI",1) > 0 then
				xIskontoOrani(j-1) = STOK70E.GetFieldValue("DO_ISKONTO" & j & "_ORANI",1)
				IskontoSayisi = IskontoSayisi + 1
				IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_NOTE",j)
				if trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) = "" then
					IskontoNotu(j-1) = Doc.Round(xIskontoOrani(j-1),1) & "% DISCOUNT"
				end if
			end if
		Next
		Baslangic = pe1.getTop() + (IskontoSayisi + 4) * satirYuksekligi
	end if
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	if IskontoOrani <> 0 then
		res = pe1.write(Baslangic - (IskontoSayisi + 2) * satirYuksekligi, solMargin+50, 6,80, "TOPLAM/TOTAL FOB " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Toplam1)
		For j = 1 to 4
			xIskontoOrani1 = xIskontoOrani(j-1)
			if xIskontoOrani1 > 0 then
				IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * xIskontoOrani1 / 100,2)
				IskontoTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoTutari,18,2)
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 6,130, trim(IskontoNotu(j-1)) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
				res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoTutari1)
			end if
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(pe1.getTop() + satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
		ToplamIskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Toplam * IskontoOrani / 100,2)
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam - ToplamIskontoTutari
		IskontoluToplam1 = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	else
		IskontoluToplam = Toplam
		IskontoluToplam1= Doc.NumFormat(IskontoluToplam,18,2)
	End if
	
	Yuzde = Doc.Round(IskontoluToplam,2) - Doc.Floor(IskontoluToplam)
	if Yuzde <> 0 then
		YuzdeYazi = "%" & Doc.NumToText(Yuzde * 100)
	End if
	ParaBirimiYazi = Doc.GetGecoValue("*PUNIT","AD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),-1)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(IskontoluToplam1) &" " & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

'& YuzdeYazi & Replace(ParaBirimiYazi," ","")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",12)
	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	SevkYeri = Doc.GetUDFValue("SP",SiparisNo,"SEVK",0)
	res = pe1.write(Baslangic, solMargin, 6,130, "TOPLAM/TOTAL FOB " & trim(SevkYeri) & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, solTutar, 6, genTutar, IskontoluToplam1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",9)
	ToplamNet = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"TOPLAM_NET",0)
	ToplamBrut = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"TOPLAM_BRT",0)
	Ambalaj = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"AMBALAJ",0)
	Navlun = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN",0)
	Sigorta = Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"SIGORTA",0)
	if Navlun > 0 then
		if Sigorta = 0 then Sigorta = IskontoluToplam * 0.004
	end if
	
	FOBTutar = IskontoluToplam - Navlun - Sigorta
	if trim(STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)) <> "USD" then
		ToplamUSD = Doc.Div(FOBTutar,Doc.GetKur("USD",STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1),STOK70E.TARIH,1,-1))
	end if

	ToplamNet1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamNet,18,0)
	ToplamBrut1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamBrut,18,0)
	Navlun1 = Doc.NumFormat(Navlun,18,2)
	Sigorta1 = Doc.NumFormat(Sigorta,18,2)
	FOBTutar1 = Doc.NumFormat(FOBTutar,18,2)
	ToplamUSD1 = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamUSD,18,2)

	Isbu = "ÝÞBU MALLAR TÜRK MENÞELÝ OLUP " & CHR(34) & "ATOM KABLO SAN. VE TÝC. A.Þ." & CHR(34)
	Isbu2 = "TARAFINDAN TÜRKÝYE 'DE ÝMAL EDÝLMÝÞTÝR."
	
	WeHereby = "WE HEREBY CERTIFY THAT THIS INVOICE IS CORRECT AND THE GOODS ARE OF TURKISH ORIGIN"
	sol1 = solMargin + 20
	Genislik1 = 80
	Genislik2 = 5
	Genislik3 = 30
	Genislik4 = 50

	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, sagMargin - sol1,"(Y." & Yalniz & ")")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, sol1, 5, Genislik1,"TOPLAM UZUNLUK / TOTAL LENGTH")

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(4,7)

	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)
	PB = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	CIF_FOB = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E",SiparisNo,"INCOTERMS",0)

	Grid(0,0) = "_SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 27
	Grid(1,1) = 80
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 26
	Grid(4,1) = 35

	Grid(0,2) = "Order No"
	Grid(1,2) = "Type & Cross-Section"
	Grid(2,2) = "(km)"
	Grid(3,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & "/km)"
	Grid(4,2) = "(" & trim(PB) & ")"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	
	sol1 = SolMargin + 1
	for i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
		if Grid(i,0) = "OR_TUTAR" then
			GenTutar = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solTutar = Sol1			
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "PRICEUNIT" and solTutar > 0 then
			GenPB = Grid(i,1) - 2
			solPB = Sol1
		elseif Grid(i,0) = "OR_FIYAT" then
			GenFiyat = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1) - 2
			solFiyat = Sol1
		end if
		sol1 = sol1 + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			ondalik = ST70.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			if degisken = "OR_TUTAR" or degisken = "OR_FIYAT" then
				Ondalik = 2
			Elseif degisken = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				Ondalik = 3
			End if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Sub AraToplamYazdir(pe1,SatirPozr)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirPozr, solTutar, 0, genTutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar-55, 6, 55, "ARA TOPLAM/SUB TOTAL " & " " & STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")	
	res = pe1.write(SatirPozr + 1, solTutar, 6, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat(AraToplam,18,2))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
End Sub

Function KTA_Kontrol()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("KOD")

	for i = 1 to ST70T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = ST70T.KOD(i)
		AG_OG = Doc.GetUDFValue("05",StokKodu,"DLG170",0)
	'	if AG_OG = 0 or trim(AG_OG) = "" then
	'		Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
	'	end if
	Next
'	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
'		Hata = "Aþaðýdaki stok kartlarýnýn kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarý girilmemiþ (DLG170)" & vbcrlf & hata & _
'					vbcrlf & "Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."
'	end if
	KTA_Kontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SipTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T","TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70T = Doc.getTableObject("YYY")
	Set S70 = doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70T.CopyTable(S70)
	ST70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	Set SipTable = ST70T
End Function
Function GrupSayisiBul(ST70)
	GrupSayisi = 0
	EskiGrup = ""
	For i = 1 to ST70.GetRecCount
		if ST70.LOTNUMBER(i) <> EskiGrup then
			GrupSayisi = GrupSayisi + 1
			EskiGrup = ST70.LOTNUMBER(i)
		end if
	Next
	GrupSayisiBul = GrupSayisi
End Function
Function IskontoKontrol()
	for i = 1 to 4
		DagitilanIskonto = 0
		For j = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
			DagitilanIskonto = DagitilanIskonto + STOK70T.GetFieldValue("TL_TISKONTO_" & i, j)
		Next

		IskontoTutari = Doc.Round(Doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70E.EVRAKNO,"ISK_TUTAR",i) * STOK70T.KUR(1),2)
		If IskontoTutari <> 0 and IskontoTutari <> DagitilanIskonto then
			Hata = Hata & "K.T.A. 'daki " & i & ". iskonto satýrlara daðýtýlmamýþ." & vbcrlf 
		End if
	Next
	IskontoKontrol = Hata
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
'	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
'	S70T.SafePack
'	S70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=81.7
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "ÝRSALÝYE NO")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	irsno = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(i)

	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, 5, 20,irsno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = (TLIskonto / STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 155
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "TOPLAM") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ISKONTO % " & Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskontoOrani,6,1)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekmiktar)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK K.D.V. 1/10")
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekkdv)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext_TL(odenecekmiktar1)

	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 147 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, "YALNIZ  " & yodenecekmiktar )
	kur=STOK70T.KUR(1)
	PB=STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 142 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, PB&" KURU"&" = "&doc.numformat_nlz(KUR,12,6)&" "&doc.defaultpb )

'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 177, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)


	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 152, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 157, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)



	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	If trim(chkod) = "000086" Then
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, "MAL VERENÝN KODU  =  025886")

----------------------------------------------------------------
Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : FTATOM2
Hangi Tablo için : STOK70
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : ATOM FATURA Y.ÝÇÝ
Kod : 
Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, satirpozr, sirano, XX_tepe, XX_Satir
Dim satirsayisi, i, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin
Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
'	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
'	S70T.SafePack
'	S70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=81.7
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "ÝRSALÝYE NO")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	irsno = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(i)

	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, 5, 20,irsno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = (TLIskonto / STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 155
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "TOPLAM") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ISKONTO % " & Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskontoOrani,6,1)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekmiktar)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK K.D.V. 1/10")
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekkdv)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext_TL(odenecekmiktar1)

	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 147 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, "YALNIZ  " & yodenecekmiktar )
	kur=STOK70T.KUR(1)
	PB=STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 142 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, PB&" KURU"&" = "&doc.numformat_nlz(KUR,12,6)&" "&doc.defaultpb )

'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 177, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)


	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 152, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 157, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)



	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	If trim(chkod) = "000086" Then
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, "MAL VERENÝN KODU  =  025886")
	Else
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not3)

' ***********

'					valtar = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 151.3 , 40 , satiryukseklik, 100, STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1)
'			res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, satirsolmargin+25, satiryukseklik, 130, valtar)
			SIPNO = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)	
		MSIPNO = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", SIPNO, "")

	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "Koçtaþ Stok Kodu")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
  koctasstokadi=Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "TEXT_TECH_2", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	

	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, 5, 20,koctasstokadi) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = (TLIskonto / STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 155
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "TOPLAM") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ISKONTO % " & Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskontoOrani,6,1)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekmiktar)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK K.D.V. 1/10")
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekkdv)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

		yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext_TL(odenecekmiktar1)

	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 147 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, "YALNIZ  " & yodenecekmiktar )
	 'kur=STOK70T.KUR(1)
	'PB=STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	'res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 142 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, PB&" KURU"&" = "&doc.numformat_nlz(KUR,12,6)&" "&doc.defaultpb )

'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 177, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)


	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 152, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 157, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)



	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	If trim(chkod) = "000086" Then
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, "MAL VERENÝN KODU  =  025886")
	Else
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not3)
	End If

'	If trim(odemekosullari2) = "" And trim(odemekosullari1) = "" Then
'		If left(STOK70T.KOD(1),4) 	<> "UZFF" Then
' ***********
	

			res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 167, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"FATURANIN SON ÖDEME TARÝHÝ : " & vadetarihi)
'					valtar = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 151.3 , 40 , satiryukseklik, 100, STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1)
'			res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, satirsolmargin+25, satiryukseklik, 130, valtar)
			SIPNO = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)	
		MSIPNO = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", SIPNO, "")
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"MÜÞTERÝ SÝPARÝÞ NO : " & MSIPNO)
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 192, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"FATURADA BELÝRTÝLEN SON ÖDEME TARÝHÝNDEN SONRA YAPILAN ÖDEMELERDE AYLIK %4 VADE FARKI UYGULANIR")

'		End If
'	End If

'	If trim(faturatip)="SR" Then

'	End If

' *******

Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
'	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
'	S70T.SafePack
'	S70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=81.7
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "Metro Stok Kodu")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik

	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

		yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext_TL(odenecekmiktar1)

	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 147 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, "YALNIZ  " & yodenecekmiktar )

Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, satirpozr, sirano, XX_tepe, XX_Satir
Dim satirsayisi, i, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin
Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
'	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
'	S70T.SafePack
'	S70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=81.7
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "ÝRSALÝYE NO")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	irsno = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(i)

	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, 5, 20,irsno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = doc.div(TLIskonto , STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 155
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik

'  15.Nisan.2009 // ORHAN

	vIndex = 2

	Doc.CreateTableObject "MMM=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set SK70 = Doc.GetTableObject("MMM")
	Set SM70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	SK70.CopyTable(SM70)

	For xx=1 To SK70.getreccount()
		SK70.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(xx)=""&SK70.KDV_ORANI(xx)
	Next
	
	SK70.GroupBy("SEVKPAKETLOTNO")

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "TOPLAM") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ISKONTO % " & Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskontoOrani,6,1)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
' 15/04/2009 ***********************************************************************************************
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
'	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtoplam)
' *********************************************************************************************************

	For Z=1 to SK70.getreccount()
		kdvorani= SK70.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(z)
		kdvtutari = SK70.TL_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF(z)

		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(kdvtutari,30,2))
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		satirPozr = satirPozr +4.3
	Next
' *********************************************************************************************************

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
'	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")

		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik

		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)

	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, 85, 5,25, "Koçtaþ Stok Kodu")
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	irsno = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(i)

	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, 5, 20,irsno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=Doc.numformat_nlz(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=Doc.numformat_nlz(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = doc.div(TLIskonto , STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100

	Not1 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3 = STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 155
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik

'  15.Nisan.2009 // ORHAN

	vIndex = 2

	Doc.CreateTableObject "MMM=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set SK70 = Doc.GetTableObject("MMM")
	Set SM70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	SK70.CopyTable(SM70)

	For xx=1 To SK70.getreccount()
		SK70.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(xx)=""&SK70.KDV_ORANI(xx)
	Next
	
	SK70.GroupBy("SEVKPAKETLOTNO")

	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "TOPLAM") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ISKONTO % " & Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskontoOrani,6,1)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.numformat_nlz(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
' 15/04/2009 ***********************************************************************************************
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
'	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
'	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtoplam)
' *********************************************************************************************************

	For Z=1 to SK70.getreccount()
		kdvorani= SK70.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(z)
		kdvtutari = SK70.TL_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF(z)
		kdvmatrah = SK70.TL_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(z)
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "K.D.V.")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 30, "%" & doc.numformat_nlz(kdvorani,6,1))
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(kdvtutari,30,2))
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		satirPozr = satirPozr +4.3
	Next
' *********************************************************************************************************

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
'	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekmiktar)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK K.D.V. 1/10")
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, odenecekkdv)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 30, "-------------------------------")
	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext_TL(odenecekmiktar1)

	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 147 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, "YALNIZ  " & yodenecekmiktar )
	kur=STOK70T.KUR(1)
	PB=STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 142 , solmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, PB&" KURU"&" = "&doc.numformat_nlz(KUR,12,6)&" "&doc.defaultpb )

'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
'	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 177, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)


	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 152, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
	res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 157, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)



	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	If trim(chkod) = "000086" Then
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, "MAL VERENÝN KODU  =  025886")
	Else
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 182, solmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not3)
	End If

'	If trim(odemekosullari2) = "" And trim(odemekosullari1) = "" Then
'		If left(STOK70T.KOD(1),4) 	<> "UZFF" Then
' ***********
	

			res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 167, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"FATURANIN SON ÖDEME TARÝHÝ : " & vadetarihi)
'					valtar = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 151.3 , 40 , satiryukseklik, 100, STOK70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1)
'			res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, satirsolmargin+25, satiryukseklik, 130, valtar)
			SIPNO = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)	
		MSIPNO = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", SIPNO, "")
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 172, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"MÜÞTERÝ SÝPARÝÞ NO : " & MSIPNO)
		res= pe1.write(UstMargin + 192, solmargin, satiryukseklik, 150,"FATURADA BELÝRTÝLEN SON ÖDEME TARÝHÝNDEN SONRA YAPILAN ÖDEMELERDE AYLIK %4 VADE FARKI UYGULANIR")

'		End If
'	End If

'	If trim(faturatip)="SR" Then

'	End If

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	Toplam=doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)

Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, satirpozr, sirano, XX_tepe, XX_Satir
Dim satirsayisi, i, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin
Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=80
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 0)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 0)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")

'	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
'	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
'	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
'	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
'	S70T.SafePack
'	S70T.GroupBy("SIPNO")

	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	XX_satir = 4.3
	XX_tepe = XX_satir * 17

	ustMargin = 40
	solmargin=40
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=15
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=81.7
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		

	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("courier new",7)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-25, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, faturatarihi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, evrakno)
	IRSNO= STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSNO)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5, solmargin+118, 5, 30, IRSTAR)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10, solmargin+118, 5, 30, STOK70T.SIPNO(1))

End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If sirano > 29 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If

' zzz

	sirano=sirano+1
'	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	satirpozr = XX_tepe + (sirano-1) * XX_Satir
	
	stokkodu = STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 6)
	birim = STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = doc.numformat_nlz(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2)

'	sipno = STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
'	chsipno = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
'	aciklama = STOK70T.NOTES(i)
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
'	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 

	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 1 , 5, 35,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 37, 5, 70,stokadi) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, 5, 18, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 128, 5, 8, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, 5, 25, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, 175, 5, 25, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")


End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
'	res=pe1.Selectfont("courier new",7)
	S = pe1.GetTop()
	If S > 159 Then

		satirPozr = 81.7
	End If

	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If

	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

Makro Kodu : ICPIYBARKO

Public Ust, Sol, EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Flag, D7LB
Sub PrintLabel()
	FormKodu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	SatirTipi = 0
	Set D7LB = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.ETIKET", "GetEtiketTable", FormKodu, SatirTipi)
	if D7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Flag = 0
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 150
	Ustmargin = 1
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 50
	EtiketEni = 48
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = EtiketEni + 2
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = EtiketBoyu + 1
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 2
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 3
	SayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

'	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaEni,sayfaBoyu,"")


	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow",8)
	res = pe1.NoPen()

	For i = 1 to D7LB.GetRowCount()
		AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
		for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
			EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor((EtiketNo-1) / EndenEtiketSayisi) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
			xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
			if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
				sol = SolMargin
			else
				sol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * EndenEtiketlerArasi
			end if
			if yEtiketSayisi = 0 and (EtiketNo Mod BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Ust = Ustmargin					
			else
				Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketlerArasi
			end if
			Call Etiket(pe1,i)
		Next
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
	sag = sol + EtiketEni - 12
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	StokKodu = D7LB.SKOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	xBarkod1 = D7LB.KOD(satirNo)
	xYazi = StokAdi

	If Left(Trim(StokKodu),3)="869" Then
		xBarkod2 = StokKodu
		Flag = 1
	ElseIf Left(Trim(StokKodu),2)="ZI" Then
		xBarkod2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "EANKODU", StokKodu, "")
		Flag = 1
	Else
		MsgBox "Stok Kod Aralýðý Doðru Deðil," &  satirNo & " Nolu Satýr Ýçin Etiket Basýlmayacaktýr !..."
		xBarkod2 = "" 
		Flag = 0
	End If

	If  Flag = 1 Then
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Barcode(Ust + 5, sol+2, 12, EtiketEni - 6, "CODE128", trim(xBarkod1), "")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		YaziUst = pe1.GetBottom
		solYazi = sol + 3
		res = pe1.Write(YaziUst + 0.5, solYazi, 10, 28, xYazi)
		res = pe1.Barcode(Ust + 30, sol, 12, EtiketEni - 5, "EAN13", trim(xBarkod2), "")
'		YaziAlt = pe1.GetBottom
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
		res = pe1.UseSet(1)
		Flag = 0
	End If

End Sub

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 1) * 4.2
End Function
