Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, top, sipno, XX_SATIR, S60T
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, solMargin, Sagmargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, satirYuksekligi
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	STOK60T.SafePack()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("sd455t656", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD+LOTNUMBER")
	sayfaBoyu = 280
	sayfaEni = 215
	SolMargin = 18
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 20
	XX_SATIR = 4.3
	Ustmargin = 28
	AltMargin = 10
	satirbaslangic=117
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	top = 0
	sipno = ""
	satirsonu=satirbaslangic+95
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	pe1. ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "SevkIrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = S60T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin
	SatirAra = 4
	FisNo = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	MusteriAdi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	telno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "TELEFONNO_1", chkodu,-1)
	faxno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "FAXNO", chkodu,-1)
	ChAdres1 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
	ChAdres2 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
	ChAdres3 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 5, 6, 65, trim(chkodu))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 5, 6, 65, trim(MusteriAdi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 7, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 8, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11, 5, 6, 35, chvergidairesi)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11 ,55, 6, 35, chvergino)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR , 153, 6, 35, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR * 2, 153, 6, 35, sevktarih)
	sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
	siptrh = doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.getDbFieldvalue("STOK40E", "TARIH", sipno,""))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 110, 6, 30, sipno)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 155, 6, 65, siptrh)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
		mik = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
		top = top + mik
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic 
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satirYuksekligi
			End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
		Degisken = trim(cstr(S60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
	Not1=STOK60E.NotES_1
	Not2=STOK60E.NotES_2
	Not3=STOK60E.NotES_3
	Not4=STOK60E.NotES_4
	nak=STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	plaka=STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

' ZZZ *************

'	sonsatir = pe1.GetTop()+satiryuksekligi*2
	sonsatir = 204

	res = pe1.write(sonsatir, 30, 6, 100, Not1)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR , 30, 6, 100, Not2)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 2, 30, 6, 100, Not3)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 3, 30, 6, 100, Not4)
	sons=238
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR,150, 6, 95, nak)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 5, 150, 6, 60, plaka)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 28
	Grid(4,1) = 30

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,5) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : IRSALIYE0
Hangi Tablo için : STOK60
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : ATOM SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ ---------ENÝ FORM
Kod : 
Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, top, sipno, XX_SATIR, S60T
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, solMargin, Sagmargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, satirYuksekligi
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	STOK60T.SafePack()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("sd455t656", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD+LOTNUMBER")
	sayfaBoyu = 280
	sayfaEni = 215
	SolMargin = 18
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 20
	XX_SATIR = 4.3
	Ustmargin = 28
	AltMargin = 10
	satirbaslangic=93
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	top = 0
	sipno = ""
	satirsonu=satirbaslangic+95
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	pe1. ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "SevkIrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = S60T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin
	SatirAra = 4
	FisNo = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	MusteriAdi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	telno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "TELEFONNO_1", chkodu,-1)
	faxno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "FAXNO", chkodu,-1)
	ChAdres1 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
	ChAdres2 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
	ChAdres3 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 2, 5, 6, 65, trim(chkodu))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 3, 5, 6, 65, trim(MusteriAdi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 8, 5, 6, 35, chvergidairesi)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 8 ,55, 6, 35, chvergino)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 2, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 3, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR * 2, 153, 6, 35, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR  , 153, 6, 35, sevktarih)
	sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
	siptrh = doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.getDbFieldvalue("STOK40E", "TARIH", sipno,""))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 110, 6, 30, sipno)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 155, 6, 65, siptrh)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 5, 150, 6, 60, plaka)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "KOD_STOK00_TEXT_TECH_2"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 28
	Grid(4,1) = 30

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,5) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub                                                                                                             


----------------------------------------------------------------
Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : IRSALIYE2
Hangi Tablo için : STOK60
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : ATOM SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ - METRO
Kod : 
Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, top, sipno, XX_SATIR, S60T
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, solMargin, Sagmargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, satirYuksekligi
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	STOK60T.SafePack()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("sd455t656", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD+LOTNUMBER")
	sayfaBoyu = 280
	sayfaEni = 215
	SolMargin = 18
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 20
	XX_SATIR = 4.3
	Ustmargin = 28
	AltMargin = 10
	satirbaslangic=117
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	top = 0
	sipno = ""
	satirsonu=satirbaslangic+95
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	pe1. ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	satiryuksekligi = 25.4 / 6
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "SevkIrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = S60T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin
	SatirAra = 4
	FisNo = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	MusteriAdi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	telno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "TELEFONNO_1", chkodu,-1)
	faxno = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "FAXNO", chkodu,-1)
	ChAdres1 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
	ChAdres2 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
	ChAdres3 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 5, 6, 65, trim(chkodu))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 5, 6, 65, trim(MusteriAdi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 7, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 8, 5, 6, 65, trim(ChAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11, 5, 6, 35, chvergidairesi)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11 ,55, 6, 35, chvergino)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR , 153, 6, 35, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR * 2, 153, 6, 35, sevktarih)
	sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
	siptrh = doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.getDbFieldvalue("STOK40E", "TARIH", sipno,""))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 110, 6, 30, sipno)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 155, 6, 65, siptrh)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	
		sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
		mik = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
		top = top + mik
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic 
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satirYuksekligi
			End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
		Degisken = trim(cstr(S60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
	Not1=STOK60E.NotES_1
	Not2=STOK60E.NotES_2
	Not3=STOK60E.NotES_3
	Not4=STOK60E.NotES_4
	nak=STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	plaka=STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

' ZZZ *************

'	sonsatir = pe1.GetTop()+satiryuksekligi*2
	sonsatir = 204

	res = pe1.write(sonsatir, 30, 6, 100, Not1)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR , 30, 6, 100, Not2)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 2, 30, 6, 100, Not3)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 3, 30, 6, 100, Not4)
	sons=238
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR,150, 6, 95, nak)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 5, 150, 6, 60, plaka)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "KOD_STOK00_TEXT_TECH_3"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 28
	Grid(4,1) = 30

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,5) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))

		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11, 5, 6, 35, chvergidairesi)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 11 ,55, 6, 35, chvergino)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 4, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 5, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 6, 110, 6, 65, trim(SevkAdres3))		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR , 153, 6, 35, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla - XX_SATIR * 2, 153, 6, 35, sevktarih)
	sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
	siptrh = doc.StrtoNorDate(Doc.getDbFieldvalue("STOK40E", "TARIH", sipno,""))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 110, 6, 30, sipno)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + XX_SATIR * 10, 155, 6, 65, siptrh)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	
		sipno = S60T.SIPNO(1)
		mik = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
		top = top + mik
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic 
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satirYuksekligi
			End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
		Degisken = trim(cstr(S60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
	Not1=STOK60E.NotES_1
	Not2=STOK60E.NotES_2
	Not3=STOK60E.NotES_3
	Not4=STOK60E.NotES_4
	nak=STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	plaka=STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

' ZZZ *************

'	sonsatir = pe1.GetTop()+satiryuksekligi*2
	sonsatir = 204

	res = pe1.write(sonsatir, 30, 6, 100, Not1)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR , 30, 6, 100, Not2)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 2, 30, 6, 100, Not3)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 3, 30, 6, 100, Not4)
	sons=238
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR,150, 6, 95, nak)
	res = pe1.write(sonsatir + XX_SATIR * 5, 150, 6, 60, plaka)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "KOD_STOK00_TEXT_TECH_4"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 28
	Grid(4,1) = 30

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,5) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	STOK20T.SafePack()
	Set S20T = Doc.Select2("sasdfs", "STOK20T", "", "", -1)
	S20T.GroupBy2("KOD+LOTNUMBER")

	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi - Mamuller"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()


	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To S20T.GetRowCount()
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = S20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = S20T.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = S20T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If S20T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = S20T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = S20T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
'					URETNO = S20T.PRODLODNUMBER(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, EtiketSol, EtiketEni, Doc1, d7LB
Sub PrintLabel()
	etiketSayisi = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "ETK_SAYISI", 0)
	if etiketSayisi = 0 Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("K.T.A. 'daki Etiket Sayýsý alanýný doldurmalýsýnýz", "Hata!", MB_OK+MB_ICONWARNING)
		Exit Sub
	End if


	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 150
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 150/4
	EtiketEni = 33.3
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 3
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 4
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")

	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
	Set d7LB = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")


	etiketIciMiktar = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "ETK_MIKTAR", 0)
	AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
	For i = 1 to etiketSayisi
		for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
			EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
			yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
			if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
				EtiketSol = SolMargin
			else
				EtiketSol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
			end if	
			if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Ust = Ustmargin					
			else
				Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
			end if
			Call Etiket(pe1, etiketIciMiktar)
		Next
	Next
	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "D7KIDSLB", ""

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,etiketIciMiktar)
	sag = EtiketSol + EtiketEni
	Alt = Ust + EtiketEni 

	StokKodu = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	Birim = MMPS10E.SF_SF_UNIT
	SeriNo = Doc.Sayac0danAl("SERINO")
	LotNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "LOTNO", 0)
	
	Doc1.Load_Voucher SeriNo
	d7LB.SKOD = StokKodu
	d7LB.SF_MIKTAR = etiketIciMiktar
	d7LB.SF_UNIT = Birim
	d7LB.MPSNO = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO
	d7LB.MPSTM_TRNUM = MMPS10TM.TRNUM(1)
	d7LB.LOTNUMBER = LotNo
	d7LB.EVRAKTYPE = "UP"
	d7LB.EVRAKNO = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO
	Doc1.Save_Voucher

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)
	res = pe1.Barcode(Ust + 1, EtiketSol + 2, 10, etiketEni - 6, "CODE128", trim(SeriNo), "")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 2, EtiketSol + 1, 5, 10, "MPS No")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sag - pe1.GetRight - 3, ": " & trim(MMPS10E.EVRAKNO))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 5, EtiketSol + 1, 5, 10, "Lot No")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sag - pe1.GetRight - 3, ": " & trim(LotNo))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 5, EtiketSol + 1, Alt - pe1.GetTop - 8, sag - EtiketSol - 3, trim(StokAdi))
End Sub

Public xEtiketAdedi, xCHKodu, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, SolMargin, SagMargin , UstMargin, SatirYuksekligi

Sub PrintLabel()

	xEtiketAdedi = 0
	xCHKodu = ""
	xStokKodu = ""
	xBarkod = ""
	xMetre = 0

	sayfaEni  = 75
	sayfaBoyu = 35
	SolMargin = 27
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 5
	UstMargin = 2
	SatirYuksekligi = 5

	BarcodeEni = 30
	BarcodeYuksekligi = 10
	EtiketlerArasi = 0
	satirBaslangic = 5
	satirYuksekligi  = BarcodeYuksekligi + EtiketlerArasi

	xCE = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() 
	xxCE = Trim(xCE) + "\IMAGES\CE.JPG"
	xxLOGO= Trim(xCE) + "\IMAGES\ROHS.JPG"
	xCHKodu = MMPS10TM.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	xStokKodu = Trim(MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU)
	xEtiketAdedi = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "ETK_SAYISI",0)
	xBarkod = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(xstokkodu,xchkodu)
	xMetre  = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_6", xStokKodu, "") 

	If xEtiketAdedi = 0 Then 
		Msgbox "Kaç adet etiket basýlacaðý belirtilmemiþ !..."
		Exit Sub
	End IF

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni+30,"")
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(1)

	If Trim(xCHKodu)="000235" Then 
		Call PxCables(pe1)
	ElseIf Trim(xCHKodu)="999999" Then 
		Call IcPiyasa()
	Else
		Call GenelEtiket(pe1)
	End If

End Sub

Sub PxCables(pe1)
	xPX1 = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "PX1",0)
	xPX2 = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "PX2",0)
	xSTGK8Kodu= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_8", xStokKodu, "")
	xSTGK8Adi = Doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK8","AD",xSTGK8Kodu,-1)
	xRenk = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "RENK",0)
	xSTGK2Kodu= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_2", xStokKodu, "")
	xStandard = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "STANDARD",0)
	xPX3 = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "PX3",0)

	satirYuksekligi  = BarcodeYuksekligi + EtiketlerArasi
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
	For i = 1 To xEtiketAdedi
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		Res = Pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",10)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		xxSol = SolMargin-3
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin-1.5,    xxSol, 5, 40, xMetre&"M")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		Res = Pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",7)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+3 , xxSol, 5, 40, Trim(xPX1))
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+6,  xxSol, 5, 40, Trim(xPX2))
		If Trim(xSTGK8Kodu) = "04" Then
			Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+9, xxSol, 5, 40, "Low Smoke Zero Halogen")
		End if
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+12, xxSol, 5, 40, Trim(xRenk))
		res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+15, xxSol, 5, 15, Trim(xSTGK2Kodu))
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+15,xxSol+16,3.5,3.5,xxCE,114)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+15, xxSol+22, 5, 15, Trim(xStandard))
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2.5, xxSol, 5, 40, Trim(xPX3))
		res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+20, xxSol, 5, 40, "PXcables")
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",4)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+20, xxSol+24.5, 5, 3, "TM")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Barcode(UstMargin+2.4, SolMargin+38, 15, BarcodeEni, "EAN13", Trim(xBarkod), "")
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
		Res = Pe1.Line(UstMargin+22.8, SolMargin, 0, SayfaEni-10)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+23.5, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("This product shall be installed/used according to the national or international wiring regulations by"))
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1.8, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("competent electricians ONLY. The manufacturer/supplier will in no way be liable for any losses"))
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1.8, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("due to faulty/improper installations"))
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If I<xEtiketAdedi Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
		End If
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub GenelEtiket(pe1)
	xSTGK6Kodu= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_6", xStokKodu, "")
	xSize = Doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK6","AD",xSTGK6Kodu,-1)
	xType = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_5", xStokKodu, "")
	xStandard = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", xStokKodu, "STANDARD",0)
	xLength = xMetre
	xSTGK2Kodu= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "GK_2", xStokKodu, "")
	xSTGK2Adi = Doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK2","AD",xSTGK2Kodu,-1)
	Aralik = 4
	Gen = 13
	
	xxSol = SolMargin
	sol = solMargin
	if trim(xBarkod) = "" Then Sol = solMargin + 20
	For i = 1 To xEtiketAdedi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		Res = Pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
		xxSatirH = 4
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin, sol, xxSatirH, Gen, "Size")
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, xxSatirH, 25, "  : " & Trim(xSize))

		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop+Aralik,  Sol, xxSatirH, Gen, "Type")
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight,xxSatirH, 25, "  : " & Trim(xType))

		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop+Aralik,  Sol, xxSatirH, Gen, "Standard")
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight,xxSatirH, 25, "  : " & Trim(xStandard))

		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop+Aralik, Sol, xxSatirH, Gen, "Length(m)")
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight,xxSatirH,25, "  : " & Trim(xLength))
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Barcode(UstMargin+2, SolMargin+34, BarcodeYuksekligi, BarcodeEni, "EAN13", Trim(xBarkod), "")
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		Res = Pe1.line(UstMargin+16, xxSol, 0, SayfaEni-10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+16.5,xxSol+1,5,5,xxLOGO,114)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+17, xxSol+10, 5, 40, Trim(xSTGK2Adi))
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+16.5,xxSol+58,5,5,xxCE,114)
		Res = Pe1.line(UstMargin+22, xxSol, 0, SayfaEni-10)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
		Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+23.5, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("This product shall be installed/used according to the national or international wiring regulations by"))
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1.8, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("competent electricians ONLY. The manufacturer/supplier will in no way be liable for any losses"))
		Res = Pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1.8, SolMargin, 3, SayfaEni-10, Trim("due to faulty/improper installations"))
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If I<xEtiketAdedi Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
		End If
	Next

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Sol, EtiketEni, D7LB
'Sub PrintLabel1(TABLO)
'	Set D7LB = Doc.GetTableObject(TABLO)
'	Call PrintLabel()
'End Sub
Sub PrintLabel()
	FormKodu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	SatirTipi = 1
	Set D7LB = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.ETIKET", "GetEtiketTable", FormKodu, SatirTipi)
	if D7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 96
	EtiketEni = 96
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	For i = 1 to D7LB.GetRecCount()
		EtiketAdedi = 1
		for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for k = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
					Sol = SolMargin
				else
					Sol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
				end if	
				if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
				end if
				Ust = Ustmargin
				Sol = SolMargin
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		Next
	Next
'	if trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) = "T" Then
		res = pe1.Show()	
'	Else
'		res = pe1.PrintDoc(0)
'	End if
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
	sag = Sol + EtiketEni

	StokKodu = D7LB.SKOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	Birim = D7LB.SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	IslemMiktari = D7LB.SF_BAKIYE(satirNo)
	SeriNo = D7LB.SERINO(satirNo)
	UstAlt = D7LB.VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	MPSNo = D7LB.MPSNO(satirNo)
	MPSTRNUM = D7LB.MPSTM_TRNUM(satirNo)
	Siparisno = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10TM", "MUSTERISIPINO", MPSNo+MPSTRNUM, "EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
	mSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", Siparisno, "")
	Tip = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KABLO_TUR", 0)
	Kesit = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KESIT", 0)
	Standart = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "STANDARD", 0)
	Gerilim = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "GERILIM", 0)
	MakaraNo = D7LB.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)

	Basla = Ust + 15
	satirAra = 11.7
	Genislik = 28
	Blok1 = sol + Genislik

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust, Sol, 12, sag - sol, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla - 4, Sol + 20, 5, 30, "www.atom.com.tr")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)
	res = pe1.BarCode(Ust,53,13,43,"Code128",Trim(SeriNo),"") 

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "TYPE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Tip)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + satirAra + 1, Sol + 1, 12, Genislik, "CROSS SECTION")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Kesit)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 2 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "STANDARD")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 18)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 2, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Standart)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "METRE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 1, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & IslemMiktari & " (" & trim(UstAlt) &")")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 4 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "VOLTAGE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Gerilim)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 5 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 6, Genislik, "DRUM NO")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 6, sag - Blok1, ": " & MakaraNo)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 6 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 6, Genislik, "ORDER NO")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 6, sag - Blok1, ": " & mSipNo)

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	for i = 1 to 7
		res = pe1.Line(Basla + (i-1) * satirAra, sol, 0, sag- sol)
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Sol, EtiketEni, d7LB
Sub PrintForm()
	Call PrintLabel()
End Sub
Sub PrintLabel()
	if Doc.GetDocType = "D7KIDSLB" and Doc.GetDocType0 <> "TRACKIZ" Then Exit Sub
	EtiketFormu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	Set d7LB = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.ETIKET", "GetEtiketTable", EtiketFormu)
	if d7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub


	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 96
	EtiketEni = 96
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	For i = 1 to d7LB.GetRecCount()
		EtiketAdedi = 1
		for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
			Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
			if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
				KutuMiktari = Kalan
			else
				KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
			end if

			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for k = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
					Sol = SolMargin
				else
					Sol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
				end if	
				if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
				end if
				Ust = Ustmargin
				Sol = SolMargin
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		Next
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()	
	'res = pe1.PrintDoc(0)
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
	sag = Sol + EtiketEni

	StokKodu = d7LB.SKOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	Birim = d7LB.SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	IslemMiktari = d7LB.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	SeriNo = d7LB.SERINO(satirNo)
	UstAlt = d7LB.VRI_VR_R1(satirNo)
	MPSNo = d7LB.MPSNO(satirNo)
	MPSTRNUM = d7LB.MPSTM_TRNUM(satirNo)
	Siparisno = d7LB.SIPARISNO_40(satirNo)
	mSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", Siparisno, "")
	Tip = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KABLO_TUR", 0)
	Kesit = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KESIT", 0)
	Standart = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "STANDARD", 0)
	Gerilim = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "GERILIM", 0)
	MakaraNo = d7LB.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)

	Basla = Ust + 15
	satirAra = 11.7
	Genislik = 28
	Blok1 = sol + Genislik

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust, Sol, 12, sag - sol, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla - 4, Sol + 20, 5, 30, "www.atom.com.tr")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)
	res = pe1.BarCode(Ust,53,13,43,"Code128",Trim(SeriNo),"") 

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "TYPE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Tip)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + satirAra + 1, Sol + 1, 12, Genislik, "CROSS SECTION")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Kesit)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 2 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "STANDARD")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 18)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 2, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Standart)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "METRE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 1, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & IslemMiktari & " (" & trim(UstAlt) &")")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 4 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "VOLTAGE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Gerilim)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 5 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 6, Genislik, "DRUM NO")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 6, sag - Blok1, ": " & MakaraNo)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 6 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 6, Genislik, "ORDER NO")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 6, sag - Blok1, ": " & mSipNo)

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	for i = 1 to 7
		res = pe1.Line(Basla + (i-1) * satirAra, sol, 0, sag- sol)
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S

Public Grid, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, SagMargin, SolMargin, UstMargin, Altmargin, ToplamGenislik, satirBaslangic, SatirPozr
Public SatirYuksekligi, KumulatifBorc, KumulatifAlacak, KumulatifBorcBakiyesi, KumulatifAlacakBakiyesi,NakYekunBorc, NakYekunAlacak 
Public SolBorc, SolAlacak, SolBorcBakiye, SolAlacakBakiye, GenislikBorc, GenislikAlacak, GenislikBorcBakiye, GenislikAlacakBakiye
Public SiraNo, YaziFlag
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1,sayfaTuru
	
	sayfaTuru = LISTEE.OPT132(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	ToplamGenislik = 0
	SatirNo = 0
	If Doc.Is_EY1(SayfaTuru) = 0 Then
		sayfaBoyu = 279.4 'Letter
		sayfaEni = 210
	Else
		sayfaBoyu = 279.4 'US Std Fanfold
		sayfaEni = 349.5		
	End If
	SolMargin = 6
	Ustmargin = 10
	AltMargin = Sayfaeni - 15
	SagMargin = Sayfaboyu - 6
	satirNo = 1
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 48
	YaziFlag = ""

	If LISTEE.SATIR_YUKSEKLIGI(1) = 0 Then
		SatirYuksekligi = 4.5
	Else
		SatirYuksekligi = LISTEE.SATIR_YUKSEKLIGI(1)
	End If
	KumulatifBorc = 0 
	KumulatifAlacak = 0 
	KumulatifBorcBakiyesi = 0 
	KumulatifAlacakBakiyesi = 0
	NakYekunBorc = 0
	NakYekunAlacak = 0
	SiraNo = 0
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Defteri Kebir",SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()

	Call PrintFormSayfaBasi(pe1,satirNo)
	SatirSayisi = LISTET.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi 
		Call PrintformSatir(pe1,i)
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaBasi(pe1,SatirNo)
	sSatir = 6

	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	TarihBaslangic = doc.StrToNorDate(LISTEE.TARIHB(1))
	TarihBitis = doc.StrToNorDate(LISTEE.TARIHE(1))
	Donem = TarihBaslangic & " - " & TarihBitis

	MaliTarihBaslangic = doc.StrToNorDate(LISTEE.MTARIHB(1))
	MaliTarihBitis = doc.StrToNorDate(LISTEE.MTARIHE(1))
	MaliDonem = MaliTarihBaslangic & " - " & MaliTarihBaslangic

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	Call UnvanYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 5,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - solMargin,FirmaAdi)

	Call AciklamaYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 6, SagMargin - SolMargin, "MÝZAN")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 13,SolMargin,5,20,"Cari Dönem")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,SolMargin + 21,5,150,": " & Donem)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + sSatir,SolMargin,5,20,"Mali Dönem")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,SolMargin + 21,5,150,": " & MaliDonem)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + sSatir, SolMargin, 5,20,"Hesap No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop , SolMargin + 21, 5,100,": " & LISTEE.KOD1 & " - " & LISTEE.KOD2)

	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SutunBasligiYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1)
		Genislik = Grid(i,1)
		If Genislik > 0 Then
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Else
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			End If
			If Genislik > 0 Then
				res = pe1.Write(SatirBaslangic - 12,Sol,10,Genislik - 2,Baslik)
			End If
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			Select Case DegiskenAdi
				Case "BORC"
					SolBorc = Sol
					GenislikBorc = Genislik - 2
				Case "ALACAK"
					SolAlacak = Sol
					GenislikAlacak = Genislik - 2
				Case "BORC_BAKIYESI"
					SolBorcBakiye = Sol
					GenislikBorcBakiye = Genislik - 2
				Case "ALACAK_BAKIYESI"
					SolAlacakBakiye = Sol
					GenislikAlacakBakiye = Genislik - 2
			End Select
			Sol = Sol + Genislik
		End If
	Next
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13,SolMargin,0,SagMargin - SolMargin)

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 2,SolMargin,0,SagMargin - SolMargin)
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSatir(pe1,SatirNo)
	SeviyeSayisi = Doc.Kod_SeviyeSayisi(LISTET.PCODE(satirNo))
	if SeviyeSayisi = 1 then
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 2 * satirYuksekligi
	else
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	end if
	If satirNo = 1 Then
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	ElseIf Sonsatir > AltMargin Then
		Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
		If (satirNo + 1) = LISTET.GetRecCount() Then Exit Sub
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		If satirTipi = 4 Then
			k = SatirNo + 2
		Else 
			k = SatirNo
		End If
		Call PrintFormSayfaBasi(pe1, k)
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
	 	if SeviyeSayisi = 1 then
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + 2 * SatirYuksekligi
		else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		end if
	End If
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
'zebra
	SiraNo = 	SiraNo + 1
	Zebra = LISTEE.ZEBRA_OPT(1) 
	If SiraNo Mod 2 = 1 And Zebra = 1 Then
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(224,255,224))
		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr - 0.2 * SatirYuksekligi,SolMargin,SatirYuksekligi,SagMargin-Solmargin)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	End If
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		Genislik = Grid(i,1)
		If Genislik > 0 Then
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			Degisken = LISTET.GetFieldvalue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			Select Case  Grid(i,4) 
				Case "C"
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				Case "N"	
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)		
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,20,Ondalik)
				Case "D"
					Degisken = Doc.StrToNordate(Degisken)
			End Select
			if SeviyeSayisi > 1 then
				Call DetayKodYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)
			else
				Call AnaKodYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)
			end if
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Sol,5,Genislik-2,Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + Genislik
		End If
	Next
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	exit sub
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Line(Altmargin,SolMargin,0,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	Call KumulatifToplamYaziTipiAyarla(pe1)	
	res = pe1.Write(Altmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1,5,60,"KÜMÜLATÝF TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(Altmargin + 2, SolBorc,5,GenislikBorc,Doc.NumFormat(KumulatifBorc,20,0))
	res = pe1.Write(Altmargin + 2, SolAlacak,5,GenislikAlacak,Doc.NumFormat(KumulatifAlacak,20,0))
	BABakiye = KumulatifBorc - KumulatifAlacak
	If BABakiye > 0 Then
		res = pe1.Write(Altmargin + 2, SolBorcBakiye,5,GenislikBorcBakiye,Doc.NumFormat(BABakiye,20,0))
	ElseIf BABakiye < 0 Then
		res = pe1.Write(Altmargin + 2, SolAlacakBakiye,5,GenislikAlacakBakiye,Doc.NumFormat(Abs(BABakiye),20,0))
	End If
	If SatirTipi = 3 Then
		NakYekunBorc = KumulatifBorc
		NakYekunAlacak = KumulatifAlacak
	Else
		NakYekunBorc = 0
		NakYekunAlacak = 0
	End If
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)		
End Sub

			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = LISTET.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

End Sub

Sub Bicimle(pe1,YaziTipi, Koyu, Italik, AltCizgi, UstCizgi, YaziRengi)
	If trim(YaziTipi) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SetFontName(YaziTipi)
	Else
		res = pe1.SetFontName("Arial")
	End If
	If Koyu = "1" Then
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	End If
	If Italik = "1" Then
		res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	End If
	If AltCizgi = "1" Then
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	End If
	If UstCizgi = "1" Then
		res = pe1.SetStrikeOut(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.SetStrikeOut(0)
	End If
	If trim(YaziRengi) = "" Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	Else
		R = Left(YaziRengi,3)
		G = Mid(YaziRengi,4,3)
		B = Right(YaziRengi,3)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(R,G,B))
	End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	SayfaS = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i=1 To SayfaS
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(32,250,6,25, ": " & i & "/" & SayfaS)
	Next
End Sub

Public SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Yazildi
Sub PrintForm()
	Yazildi = 0
	Set pe1=doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	SayfaEni = 210
	SayfaBoyu = 297

	res=pe1.Open(0,"Mutabakat Mektubu",SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")

	For i = 1 To TL_BORC_ALACAK.GetRecCount()
		If Doc.Is_EY1(TL_BORC_ALACAK.SELECTED(i)) Then
			Call DokumanYarat(pe1,i)
		End If
	Next    
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub
Sub DokumanYarat(pe1,SatirNo)
	if Yazildi > 0 then res = pe1.PageBreak()
	UstMargin = 25
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = sayfaEni - 10

	CHKodu = TL_BORC_ALACAK.KOD(satirNo)

	CHAdi1 = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,""))
	CHAdi2 = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,""))
	Adres1 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,"")
	Adres2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,"")
	Adres3 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,"")
	BorcAlacakTutari = TL_BORC_ALACAK.BORC_BAKIYESI(satirNo) - TL_BORC_ALACAK.ALACAK_BAKIYESI(satirNo)
	If BorcAlacakTutari > 0 Then
		BorcAlacak = "Borç Bakiyesi"
		AlacakBorc = "Alacak Bakiyesi"
	ElseIf BorcAlacakTutari = 0 Then
		BorcAlacak = "Bakiye"
	Else
		BorcAlacak = "Alacak Bakiyesi"
		AlacakBorc = "Borç Bakiyesi"
	End If
	BorcAlacakTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari),20,2)
	HazirlamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun())
	HesapTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(GLOBAL_STACK.HESAPTARIHIE(1))
	Firma = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")


	Icerik1 = "Ýþletmemizdeki cari hesabýnýz " + HesapTarihi + " tarihi itibarýyla " + BorcAlacakTutari1 + " " & Doc.DefaultPB & " "
	Icerik2 = "Yalnýz " & Doc.NumToText_TL(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari)) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB
	Icerik3 =	 Borcalacak + " vermektedir."
	Icerik4 = "Mutabýk olup olmadýðýmýzý bildirmenizi rica ederiz. Saygýlarýmýzla... "

	Not11 = "Mutabakat veya itirazýnýzý 1 (bir) ay içerisinde bildirmediðiniz takdirde"
	Not12 = "T.T.K. 92. maddesi gereði bakýyede mutabýk sayýlacaðýmýzý hatýrlatýrýz."
	Not21 = "Bakýyede mutabýk olmadýðýnýz takdirde bir hesap ekstrenizin gönderilmesini"
	Not22 = "rica ederiz. "
	Not23 = "HATA VE UNUTMA SAKLIDIR"

	Cevap11 = "Ýþletmemizdeki cari hesabýnýz " + HesapTarihi + " tarihi itibarýyla " + BorcAlacakTutari1 + " " + Doc.DefaultPB
	Cevap12 = "Yalnýz " & Doc.NumToText_TL(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari)) & " " + Doc.DefaultPB
	Cevap13 = AlacakBorc + " vermektedir."

	satirAra = 6

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin,SolMargin,5,150,CHAdi1)
	res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin,SagMargin- 40,5,40,"\b Tarih : \b0 " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun))

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,CHAdi2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 4 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres3)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 6 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 7 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik3)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 10 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik4)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 12 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,15,"Not : ")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 12 * satirAra,SolMargin + 16,5,10,"1 : ")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 12 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not11)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 13 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not12)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 14 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not13)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 15 * satirAra,SolMargin + 16,5,10,"2 : ")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 15 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not21)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 16 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not22)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 17 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not23)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 21 * satirAra,SagMargin-100,10,100,Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0"))


	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 25 * satirAra,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 25 * satirAra + 1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)

	cBasla = UstMargin + 27 * satirAra
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap11)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 2 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap12)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 3 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap13)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 6 * satirAra,SagMargin-50,5,30,"Kaþe - Ýmza")

	Yazildi = Yazildi + 1
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : MetiketS

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Sol, EtiketEni
Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 100
	Ustmargin = 2
	SolMargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 96
	EtiketEni = 96
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = 0
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1
	sayfaEtiketSayisi = EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	satir = STOK20T.GetCurrentRow()
	For i = satir to satir
		EtiketAdedi = 1
		for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
			Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
			if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
				KutuMiktari = Kalan
			else
				KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
			end if

			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for k = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor(Doc.Div((EtiketNo-1), EndenEtiketSayisi)) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				if EtiketNo Mod EndenEtiketSayisi = 1 then
					Sol = SolMargin
				else
					Sol = SolMargin + xEtiketSayisi * (EtiketEni + EndenEtiketlerArasi)
				end if	
				if (EtiketNo mod sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1 or sayfaEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * (EtiketBoyu + BoydanEtiketlerArasi)
				end if
				Ust = Ustmargin
				Sol = SolMargin
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		Next
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
	sag = Sol + EtiketEni

	StokKodu = STOK20T.KOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	Birim = STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	IslemMiktari = STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	SeriNo = STOK20T.SERINO(satirNo)
	if trim(SeriNo) <> "" Then
		IslemMiktari = IslemMiktari & " "&"(" & trim(SeriNo) & ")"
	End if
	MPSNo = STOK20T.MPSNO(satirNo)
	MPSTRNUM = STOK20T.MPSTM_TRNUM(satirNo)
	Siparisno = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10TM", "MUSTERISIPINO", MPSNo+MPSTRNUM, "EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
	mSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", Siparisno, "")
	Standart = STOK20T.ISEMRINO(satirNo)
	Tip = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KABLO_TUR", 0)
	Kesit = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "KESIT", 0)
	Gerilim = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", StokKodu, "GERILIM", 0)
	MakaraNo = STOK20T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)

	Basla = Ust + 15
	satirAra = 13
	Genislik = 28
	Blok1 = sol + Genislik

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust - 1, Sol, 12, sag - sol, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla - 4, Sol + 18, 5, sag - Sol - 20, "www.atom.com.tr")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "DRUM NO")
	'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": ")
		'res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & mSipNo)

  res = pe1.selectFont("Arial",10)	
	'res = pe1.write(54,5,6,25,"Makara No")
	'res = pe1.BarCode(5,32,20,50,"Code128",Trim(MakaraNo),"") 
	res = pe1.BarCode(10,50,20,50,"Code128",Trim(MakaraNo),"") 






	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + satirAra + 5, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "TYPE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Tip)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 2 * satirAra + 2, Sol + 1, 12, Genislik, "CROSS SECTION")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Kesit)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 3 * satirAra + 5, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "STANDARD")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 18)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 2, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Standart)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 4 * satirAra + 5, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "METRE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 1, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & IslemMiktari )

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla + 5 * satirAra + 5, Sol + 1, 10, Genislik, "VOLTAGE")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 10, sag - Blok1, ": " & Gerilim)

	'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 13)
	'res = pe1.Write(Basla + 6 * satirAra + 3, Sol + 1, 6, Genislik, "DRUM NO")
	'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	'res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, Blok1, 6, sag - Blok1, ": " & MakaraNo)

 






	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	for i = 2 to 7
		res = pe1.Line(Basla + (i-1) * satirAra, sol, 0, sag- sol)
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : AT2010 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : OEE-001
Hangi Tablo için : OSF312
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : OSF312 // Günlük Çalýþma Bildirimi 09MRT160410
Kod : 
Public SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, SolMargin, SagMargin, 	UstMargin, AltMargin, SatirYuksekligi, SatirBaslangic, SayfaSatirSayisi, SatirPozR, vTable
Public KutuGenislik, KutuYukseklik, AltBlokYukseklik, xSatirNo, SatirUretimSureToplami, UretimSure
Public TezgahGunlukCalisma, PlanliDurusSuresi, 	AyarSetupSure, DurusSure 
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
	SayfaBoyu = 297
	SayfaEni  = 210
	SolMargin = 5
	SagMargin = 5
	UstMargin = 5
	AltMargin = 5 
	SatirYuksekligi = 5
	SatirBaslangic = UstMargin+35
	SayfaSatirSayisi= 33
	AltBlokYukseklik= 50
	TezgahGunlukCalisma = 0
	PlanliDurusSuresi = 0
	AyarSetupSure = 0
	DurusSure = 0
	UretimSure = 0
	SatirUretimSureToplami = 0
	KutuGenislik = SayfaEni - (SolMargin + SagMargin)
	KutuYukseklik= SayfaBoyu- (UstMargin + AltMargin+15)
	Set Pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Res = Pe1.Open(0, "Atom", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",9)

	TezgahKodu = LISTEE2_DIGERKRITERLER.X_T_ISMERKEZI		
	If Trim(TezgahKodu) = "" Then
		Msgbox "Lütfen Ýþ Merkezini seçiniz!..."
		Exit Sub
	Else
		TezgahGunlukCalisma = TezGunCalisma(TezgahKodu)
	End If

	Call Alanlar()
	Call SayfaBasi(Pe1)
	Kayitsayisi = LISTET2.GetRecCount()	 
	For I=1 To Kayitsayisi
		Call SatirYazdir(Pe1, i)
		Fark = Doc.DTDTDif1(LISTET2.RECTARIH1(i), LISTET2.RECTIME1(i), LISTET2.RECTARIH2(i), LISTET2.RECTIME2(i))
		If trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "A" Then
			AyarSetupSure =  AyarSetupSure + Fark
		ElseIf trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "D" Then
			DurusSure = DurusSure + Fark
			DurusTipi = Trim(LISTET2.DURMA_SEBEBI(i))
			PDMi = PlanliDurus(DurusTipi)
			If Trim(PDmi) = "E" Then
				PlanliDurusSuresi = PlanliDurusSuresi + Fark
			End If
		ElseIf trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(i)) = "U" Then
			UretimSure = UretimSure + Fark
		End If
		satirno=satirno+1
		Fark = 0
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(Pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(Pe1)
	' Logo
	LogoW = 33
	LogoH = (SatirYuksekligi*2)
	Logo = Trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")))
	Res = Pe1.Nopen()
	Res = Pe1.Picture(UstMargin+5, SolMargin+1, LogoH, LogoW, Logo,0)
	' dýþ kutu
	Res = Pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	Res = Pe1.Box(UstMargin+15, SolMargin, KutuYukseklik, KutuGenislik)
	' yatay çizgiler
	Lbasla = UstMargin+15
	For I=1 To 42
		If I=4 Then
			Lbasla = Lbasla+(SatirYuksekligi*2)
		Else
			Lbasla = Lbasla+SatirYuksekligi
		End If	
		Res = Pe1.Line(Lbasla, SolMargin, 0, KutuGenislik)
	Next
	' dikey çizgiler
	xUst = UstMargin+30
	xSol = SolMargin
	xYukseklik = 200
	For Z=0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		KolonGenisligi = Grid(Z, 1) 
		xHeader = Grid(Z, 2)
	 	Res = Pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Res = Pe1.Line (xUst, xSol, xYukseklik, 0)	
		Res = Pe1.Write(xUst, xSol+1, 2*SatirYukSekligi, KolonGenisligi-1, xHeader)	
		xSol= xSol + KolonGenisligi
	Next	
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+21, SolMargin+  1, 4, 15, "AD")
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+16, SolMargin+134, 4, 45, "TARÝH :"& " " & Doc.StrToNorDate(LISTEE2_DIGERKRITERLER.TARIH))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+21, SolMargin+134, 4, 45, "DAÝRE :")
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+25, SolMargin+134, 4, 45, "MAKÝNE:"& " " & Trim(LISTEE2_DIGERKRITERLER.X_T_ISMERKEZI))
	Res = Pe1.Line(UstMargin+15, SolMargin+ 14, 3*SatirYukSekligi, 0)
	Res = Pe1.Line(UstMargin+15, SolMargin+132, 3*SatirYukSekligi, 0)
	Ust = UstMargin + 10
	For J=1 To 3
		Ust = Ust + Satiryuksekligi
		PersAdi = Trim(LISTET2.IS_OPERATOR_1_PERS00_AD(J))
		res = pe1.write(ust, SolMargin+16, 4, 50, PersAdi)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, satirno)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	Degisken = ""
	Sol = SolMargin
	If satirno =1 Then
		satirpozr = SatirBaslangic
	End If
	If satirno = SayfaSatirSayisi Then
'		Call sayfasonu(pe1)
		Res = Pe1.PageBreak
		satirno=1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		satirpozr = satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
	End If
	
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		If Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_FisNo" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.EVRAKNO(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_MpsNo" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.MPSNO(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_UrunAdi" Then
			StokKodu = LISTET2.STOK_CODE(satirno)
			Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")	
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_Operasyon" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.OPERASYON(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_MakinaHýzý" Then
			Degisken = ""
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_UretilenMiktar" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_BaslamaZamani" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.RECTIME1(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_BitisZamani" Then
			Degisken = LISTET2.RECTIME2(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_BeklemeNedeni" Then
			NedenKodu = LISTET2.DURMA_SEBEBI(satirno)
			If trim(NedenKodu)<>"" Then
				Degisken = Doc.GetGecoValue("DURMAS", "AD", NedenKodu, -1)
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_AyarUretimDurus" Then
				Degisken = LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(satirno)
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_Performans" Then
				xPerformans = LISTET2.OEE_PERFORMANS(satirno)
				If Trim(LISTET2.D7_ISLEM_KODU(satirno))="U" Then
					xFark = Doc.DTDTDif1(LISTET2.RECTARIH1(satirno), LISTET2.RECTIME1(satirno), LISTET2.RECTARIH2(satirno), LISTET2.RECTIME2(satirno))
					SatirUretimSureToplami = SatirUretimSureToplami + (Doc.Div((xFark * xPerformans),100))
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(xPerformans,10,2)
				Else
					Degisken = ""
				End If
		ElseIf Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_Vardiya" Then
				Degisken = LISTET2.VARDIYA(satirno)
		End If

		If Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_UretilenMiktar" Or Trim(DegiskenAdi) = "_Performans" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		Else
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End If

		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol+1, SatirYuksekligi, SutunGenisligi-2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
End Sub

Function TezGunCalisma(vTezgahKodu)
	TezGunCalisma = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT00", "B_KAPASITE", vTezgahKodu, "")
End Function

Function PlanliDurus(vDurusTipi)
	Set vTable = Doc.Select1("xTable","TABL73T","DURMA_SEBEBI='"+vDurusTipi+"'" ,"", -1) 
	If vTable.GetRowCount>0 Then 
		PlanliDurus = "E"
	Else
		PlanliDurus = "H"
	End If
End Function

Sub SayfaSonu(Pe1)
	Res = Pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",10)

	PlansizDurusSure    = (DurusSure - PlanliDurusSuresi) * 60
	AyarSetupSure       = AyarSetupSure * 60
	TezgahGunlukCalisma = TezgahGunlukCalisma * 60
	PlanliDurusSuresi   = PlanliDurusSuresi * 60
	SurelerToplami      = (AyarSetupSure + DurusSure + UretimSure) * 60
	ToplamUretimSuresi  = UretimSure * 60
	PlanlananUretimSure = SatirUretimSureToplami * 60
	SoylenmeyenSure     = TezgahGunlukCalisma - SurelerToplami

'	xAV = Doc.Div((TezgahGunlukCalisma-PlanliDurusSuresi-AyarSetupSure-PlansizDurusSure),(TezgahGunlukCalisma-PlanliDurusSuresi))*100
	xAV = Doc.Div((TezgahGunlukCalisma-PlanliDurusSuresi-AyarSetupSure-PlansizDurusSure),(TezgahGunlukCalisma-PlanliDurusSuresi))

	xPF = Doc.Div(PlanlananUretimSure, ToplamUretimSuresi)*100
	xQ  = 1
	xOEE = (xAV * xPF * xQ) / 100

	xUstMarj = (UstMargin+15) + (SatirYuksekligi*44)
	xSutunGenisligi = KutuGenislik / 4

	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+1, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "Süreler Toplamý :" & " " & SurelerToplami)
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+  xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "Ayar/Setup (A) :" & " " & (AyarSetupSure*60))
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+2*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "Üretim (U)     :" & " " & (UretimSure*60))
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+3*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "Durus (D)      :" & " " & (DurusSure*60))

	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj+Satiryuksekligi, SolMargin+1, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "Soylenmeyen Süre :" & " " & SoylenmeyenSure)


	xUstMarj = xUstMarj + (SatirYuksekligi*2)
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+  xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "AV =" & " " & Doc.NumFormat(xAV,10,2))
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+2*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "PF =" & " " & Doc.NumFormat(xPF,10,2))
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+3*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "OEE=" & " " & Doc.NumFormat(xOEE,10,2))
	xUstMarj = xUstMarj + (SatirYuksekligi*5)
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+1, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "ONAY :__________")
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+  xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "ONAY :__________")
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+2*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "ONAY :__________")
	res = pe1.write(xUstMarj, SolMargin+3*xSutunGenisligi, SatirYuksekligi, xSutunGenisligi-2, "ONAY :__________")

End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, satirNo)
res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
	
	if pe1.GetBottom() > satirSonu then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	else
		if satirNo = 1 then
			satirPozr = satirBaslangic
		else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		end if
	end if
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 8)

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 35
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 18
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 18
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 8

	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 152
	satirSonu = altmargin-65
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ýþe Giriþ Bildirgesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSM0.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 7,SolMargin,8,SagMargin - SolMargin,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
'		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
'		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 3,SolMargin+5,18,60,logo,114)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin - 2,SolMargin,8,SagMargin - SolMargin,Firma)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
		Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
		CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)

		CHAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,-1)

		Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
		Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1)

		SatirAra = 6

		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Adres2)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"FAX NO")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Faks)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 182, 6,15,"TARÝH")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			If i = 3 Or i = 5 Or i = 7 Then
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1)
			Else
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			End If
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 12, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
