Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin-4, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin+4, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	SatirBitis = SatirBaslangic + 10 * satiryuksekligi
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 47.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		If i <> 5 And i <> 3 Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next
'notlarla toplam arasýndaki dikey çizgi
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(4) , 27, 0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(2) , AltMargin - UstMargin -74.5 - cizgiBoyu , 0)
'kutu çiz- lütfen onaylayýn kutusu
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2), 8 , SagMargin - xCizgi(2))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+76.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2)+2, 5, SagMargin - xCizgi(2)-4, "LÜTFEN FORMU ONAYLAYARAK FÝRMAMIZA GERÝ FAKSLAYINIZ ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
'yatay çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 21, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 47.5, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 27, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

' notlar mesajlar
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 2, 5,20,"NOTLAR")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 22, 5,3,":")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	satirpozr=SatirBitis + 2 - SatirYuksekligi
		Not1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
		If trim(Not1)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not1)
		If trim(Not2)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not2)
		
		
		If rows > 3 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 3 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
		
		For i = 1 To rows
			If i > 3 Then Exit For
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
			If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Solmargin + 25, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120,Mesaj)		
		Next

	Ondalik = Grid(7,6)
	ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
	IskontoOrani = STOK46E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI(1)
	IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVOrani = STOK46E.DO_KDV_ORANI(1)

	ToplamTutar = SayiBicimle(ToplamTutar,Ondalik,1,1)
	IskontoOrani = SayiBicimle(IskontoOrani,Ondalik,1,1)
	IskontoToplami = SayiBicimle(IskontoToplami,Ondalik,1,1)
	NetTutar = SayiBicimle(NetTutar,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVOrani = SayiBicimle(KDVOrani,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVTutari = SayiBicimle(KDVTutari,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVDahilTutar = SayiBicimle(KDVDahilTutar,Ondalik,1,1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	
	sss = SatirYuksekligi

	SatirYuksekligi = 4.7

	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,40,"ÝSKONTO %  " & IskontoOrani)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"NET TOPLAM")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"GENEL TOPLAM")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, ToplamTutar)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, IskontoToplami)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi - 1,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, NetTutar)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,12,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, KDVTutari)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 4 * satirYuksekligi - 1,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, KDVDahilTutar)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
	SatirYuksekligi = sss
	GAlt = pe1.GetBottom() - 5
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	GAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+85 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4),6,xCizgi(6) - xCizgi(4), "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	sayfaEni = 297

	ToplamTutar = 0

	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,6) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)
'	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
'	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
'	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "NOTE0"
'	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

'	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 70
'	Grid(6,1) = 14
'	Grid(7,1) = 32
'	Grid(8,1) = 14

'	Grid(0,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"
	Grid(1,2) = "Açýklama (Description)"
	Grid(2,2) = "Teslim Tarihi (Delivery Date)"
	Grid(3,2) = "Miktar (Quantity)"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "Notlar (Notes)"
'	Grid(6,2) = ""
'	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
'	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
'	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
'	Grid(6,4) = "C"
'	Grid(7,4) = "N"
'	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 20)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3,SolMargin,8,SagMargin - SolMargin,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		
logo =Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")
res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin - 3,SolMargin+5,18,60,logo,114)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
		Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
		CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
		CHAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1) 
		CHAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,-1) 
		CHAdi = trim(CHAdi) & " " & trim(CHAdi2)
		Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
		Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1)
		
		
		SiparisiAlan = STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1)
		SiparisiVeren = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+17
		SatirAra = 6
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"TEDARÝKÇÝ FÝRMA")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,143,CHAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"ADRESÝ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,85,Adres1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Adres2)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Adres3)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"FAX NO")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Faks)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 182, 6,15,"TARÝH")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 212, 6,50,": " & Tarih)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,26,"SÝPARÝÞ NO")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 212, 6,50,": " & trim(SiparisNo))
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,26,"ÖDEME ÞEKLÝ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 212,6,50,": " & trim(STOK46E.ODEMEGUNU(1)) & " gün")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,30,"NAKLÝYE ÞEKLÝ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 212,6,50,": " & trim(STOK46E.NAKLIYECIFIRMA(1)))


' Sütun baþlýklarý
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			If i = 3 Or i = 5 Or i = 7 Then
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1)
			Else
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			End If
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 12, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin-4, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin+4, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	SatirBitis = SatirBaslangic + 10 * satiryuksekligi
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 47.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		If i <> 5 And i <> 3 Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next
'notlarla toplam arasýndaki dikey çizgi
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(4) , 27, 0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(2) , AltMargin - UstMargin -74.5 - cizgiBoyu , 0)
'kutu çiz- lütfen onaylayýn kutusu
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2), 8 , SagMargin - xCizgi(2))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+76.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2)+2, 5, SagMargin - xCizgi(2)-4, "LÜTFEN FORMU ONAYLAYARAK FÝRMAMIZA GERÝ FAKSLAYINIZ ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
'yatay çizgiler
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 21, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 47.5, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 27, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

' notlar mesajlar
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 2, 5,20,"NOTLAR")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 22, 5,3,":")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	satirpozr=SatirBitis + 2 - SatirYuksekligi
		Not1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
		If trim(Not1)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not1)
		If trim(Not2)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not2)
		
		
		If rows > 3 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 3 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
		
		For i = 1 To rows
			If i > 3 Then Exit For
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
			If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Solmargin + 25, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120,Mesaj)		
		Next

	Ondalik = Grid(7,6)
	ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
	IskontoOrani = STOK46E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI(1)
	IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVOrani = STOK46E.DO_KDV_ORANI(1)

	ToplamTutar = SayiBicimle(ToplamTutar,Ondalik,1,1)
	IskontoOrani = SayiBicimle(IskontoOrani,Ondalik,1,1)
	IskontoToplami = SayiBicimle(IskontoToplami,Ondalik,1,1)
	NetTutar = SayiBicimle(NetTutar,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVOrani = SayiBicimle(KDVOrani,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVTutari = SayiBicimle(KDVTutari,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVDahilTutar = SayiBicimle(KDVDahilTutar,Ondalik,1,1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	
	sss = SatirYuksekligi

	SatirYuksekligi = 4.7

	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,40,"ÝSKONTO %  " & IskontoOrani)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"NET TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,40,"KDV %  " & KDVOrani)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"GENEL TOPLAM")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, ToplamTutar)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, IskontoToplami)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi - 1,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, NetTutar)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,12,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, KDVTutari)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 4 * satirYuksekligi - 1,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, KDVDahilTutar)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
	SatirYuksekligi = sss
	GAlt = pe1.GetBottom() - 5
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(GAlt + 6, SolMargin + 2,6,xCizgi(2) - SolMargin - 4, "GENEL ÞARTLAR")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.WriteRTFFile(GAlt + 11, SolMargin + 2,38,xCizgi(2) - SolMargin - 4, "..\doc\genel.rtf")

	GAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+85 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4),6,xCizgi(6) - xCizgi(4), "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+85 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(6),6,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6), "SÝPARÝÞÝ ALAN")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+82.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4), AltMargin - UstMargin - 82.5 - cizgiBoyu ,0)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+82.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(6), AltMargin - UstMargin - 82.5 - cizgiBoyu ,0)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+90.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4), 0,sagMargin - xCizgi(4))



	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+94.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2) + 2,6,30, "ADI SOYADI")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+100.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2) + 2,6,30, "TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+106.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2) + 2,6,30, "KAÞE-ÝMZA")

'	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+94.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4) + 2,6,xCizgi(6) - xCizgi(4) - 4, STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1))
'	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+94.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6) - 4, STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1))
'	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+100.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4) + 2,6,xCizgi(6) - xCizgi(4) - 4, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1)))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin +0.5,SagMargin - 35,6,35,"741 F 04 Rev.2")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
Grid(9,0) = "NOTE0"


	Grid(0,1) = 40
	Grid(1,1) = 40
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 25
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 15
	Grid(8,1) = 14
Grid(9,1) = "20"

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
Grid(9,2) = "NOTLAR"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
Grid(9,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	sayfaEni = 210

	satirBaslangic = 0

	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 124
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 10

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  290, 210,"")

	Call Alanlar()
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 30, sagMargin - 150, 5, 150, "Sayfa : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,6)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(1,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(3,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(6,0) = "NOTE0"

	Grid(0,1) = 71
	Grid(1,1) = 15
	Grid(2,1) = 11
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 40

	Grid(0,2) = "Ürün Tanýmý / Description"
	Grid(1,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(2,2) = ""
	Grid(3,2) = "Teslim Tarihi/ Delivery Date"
	Grid(4,2) = "Fiyat / Price"
	Grid(5,2) = ""
	Grid(6,2) = "Notlar / Notes"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			If AlanAdi = "OR_TUTAR" Then
				ondalik = 2
			Else
				ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(AlanAdi)
			End If
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	


End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	STOK46T.SafePack()
	if STOK46T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 0
	AltMargin = UstMargin + 287
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 124
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  290, 210,"")

	Call Alanlar()

	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaNoYazdir(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,6)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(1,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(3,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(6,0) = "NOTE0"

	Grid(0,1) = 71
	Grid(1,1) = 15
	Grid(2,1) = 11
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 12
	Grid(6,1) = 40

	Grid(0,2) = "Ürün Tanýmý / Description"
	Grid(1,2) = "Miktar/ Quantity"
	Grid(2,2) = ""
	Grid(3,2) = "Teslim Tarihi/ Delivery Date"
	Grid(4,2) = "Fiyat / Price"
	Grid(5,2) = ""
	Grid(6,2) = "Notlar / Notes"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "N"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			If AlanAdi = "OR_TUTAR" Then
				ondalik = 2
			Else
				ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(AlanAdi)
			End If
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	


End Sub
Sub SayfaNoYazdir(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 15, sagMargin - 40, 5, 40, "Sayfa : " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi - Mamuller"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	STOK20T.SafePack()
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK20T.GetRowCount() 

	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 12
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 35
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 95
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 121
	Blok30 = SolMargin + 188
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 214

	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	
	BBasla = 30
	SatirAra = 5
	FisNo = STOK20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK20E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK20E.ONAYEH1(1)
	FasonMu = STOK20E.FASONNORMAL(1)
	OtomatikRez = STOK20E.MPSSREZ1(1)
	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK20E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK20E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Fason/Normal")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FasonMu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin+0.5
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi-1, Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)) =	Sol-0.5
			Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next
	Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = STOK20T.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = STOK20T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If STOK20T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 0.5, SagMargin - 80,5,80,"14.05.2008 700 F 05 Rev.0")
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
	
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
