Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, S20T
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	STOK20T.SafePack()
	Set S20T = Doc.Select2("sasdfs", "STOK20T", "", "", -1)
	S20T.GroupBy2("KOD+LOTNUMBER+SF_VRI_VR_R3+SF_VRI_VR_R1+SF_VRI_VR_R2")

	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi - Mamuller"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()


	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To S20T.GetRowCount()
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 35
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 95
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 121
	Blok30 = SolMargin + 188
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 214

	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	
	BBasla = 30
	SatirAra = 5
	FisNo = STOK20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK20E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK20E.ONAYEH1(1)
	FasonMu = STOK20E.FASONNORMAL(1)
	OtomatikRez = STOK20E.MPSSREZ1(1)
	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK20E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK20E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Fason/Normal")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FasonMu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin+0.5
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi-1, Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)) =	Sol-0.5
			Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next
	Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = S20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = S20T.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = S20T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If S20T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = S20T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = S20T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.setAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 0.5, SagMargin - 80,5,80,"14.05.2008 700 F 05 Rev.0")
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
	
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi, ToplamTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Depolar Arasý Transfer Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK26T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK26T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 6
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
	satirSonu = AltMargin 
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 140
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 161
	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK26E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK26E.TARIH(1))
	CikisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.AMBCODE(1)
	CikisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",CikisAmbarKodu,"")  
	GirisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	GirisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",GirisAmbarKodu,"")  

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Veren Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(CikisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(CikisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Alan Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(GirisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(GirisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Evrak No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FisNo)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

  KutuAlt = pe1.GetBottom() 




'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK26T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			elseIf DegiskenAdi = "_SIPNOTU" Then
				SiparisArtikelNo = STOK26T.ALLOC_SIPARTNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","NOTES",SiparisArtikelNo,"ARTNO")
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+1 , SolMargin + 230, 6,45,"03.01.2002 / 741 F 08 Rev.0")


'dikey çizgiler
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(4,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(5,0) = "_SIPNOTU"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 11		
	Grid(1,1) = 41		
	Grid(2,1) = 70		
	Grid(3,1) = 25		
	Grid(4,1) = 30		
	Grid(5,1) = 70		
	Grid(6,1) = 25		
	Grid(7,1) = 13		

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"	
	Grid(1,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Sipariþ Notu"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(7,2) = "Birim"				

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "C"	
	Grid(6,4) = "N"	
	Grid(7,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK26T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, S29T

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	toplammiktar=0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Ambar Giriþ Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	STOK29T.SafePack()
	Set S29T = Doc.Select2("sseeww", "STOK29T", "", "", -1)
	S29T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	For i = 1 to S29T.GetRowCount()
		set S29rr = Doc.Select2("de", "STOK29T", "KOD='"+S29T.KOD(i)+"'", "", -1)
		if S29rr.getRowCount() > 0 Then
			S29T.OR_FIYAT(i) =  S29rr.OR_FIYAT
			S29T.TL_FIYAT(i) =  S29rr.TL_FIYAT
		End if
	Next
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 45
	Call Alanlar()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To S29T.GetRecCount
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	res = pe1.Write(162, xCizgi(5) -27, 6,50,"TOPLAM MÝKTAR")

	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")

	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.Write(162, xCizgi(5) -27, 6,50,"ARA TOPLAM MÝKTAR")

		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = S29T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			If degiskenAdi = "OR_TUTAR" Then
				ToplamTutar = ToplamTutar + Degisken
			elseIf degiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
				Toplammiktar = Toplammiktar + Degisken

			End If
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Teklif Hammadde Ýhtiyaç Analizi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	satirSayisi_tableT = TEKL20TM.GetRecCount() 

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	FisNo = TEKL20E.EVRAKNO(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 20, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 65, 6, 15, "Ambar ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 81, 6, 40, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 155, 6, 15, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 35, 6, 65, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 101, 6, 25, "Hareket Kodu")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 126, 6, 65, ": " & trim(HareketKodu) & "  "  & Trim(Hareket))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Notlar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 35, 6, SayfaEni - 60, ": " & trim(Notlar) )
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = TEKL20TM.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
	  LineX = xCizgi(i)
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","TEKL20TM")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = TEKL20TM.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public OperasyonSatirNo, MPS10T, MPS10E, MPS10TM
Public ustmargin, solmargin, Sayfaeni, SagMargin

Sub PrintForm()   
	Dim pe1
	ustmargin=10
	solmargin=10
	Sayfaeni=210	
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	OperasyonSatirNo = 0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Listeleri",297,210,"")
	if Doc.GetDocType = "MMPS10" Then
		Set MPS10E = Doc.Select2("s3h33hdfghd", "MMPS10E", "" ,"", -1)
		Set MPS10T = Doc.Select2("s3h33hdfddd33rd", "MMPS10T", "" ,"", -1)
		Set MPS10TM = Doc.Select2("s3h3d", "MMPS10TM", "" ,"", -1)
		
		Call PrintMPS(pe1)		
	Else
		Call MMPS30_Print(pe1)
	End if
	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i=1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		Baslik = Trim(CStr(i)) + " / " + Trim(CStr(pe1.GetPageCount()))	
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(282,10,6,190,"- \b Sayfa : \b0  " & Baslik & " -") 	   
	Next   
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub MMPS30_Print(pe1)
	for i = 1 to MMPS30T.GetRecCount()	
		MPSNo = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
		if trim(MPSNo) <> "" then
			rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10E","EVRAKNO",MPSNo)
			Set MPS10E = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_MMPS10E_SELECT")
			rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10T","EVRAKNO",MPSNo)
			Set MPS10T = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_MMPS10T_SELECT")
			rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10TM","EVRAKNO",MPSNo)
			Set MPS10TM = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_MMPS10TM_SELECT")

			if trim(MMPS30T.SELECTED(i))="E" then
				s=s+1
				
				if s > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
				End if
				Call PrintMPS(pe1)
			End if
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Sub PrintMPS(pe1)
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	siraNo = 0
	For t=1 to satirsayisi
		if trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(t)) = "I" then
			m=m+1
		end if
	next
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
		if trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" then
			s=s+1
			Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
			if m<>s then
				Res=pe1.pagebreak()
			end if
			call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		end if
	Next	
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
  	res = pe1.nopen()

'*******************
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin - 5,SolMargin + 2, 6,180,FirmaAdi)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		MPSRefNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)

		MamulKodu = MPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
		MamulAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",MamulKodu,"")
		UretimSipNo = MPS10E.MUSTERISIPINO(1)
		GrupNo = MPS10E.GRUPEVRAKNO(1)
		ToleransTipi = MPS10E.TOLERANSTYPE(1)
		Tolerans = MPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,"")

		MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
'		MusteriAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,"")
'		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,"")
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+7
		SatirAra = 6
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"MPS Ref No")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,trim(MPSRefNo))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MamulKodu & "   " & MamulAdi)
'		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,MamulAdi)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,45,MamulMiktari & "  " & trim(StokBirimi))
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 85, 6,85,"(Tolerans : " & ToleransTipi & " % " & _
									Tolerans & ")")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Teslim Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,TeslimTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Müþteri")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MusteriAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Notlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not1)
		If trim(Not2) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not2)
		End If
		Alt = pe1.GetBottom()

		res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, SolMargin, Alt - BBasla + 2,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	'	Call Normal(pe1)

End Sub
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirno)
	
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 7
	satirSonu = 272
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)
	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		rSiraNo = trim(MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
		For j=1 To MPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)

			 satirpozr = 62
		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 62
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",IsMerkeziKodu,-1)
		OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
		OperasyonAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
		MamulPaketSayisi = MPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketSayisi = MPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = MPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YariMamulPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = MPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = FormatNumber(ToplamYariMamulMiktari,0,,,-1)
		BaslamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MPS10T.R_LATEST_B_TARIH(SatirNo))
		BitisTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MPS10T.R_LATEST_E_TARIH(SatirNo))

		res = pe1.NoPen()
		rSiraNo = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		m = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
		If m > 0 Then
			Boy = 3 * iSatir	+ 3
		Else
			Boy = 4 * iSatir - 2
		End If 
		
		BaslikBasla = SatirPozr - 3
		ToplamSatir = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
		DisBoy = ToplamSatir + 3 * iSatir

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(118,216,195))
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla, 10,Boy,190)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'barkodun arka planý
		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr -3, 10 ,Boy,70)

'gerçekleþen kutularý
'		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + iSatir - 1, 170,6,25)
'		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + 2 * iSatir - 1,170, 6,25)

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		If Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(BaslikBasla + Boy,10,0,190)						
		End If

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

'		res = pe1.SetRotation(270)
		ArtNo = MPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)
		pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr , 13,20,65,"CODE128",ArtNo,"")
		res = pe1.SetRotation(0)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,82,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,110,6,60,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,82,6,25,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,110,6,60,": " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(OperasyonAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,82,6,25,"Üretim Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,110,6,60,": " & MamulPaketSayisi & " x " & YariMamulPaketSayisi & " x " & YariMamulPaketIcerigi & _
																		" = " & ToplamYariMamulMiktari)

'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,145,6,25,"Planlanan")
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,170,6,25,"Gerçekleþen")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,150,6,20,"ONAY   :")

'		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,145,0,25)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,170,0,25)

'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,120,6,25,"Baþlama Tarihi")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")		
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,145,6,25,BaslamaTarihi)
		
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,120,6,25,"Bitiþ Tarihi")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")		
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,145,6,25,BitisTarihi)
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

'mühendislik tanýmlarý
		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
		BaslikBitis = satirPozr
		Call muhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)

'		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2 * iSatir		
		If Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			HSatirBaslangic = satirpozr + iSatir
		Else
			HSatirBaslangic = BaslikBasla + Boy
		End If
		If m > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic,10,0,190)						
		End If 

		HSatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 5
		For j=1 To MPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(j)
			KaynakTipi1 = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				sonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
				If sonSatir1 >= satirSonu Then
			  		 res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,sonSatir1 - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
					 siraNo = 1
					 res = pe1.PageBreak()
					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					 satirpozr = 62
					 BaslikBasla = 62
					 HSatirBaslangic = 62
					 k = 0
				End If
				res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
				If (k Mod 2) = 0 Then
					res = pe1.NoPen()					
					res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
					res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(213,239,215))
					res = pe1.Box(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir - 1,10,6,190)
				End If
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
				HammaddeKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,50,6,80,HammaddeAdi)

				HammaddeMiktar = MPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)
				HammaddeMiktar = FormatNumber(HammaddeMiktar,0,,,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,135,6,30,HammaddeMiktar)

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,168,6,10,HammaddeBirim)
				k = k + 1
			End If
		Next
		HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla-1,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
	End If 
End Sub
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	MamulKodu = MPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	satirYuksekligi	= 7

	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	If SatirSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 20, 5,165,Tanim)
	Next

	SipOpGK3 = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40T", MPS10TM.MUSTERISIPIARTNO, "OPGK3", 0)
	if trim(SipOpGK3) <> "" Then
		if trim(SipOpGK3) = trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01", "GK_3", OperasyonKodu, "")) Then
			SipOpNotu = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40T", MPS10TM.MUSTERISIPIARTNO, "OPNOTU", 0)
			if trim(SipOpNotu) <> "" Then
				satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
				res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin, 5, sagMargin - Solmargin, trim(SipOpNotu))
			End if
		End if
	End if
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Function Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	MamulKodu = MPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)

	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")

	MuhendislikSatir = Tech.GetRecCount() * SatirYuksekligi

End Function
Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	SatirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 15
	satiryuksekligi = 5
'	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 64
	satirSonu = 285

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ýþ Emri", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	For j = 1 to MMPS30T.GetRecCount()
		if Doc.Is_EY1(MMPS30T.Selected(j)) then
			siraNo = 0        
			Rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10E","EVRAKNO",MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(j))
			Set MMPS10E = Doc.getTableObject("AU_MMPS10E_SELECT")

			Rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10T","EVRAKNO",MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(j))
			Set MMPS10T = Doc.getTableObject("AU_MMPS10T_SELECT")

			if j <> 1 then res = pe1.PageBreak

			BaslangicSayfa= pe1.GetPageCount
			satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			SatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			For i = 1 To satirSayisi
				KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
				If KaynakTipi = "I" Then
					Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
				End If
			Next
			satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			sonSayfa = pe1.GetPageCount
			Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1, BaslangicSayfa, sonSayfa)
		end if
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub



Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin - 5,SolMargin + 2, 6,180,FirmaAdi)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		MPSRefNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)

		MamulKodu = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
		MamulAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",MamulKodu,"")
		UretimSipNo = MMPS10E.MUSTERISIPINO(1)
		GrupNo = MMPS10E.GRUPEVRAKNO(1)
		ToleransTipi = MMPS10E.TOLERANSTYPE(1)
		Tolerans = MMPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MMPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,"")

		MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
'		MusteriAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,"")
'		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,"")
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+7
		SatirAra = 6
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"MPS Ref No")

		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,trim(MPSRefNo))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MamulKodu & "   " & MamulAdi)
'		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,MamulAdi)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,45,MamulMiktari & "  " & trim(StokBirimi))
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 85, 6,85,"(Tolerans : " & ToleransTipi & " % " & _
									Tolerans & ")")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Teslim Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,TeslimTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Müþteri")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MusteriAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Notlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not1)

			res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not2)
		End If

		res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
'sss
	If trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)

	Ekler = SatirSatir(SatirNo) + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + Ekler
	
If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
'		If SiraNo = 0 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
'		Else
'				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
'				satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
'		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		

	satirBas = satirPozr

	TezgahKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	TezgahAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00","AD",TezgahKodu,"")
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	OperasyonAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,"")
	MamulPaket = MMPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
	YMamulPaket = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
	YMPaketIcerigi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
	YMMiktari = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)

	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(YMMiktari)
	YMMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(YMMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	Ondalik1 = Doc.SigDig(YMPaketIcerigi)
	YMPaketIcerigi = Doc.NumFormat(YMPaketIcerigi,18,Ondalik1)


	OperasyonSuresi = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(SatirNo)


	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + 2

	Blok2 = SolMargin  + 95

	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Ýþ Merkezi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,Blok2 - SolMargin - 32,": " & trim(TezgahAdi))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, Blok2,5,25,"Üretim Miktarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	UretimMiktari = trim(MamulPaket) & " x " & trim(YMamulPaket) & " x " & trim(YMPaketIcerigi) & _
								" = " & trim(YMMiktari)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(SatirPozr, Blok2 + 26,5,SagMargin - Blok2 - 28,"\b1 :  \b0 " & UretimMiktari)


	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,Blok2 - SolMargin - 32,": " & OperasyonAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, Blok2,5,25,"Oper. Süresi")
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, Blok2 + 26,5,3,":")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, Blok2 + 29,5,15,OperasyonSuresi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, Blok2 + 46,5,12,"SAAT")
	End If
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
	SatirSon = pe1.GetBottom()

	SatirPozr = SatirPozr + 2

	Call MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call MesajYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
	SatirSon = SatirSon + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + 2

	HammaddeSon = SatirSon + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + 2
	
'xxx
	res = pe1.Box(SatirBas ,SolMargin,SatirSon - SatirBas -1,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	If HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) > 0 Then
		res = pe1.Box(SatirSon-1,SolMargin,HammaddeSon - SatirSon+1,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	End If
' amman dikkat bu satýr önemli! ***********
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom() - 2,2,3,5,"")
'******************************************

End Sub
Function SatirSatir(satirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)

	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		k = 4
	Else 
		k = 2
	End If
	satirSatir = k * SatirYuksekligi
End Function
Sub MesajYaz(pe1,SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			Dosya = Old.Notes(i)
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr() + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.Picture(SatirPozr, Solmargin + 30, 50,120,"..\wd\images\" & trim(Dosya),114)
			res = pe1.UseSet(1)
		Else
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i) 
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,120,Mesaj)
		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function MesajSatir(SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			k = k + 55
		Else
			k = k + SatirYuksekligi
		End If
	Next
	MesajSatir = k
End Function
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 32,Tanim)
	Next
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Function Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)

	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")

	MuhendislikSatir = Tech.GetRecCount() * SatirYuksekligi

End Function
Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,"")
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,"")
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Alt = pe1.GetBottom()
'	res = pe1.Write(Alt, SagMargin - 30,6,32,"FR 343-01")
End Sub
Sub Hazirlayan(pe1,SatirPozr)
	If (satirPozr + 30) > satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satirPozr = UstMargin + 6
	End If
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,SolMargin,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "HAZIRLAYAN")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "ONAYLAYAN")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 3,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,30,0)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 12,SolMargin,0,SagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Box(satirPozr + 3,SolMargin,30,SagMargin-SolMargin)
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1, BaslangicSayfa, sonSayfa)
	SayfaSayisi = sonSayfa - BaslangicSayfa + 1
	For i = BaslangicSayfa To sonSayfa
		sayfaNo = i - BaslangicSayfa + 2
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin , SagMargin - 30, 6,30, "\b Sayfa  :  \b0 " & sayfaNo & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()   
Dim pe1
	OperasyonSatirNo = 0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Listeleri",297,210,"")
	for i = 1 to MMPS30T.GetRecCount()	
		MPSNo = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
		if trim(MPSNo) <> "" then
			rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10E","EVRAKNO",MPSNo)
			Set MPS10E = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_MMPS10E_SELECT")
			rows = Doc.SelectEQ("MMPS10T","EVRAKNO",MPSNo)
			Set MPS10T = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_MMPS10T_SELECT")
			if trim(MMPS30T.SELECTED(i))="E" then
				s=s+1
				
				if s > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
				end if
			Call PrintMPS(pe1)
			end if
		end if
	Next

	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i=1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		Baslik = Trim(CStr(i)) + " / " + Trim(CStr(pe1.GetPageCount()))	
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(282,10,6,190,"- \b Sayfa : \b0  " & Baslik & " -") 	   
	Next   
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub PrintMPS(pe1)
	
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	siraNo = 0
	For t=1 to satirsayisi
		if trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(t)) = "I" then
			m=m+1
		end if
	next
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
		if trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" then
			s=s+1
			Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
			if m<>s then
				Res=pe1.pagebreak()
			end if
			call SayfaBasi(pe1)

		end if
	Next	
End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
  	res = pe1.nopen()
  ustmargin=10
	solmargin=10
	Sayfaeni=210	
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

'*******************
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin - 5,SolMargin + 2, 6,180,FirmaAdi)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		MPSRefNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)

		MamulKodu = MPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
		MamulAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",MamulKodu,"")
		UretimSipNo = MPS10E.MUSTERISIPINO(1)
		GrupNo = MPS10E.GRUPEVRAKNO(1)
		ToleransTipi = MPS10E.TOLERANSTYPE(1)
		Tolerans = MPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,"")

		MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
'		MusteriAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,"")
'		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,"")
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+7
		SatirAra = 6
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"MPS Ref No")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,trim(MPSRefNo))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MamulKodu & "   " & MamulAdi)
'		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
'		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,MamulAdi)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,45,MamulMiktari & "  " & trim(StokBirimi))
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 85, 6,85,"(Tolerans : " & ToleransTipi & " % " & _
									Tolerans & ")")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Teslim Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,TeslimTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Müþteri")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MusteriAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Notlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not1)
		If trim(Not2) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 106,Not2)
		End If
		Alt = pe1.GetBottom()

		res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, SolMargin, Alt - BBasla + 2,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	'	Call Normal(pe1)

End Sub
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirno)
	
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 7
	satirSonu = 272
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)
	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		rSiraNo = trim(MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
		For j=1 To MPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)

			 satirpozr = 62
		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 62
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",IsMerkeziKodu,-1)
		OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
		OperasyonAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
		MamulPaketSayisi = MPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketSayisi = MPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = MPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YariMamulPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = MPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = FormatNumber(ToplamYariMamulMiktari,0,,,-1)
		BaslamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MPS10T.R_LATEST_B_TARIH(SatirNo))
		BitisTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MPS10T.R_LATEST_E_TARIH(SatirNo))

		res = pe1.NoPen()
		rSiraNo = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		m = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
		If m > 0 Then
			Boy = 3 * iSatir	+ 3
		Else
			Boy = 4 * iSatir - 2
		End If 
		
		BaslikBasla = SatirPozr - 3
		ToplamSatir = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
		DisBoy = ToplamSatir + 3 * iSatir

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(118,216,195))
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla, 10,Boy,190)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'barkodun arka planý
		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr -3, 10,Boy,20)

'gerçekleþen kutularý
		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + iSatir - 1, 170,6,25)
		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + 2 * iSatir - 1,170, 6,25)

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		If Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(BaslikBasla + Boy,10,0,190)						
		End If

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

		res = pe1.SetRotation(270)
		ArtNo = MPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)
		pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr - 4, 12,15,3 * iSatir,"CODE128",ArtNo,"")
		res = pe1.SetRotation(0)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,32,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,60,6,60,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,32,6,25,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,60,6,60,": " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(OperasyonAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,32,6,25,"Üretim Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,60,6,60,": " & MamulPaketSayisi & " x " & YariMamulPaketSayisi & " x " & YariMamulPaketIcerigi & _
																		" = " & ToplamYariMamulMiktari)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,145,6,25,"Planlanan")
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,170,6,25,"Gerçekleþen")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,150,6,20,"ONAY   :")

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,145,0,25)
		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,170,0,25)

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,120,6,25,"Baþlama Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,145,6,25,BaslamaTarihi)
		
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,120,6,25,"Bitiþ Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,145,6,25,BitisTarihi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

'mühendislik tanýmlarý
		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
		BaslikBitis = satirPozr
		Call muhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)

'		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2 * iSatir		
		If Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			HSatirBaslangic = satirpozr + iSatir
		Else
			HSatirBaslangic = BaslikBasla + Boy
		End If
		If m > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic,10,0,190)						
		End If 

		HSatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 5
		For j=1 To MPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(j)
			KaynakTipi1 = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				sonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
				If sonSatir1 >= satirSonu Then
			  		 res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,sonSatir1 - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
					 siraNo = 1
					 res = pe1.PageBreak()
					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					 satirpozr = 62
					 BaslikBasla = 62
					 HSatirBaslangic = 62
					 k = 0
				End If
				res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
				If (k Mod 2) = 0 Then
					res = pe1.NoPen()					
					res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
					res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(213,239,215))
					res = pe1.Box(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir - 1,10,6,190)
				End If
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
				HammaddeKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,50,6,80,HammaddeAdi)

				HammaddeMiktar = MPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)
				HammaddeMiktar = FormatNumber(HammaddeMiktar,0,,,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,135,6,30,HammaddeMiktar)

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,168,6,10,HammaddeBirim)
				k = k + 1
			End If
		Next
		HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla-1,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
	End If 
End Sub
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	MamulKodu = MPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	satirYuksekligi	= 7

	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	If SatirSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,165,Tanim)
	Next
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Function Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	MamulKodu = MPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)

	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")

	MuhendislikSatir = Tech.GetRecCount() * SatirYuksekligi

End Function
Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	SatirSayisi = MPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 0
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 181
	satirSonu = altmargin-50
	satiryuksekligi1=7.4

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Vizite Kaðýdý", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB06.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirSayisi = PERSB06T.GetRecCount()
	for i = 1 to satirSayisi
		Call satirYazdir(pe1, i)
	Next		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, satirNo)
res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
	
	if pe1.GetBottom() > satirSonu then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	else
		if satirNo = 1 then
			satirPozr = satirBaslangic
		else
		
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		end if
	end if
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 8)
	
	yil=PERSB06T.PRM_YIL(satirNo)
	ay=PERSB06T.PRM_AY(satirNo)
	gunsayisi=PERSB06T.PRM_ODEMEGUNSAYISI(satirNo)
	rakam=PERSB06T.PRM_UCRETI(satirNo)
	yazi=PERSB06T.PRM_UCRETI_YAZIYLA(satirNo)
	ekodeme1=PERSB06T.PRM_EKODEMELER1(satirNo)
	ekodeme2=PERSB06T.PRM_EKODEMELER2(satirNo)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,40,yil)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+14,satiryuksekligi,40,ay)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+24,satiryuksekligi,40,gunsayisi)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+41,satiryuksekligi,40,rakam)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+63,satiryuksekligi,80,yazi)	
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+121,satiryuksekligi,40,ekodeme1)
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+153,satiryuksekligi,40,ekodeme2)
		


End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 0
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 9
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4.7
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 152
	satirSonu = altmargin-65
	satiryuksekligi1=7.4

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "ÝþYeri Bildirgesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB07.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirSayisi = PERSB07T.GetRecCount()
	for i = 1 to satirSayisi
		Call satirYazdir(pe1, i)
	Next		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, satirNo)
res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
	
	if pe1.GetBottom() > satirSonu then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirPozr = satirBaslangic
	else
		if satirNo = 1 then
			satirPozr = satirBaslangic
		else
		
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		end if
	end if
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 8)
	
	yil=PERSB07T.PRM_YIL(satirNo)
	ay=PERSB07T.PRM_AY(satirNo)
	gunsayisi=PERSB07T.PRM_ODEMEGUNSAYISI(satirNo)
	
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,40,satirNo)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+9,satiryuksekligi,40,yil)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+69,satiryuksekligi,40,ay)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop,solmargin+129,satiryuksekligi,40,gunsayisi)
	

End Sub
